description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Compares total number of customer rows between model and reference.
sql: select 'total_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total_lifetime_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total_lifetime_orders' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares revenue-weighted global average order value (total revenue / total orders).
sql: select 'global_avg_order_value' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) / sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) / sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the unweighted mean of per-customer avg_order_value, sensitive to fan-out or null handling differences.
sql: select 'unweighted_avg_order_value' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_value) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_value) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the unweighted mean of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost, sensitive to null exclusion logic.
sql: select 'unweighted_avg_order_supply_cost' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the sum of the per-customer avg_order_supply_cost column, catching scale or null-handling errors.
sql: select 'sum_avg_order_supply_cost' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost (no qualifying orders with item records).
sql: select 'null_avg_order_supply_cost_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Full outer join on customer_id to find customers present only in model or only in reference.
sql: with fo as (select m.customer_id as m_id, r.customer_id as r_id from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id) select 'only_in_model' as slice, sum(case when r_id is null and m_id is not null then 1 else 0 end) as model_value, cast(0 as bigint) as reference_value from fo union all select 'only_in_reference' as slice, cast(0 as bigint) as model_value, sum(case when m_id is null and r_id is not null then 1 else 0 end) as reference_value from fo

description: Counts customer_id matches where customer_name differs between model and reference; expected value is 0.
sql: select 'customer_name_mismatch_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_name is distinct from r.customer_name) as model_value, cast(0 as bigint) as reference_value

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_revenue at the model's native grain, exposing any individual mismatches.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_orders at the model's native grain.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_orders as model_value, r.lifetime_orders as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_value, exposing division or rounding differences.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, r.avg_order_value as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_supply_cost, exposing null-exclusion or averaging differences.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost as model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_orders grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares the count of customers grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as period, count(*) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as period, count(*) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by month of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by month of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', last_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', last_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by quarter of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by quarter of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', last_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', last_order_date) as period, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares the count of customers grouped by week of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as period, count(*) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as period, count(*) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date (as epoch seconds) between model and reference to catch boundary truncation errors.
sql: select 'min_first_order_date' as slice, (select epoch(cast(min(first_order_date) as timestamp)) from model_output) as model_value, (select epoch(cast(min(first_order_date) as timestamp)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date (as epoch seconds) between model and reference to catch boundary truncation errors.
sql: select 'max_last_order_date' as slice, (select epoch(cast(max(last_order_date) as timestamp)) from model_output) as model_value, (select epoch(cast(max(last_order_date) as timestamp)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue for customers whose first_order_date equals the overall earliest date, each side using its own min.
sql: with md as (select min(first_order_date) as d from model_output), rd as (select min(first_order_date) as d from reference_output) select 'revenue_on_earliest_first_order_date' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output, md where first_order_date = md.d) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output, rd where first_order_date = rd.d) as reference_value

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue for customers whose last_order_date equals the overall latest date, each side using its own max.
sql: with md as (select max(last_order_date) as d from model_output), rd as (select max(last_order_date) as d from reference_output) select 'revenue_on_latest_last_order_date' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output, md where last_order_date = md.d) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output, rd where last_order_date = rd.d) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers whose first_order_date equals last_order_date (single-day lifetime).
sql: select 'single_day_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where first_order_date = last_order_date) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where first_order_date = last_order_date) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with exactly one lifetime order, an edge case for avg_order_value calculations.
sql: select 'single_order_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped into lifetime_orders buckets (1, 2-5, 6-10, 11+).
sql: with m as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.bucket = r.bucket

description: Compares the minimum lifetime_revenue value across all customers.
sql: select 'min_lifetime_revenue' as slice, (select min(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the maximum lifetime_revenue value across all customers.
sql: select 'max_lifetime_revenue' as slice, (select max(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the minimum lifetime_orders value across all customers.
sql: select 'min_lifetime_orders' as slice, (select min(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the maximum lifetime_orders value across all customers.
sql: select 'max_lifetime_orders' as slice, (select max(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with negative lifetime_revenue, which should not occur after refund exclusion.
sql: select 'negative_lifetime_revenue_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_revenue < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_revenue < 0) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with zero lifetime_orders, which should not occur given the grain definition.
sql: select 'zero_lifetime_orders_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 0) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with a null customer_name.
sql: select 'null_customer_name_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customer_name is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customer_name is null) as reference_value

description: Compares total number of customer rows between model and reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Compares revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders) across all customers.
sql: select 'total_weighted' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the simple (unweighted) mean of avg_order_supply_cost across customers.
sql: select 'total_simple_mean' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares order-count-weighted average supply cost across customers, which is sensitive to null handling.
sql: select 'total_weighted_by_orders' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders)/sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is not null) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders)/sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is not null) as reference_value

description: Counts customer_id keys present only in model_output vs only in reference_output.
sql: select 'in_model_only' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m where not exists (select 1 from reference_output r where r.customer_id = m.customer_id))::double as model_value, 0.0 as reference_value union all select 'in_reference_only' as slice, 0.0 as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r where not exists (select 1 from model_output m where m.customer_id = r.customer_id))::double as reference_value

description: Lists each individual customer_id key that is missing from either model_output or reference_output.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, case when m.customer_id is null then 0.0 else 1.0 end as model_value, case when r.customer_id is null then 0.0 else 1.0 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_id is null or r.customer_id is null limit 5000

description: Checks for duplicate customer_id rows (grain violation) in each table.
sql: select 'duplicate_customer_id_rows' as slice, (select count(*) - count(distinct customer_id) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) - count(distinct customer_id) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by month of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as mo, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as mo, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.mo as varchar), cast(r.mo as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by month of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', last_order_date) as mo, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', last_order_date) as mo, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.mo as varchar), cast(r.mo as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_orders grouped by week of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as wk, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as wk, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.wk as varchar), cast(r.wk as varchar)) as slice, m.val::double as model_value, r.val::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.wk = r.wk order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_orders grouped by quarter of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as q, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as q, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val::double as model_value, r.val::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compares customer counts grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as yr, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as yr, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.cnt::double as model_value, r.cnt::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date (as days since epoch) across all customers.
sql: select 'min_first_order_date' as slice, (select (min(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01') from model_output)::double as model_value, (select (min(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01') from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date (as days since epoch) across all customers.
sql: select 'max_last_order_date' as slice, (select (max(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01') from model_output)::double as model_value, (select (max(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01') from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Compares total revenue in each table's own earliest calendar month of first_order_date.
sql: with m_min as (select min(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as mon from model_output), r_min as (select min(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as mon from reference_output) select 'earliest_month_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output, m_min where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = m_min.mon) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output, r_min where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = r_min.mon) as reference_value

description: Compares total revenue in each table's own latest calendar month of last_order_date.
sql: with m_max as (select max(date_trunc('month', last_order_date)) as mon from model_output), r_max as (select max(date_trunc('month', last_order_date)) as mon from reference_output) select 'latest_month_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output, m_max where date_trunc('month', last_order_date) = m_max.mon) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output, r_max where date_trunc('month', last_order_date) = r_max.mon) as reference_value

description: Counts customers with exactly one lifetime order, a segment prone to averaging/fan-out errors.
sql: select 'lifetime_orders_eq_1' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1)::double as reference_value

description: Counts customers whose first and last order date are identical.
sql: select 'first_eq_last_order_date' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where first_order_date = last_order_date)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where first_order_date = last_order_date)::double as reference_value

description: Counts customers with lifetime_orders equal to 0, which should not exist given the join definition.
sql: select 'lifetime_orders_eq_0' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 0)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 0)::double as reference_value

description: Counts customers with negative lifetime_revenue, an anomaly signal.
sql: select 'lifetime_revenue_lt_0' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_revenue < 0)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_revenue < 0)::double as reference_value

description: Counts customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost, which occurs when no qualifying order has item records.
sql: select 'avg_order_supply_cost_is_null' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null)::double as reference_value

description: Compares the maximum lifetime_revenue value (top customer) between the two tables.
sql: select 'max_lifetime_revenue' as slice, (select max(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the minimum lifetime_revenue value between the two tables.
sql: select 'min_lifetime_revenue' as slice, (select min(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the maximum lifetime_orders value (most active customer) between the two tables.
sql: select 'max_lifetime_orders' as slice, (select max(lifetime_orders) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select max(lifetime_orders) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Compares the simple average lifetime_revenue per customer (unweighted by orders).
sql: select 'avg_per_customer' as slice, (select avg(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the simple average lifetime_orders per customer.
sql: select 'avg_per_customer' as slice, (select avg(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the sum of the per-customer avg_order_value column itself (sensitive to ratio miscomputation).
sql: select 'sum_of_avg_order_value_column' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_value) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_value) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Counts customers whose customer_name differs between model and reference for the same customer_id.
sql: select 'customer_name_mismatch' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_name is distinct from r.customer_name)::double as model_value, 0.0 as reference_value

description: Counts rows with a null customer_id in each table.
sql: select 'customer_id_is_null' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customer_id is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customer_id is null)::double as reference_value

description: Counts rows with a null customer_name in each table.
sql: select 'customer_name_is_null' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customer_name is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customer_name is null)::double as reference_value

description: Counts rows where avg_order_value does not equal lifetime_revenue divided by lifetime_orders within each table.
sql: select 'avg_order_value_ne_revenue_div_orders' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders > 0 and abs(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue / lifetime_orders) > 0.01)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders > 0 and abs(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue / lifetime_orders) > 0.01)::double as reference_value

description: Compares customer counts bucketed by lifetime_orders ranges (1, 2-5, 6-10, 11+).
sql: with m as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) as slice, m.cnt::double as model_value, r.cnt::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.bucket = r.bucket order by 1

description: Compares customer counts grouped by year of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as yr, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as yr, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.cnt::double as model_value, r.cnt::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by quarter of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compares the count of distinct customer_id values between the two tables.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_id_count' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_id) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_id) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Counts customers with avg_order_supply_cost exactly equal to zero, a potential sign of miscounted item-less orders.
sql: select 'avg_order_supply_cost_eq_0' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0)::double as reference_value

description: Compares total number of customer rows between model and reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares overall revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/nullif(sum(lifetime_orders),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/nullif(sum(lifetime_orders),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the simple (unweighted) mean of avg_order_supply_cost across customers, excluding nulls.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with a non-null avg_order_supply_cost, to catch null-handling differences.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Full outer join on customer_id to surface keys present only in model or only in reference.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, case when m.customer_id is not null then 1 else null end as model_value, case when r.customer_id is not null then 1 else null end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_id is null or r.customer_id is null limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_revenue via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_orders via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_orders as model_value, r.lifetime_orders as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_value via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, r.avg_order_value as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_supply_cost via full outer join on customer_id, exposing null-handling or fan-out issues.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost as model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of first_order_date (as days since epoch) via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, (m.first_order_date - DATE '1970-01-01') as model_value, (r.first_order_date - DATE '1970-01-01') as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of last_order_date (as days since epoch) via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, (m.last_order_date - DATE '1970-01-01') as model_value, (r.last_order_date - DATE '1970-01-01') as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Compares customer counts grouped by first_order_date year (acquisition cohort).
sql: with mm as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), rr as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.yr, rr.yr) as slice, mm.cnt as model_value, rr.cnt as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.yr = rr.yr

description: Compares customer counts grouped by first_order_date month (acquisition cohort).
sql: with mm as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), rr as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.ym, rr.ym) as slice, mm.cnt as model_value, rr.cnt as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.ym = rr.ym

description: Compares customer counts grouped by last_order_date month (recency).
sql: with mm as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), rr as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.ym, rr.ym) as slice, mm.cnt as model_value, rr.cnt as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.ym = rr.ym

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by first_order_date month.
sql: with mm as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1), rr as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.ym, rr.ym) as slice, mm.rev as model_value, rr.rev as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.ym = rr.ym

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by last_order_date month.
sql: with mm as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1), rr as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.ym, rr.ym) as slice, mm.rev as model_value, rr.rev as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.ym = rr.ym

description: Compares total lifetime_orders grouped by first_order_date year.
sql: with mm as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, sum(lifetime_orders) as ord from model_output group by 1), rr as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, sum(lifetime_orders) as ord from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.yr, rr.yr) as slice, mm.ord as model_value, rr.ord as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.yr = rr.yr

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by last_order_date quarter.
sql: with mm as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', last_order_date) as varchar) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1), rr as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', last_order_date) as varchar) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.q, rr.q) as slice, mm.rev as model_value, rr.rev as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.q = rr.q

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date (as days since epoch) across all customers.
sql: select 'min_first_order_date' as slice, (select min(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' from model_output) as model_value, (select min(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date (as days since epoch) across all customers.
sql: select 'max_last_order_date' as slice, (select max(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' from model_output) as model_value, (select max(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with exactly one lifetime order.
sql: select 'single_order_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue for customers with exactly one lifetime order.
sql: select 'single_order_customers_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of high-frequency customers with 10 or more lifetime orders.
sql: select 'high_order_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders >= 10) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders >= 10) as reference_value

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue for high-frequency customers with 10 or more lifetime orders.
sql: select 'high_order_customers_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where lifetime_orders >= 10) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where lifetime_orders >= 10) as reference_value

description: Compares, within each table independently, the count of customers where avg_order_value * lifetime_orders does not reconcile to lifetime_revenue.
sql: select 'avg_order_value_internal_mismatch_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where abs(avg_order_value * lifetime_orders - lifetime_revenue) > 0.01) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where abs(avg_order_value * lifetime_orders - lifetime_revenue) > 0.01) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost.
sql: select 'null_avg_order_supply_cost' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of null avg_order_supply_cost values across lifetime_orders buckets.
sql: with mm as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) filter (where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as nulls from model_output group by 1), rr as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) filter (where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as nulls from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(mm.bucket, rr.bucket) as slice, mm.nulls as model_value, rr.nulls as reference_value from mm full outer join rr on mm.bucket = rr.bucket

description: Compares the count of distinct customer_name values, to catch name collisions or fan-out.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_names' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_name) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_name) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customer_name values that appear on more than one row, which would indicate unexpected grain duplication.
sql: select 'duplicate_customer_names' as slice, (select count(*) from (select customer_name from model_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1)) as model_value, (select count(*) from (select customer_name from reference_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1)) as reference_value

description: Compares total lifetime_revenue for customers whose first_order_date equals last_order_date (effectively single-day activity).
sql: select 'single_day_activity_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where first_order_date = last_order_date) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where first_order_date = last_order_date) as reference_value

description: Compares lifetime_revenue for the top 10 customers by reference revenue, to validate the highest-impact accounts.
sql: with top as (select customer_id from reference_output order by lifetime_revenue desc limit 10) select top.customer_id as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from top left join model_output m on top.customer_id = m.customer_id left join reference_output r on top.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Compares the count of customers whose first_order_date falls in the earliest month observed across both tables.
sql: with bounds as (select min(first_order_date) as d from (select first_order_date from model_output union all select first_order_date from reference_output)) select 'earliest_month_customer_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output, bounds where strftime(model_output.first_order_date, '%Y-%m') = strftime(bounds.d, '%Y-%m')) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output, bounds where strftime(reference_output.first_order_date, '%Y-%m') = strftime(bounds.d, '%Y-%m')) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers whose last_order_date falls in the latest month observed across both tables.
sql: with bounds as (select max(last_order_date) as d from (select last_order_date from model_output union all select last_order_date from reference_output)) select 'latest_month_customer_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output, bounds where strftime(model_output.last_order_date, '%Y-%m') = strftime(bounds.d, '%Y-%m')) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output, bounds where strftime(reference_output.last_order_date, '%Y-%m') = strftime(bounds.d, '%Y-%m')) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with negative lifetime_revenue, which should not occur if refunds are properly excluded.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_revenue < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_revenue < 0) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with zero lifetime_orders, which should not occur given the inner join to qualifying orders.
sql: select 'zero_orders_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 0) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with avg_order_supply_cost exactly zero, to detect whether orders with no item records were incorrectly counted as zero instead of excluded.
sql: select 'avg_order_supply_cost_zero_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0) as reference_value

description: Compares the sum of avg_order_supply_cost across all customers, sensitive to null-vs-zero handling differences in aggregate.
sql: select 'sum_avg_order_supply_cost' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Compares the total number of customer rows between model and reference.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the grand total of lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the grand total of lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(SUM(lifetime_orders) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(SUM(lifetime_orders) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders) overall, which exposes fan-out or exclusion bugs that per-row averages hide.
sql: SELECT 'total_weighted_avg_order_value' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue)/SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue)/SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the simple mean of the per-customer avg_order_value field across all customers.
sql: SELECT 'total_simple_mean_avg_order_value' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_value) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_value) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the simple mean of the per-customer avg_order_supply_cost field across all customers, sensitive to item-join fan-out.
sql: SELECT 'total_simple_mean_avg_order_supply_cost' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with a NULL avg_order_supply_cost, which should reflect orders-with-no-items exclusion consistently.
sql: SELECT 'null_avg_order_supply_cost_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Compares the count of customers with a NULL avg_order_value, which should be zero on both sides given the grain.
sql: SELECT 'null_avg_order_value_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_value IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_value IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Compares counts of customer_id keys present only in model, only in reference, and in both, to surface missing or extra qualifying customers.
sql: WITH full_join AS (SELECT m.customer_id AS m_id, r.customer_id AS r_id FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id) SELECT 'only_in_model' AS slice, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r_id IS NULL AND m_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, 0.0 AS reference_value FROM full_join UNION ALL SELECT 'only_in_reference' AS slice, 0.0 AS model_value, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m_id IS NULL AND r_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM full_join UNION ALL SELECT 'matched' AS slice, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m_id IS NOT NULL AND r_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m_id IS NOT NULL AND r_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM full_join

description: Full per-customer comparison of lifetime_revenue to catch customer-level discrepancies hidden by aggregate totals.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.lifetime_revenue AS model_value, r.lifetime_revenue AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Full per-customer comparison of lifetime_orders, sensitive to item-join fan-out or wrongful order exclusion.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, CAST(m.lifetime_orders AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(r.lifetime_orders AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Full per-customer comparison of avg_order_value.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.avg_order_value AS model_value, r.avg_order_value AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Full per-customer comparison of avg_order_supply_cost, sensitive to item-join fan-out in the averaging.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost AS model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Compares lifetime_revenue totals bucketed by the year of first_order_date.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, m.rev AS model_value, r.rev AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr ORDER BY 1

description: Compares lifetime_revenue totals bucketed by the year of last_order_date.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM last_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM last_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, m.rev AS model_value, r.rev AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr ORDER BY 1

description: Compares lifetime_revenue totals bucketed by the calendar month of first_order_date.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.ym, r.ym) AS slice, m.rev AS model_value, r.rev AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.ym = r.ym ORDER BY 1

description: Compares lifetime_orders totals bucketed by the calendar month of last_order_date.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS cnt FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS cnt FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.ym, r.ym) AS slice, CAST(m.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(r.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.ym = r.ym ORDER BY 1

description: Compares customer counts bucketed by the calendar month of first_order_date.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.ym, r.ym) AS slice, CAST(m.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(r.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.ym = r.ym ORDER BY 1

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date across all customers (encoded as YYYYMMDD integer).
sql: SELECT 'min_first_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MIN(first_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MIN(first_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the latest first_order_date across all customers (encoded as YYYYMMDD integer).
sql: SELECT 'max_first_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MAX(first_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MAX(first_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the earliest last_order_date across all customers (encoded as YYYYMMDD integer).
sql: SELECT 'min_last_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MIN(last_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MIN(last_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date across all customers (encoded as YYYYMMDD integer).
sql: SELECT 'max_last_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MAX(last_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(strftime(MAX(last_order_date), '%Y%m%d') AS BIGINT) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares lifetime_revenue for the earliest calendar month of first_order_date (per reference), a boundary-period edge case.
sql: WITH r_min AS (SELECT MIN(strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m')) AS ym FROM reference_output) SELECT 'first_month_revenue' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM model_output WHERE strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') = (SELECT ym FROM r_min)) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM reference_output WHERE strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') = (SELECT ym FROM r_min)) AS reference_value

description: Compares lifetime_revenue for the latest calendar month of first_order_date (per reference), a boundary-period edge case.
sql: WITH r_max AS (SELECT MAX(strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m')) AS ym FROM reference_output) SELECT 'last_month_revenue' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM model_output WHERE strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') = (SELECT ym FROM r_max)) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM reference_output WHERE strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') = (SELECT ym FROM r_max)) AS reference_value

description: Compares lifetime_revenue totals bucketed by lifetime_orders size (1, 2-5, 6-10, 11+), sensitive to order-count-dependent fan-out bugs.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders = 1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders = 1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.bucket, r.bucket) AS slice, m.rev AS model_value, r.rev AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.bucket = r.bucket ORDER BY 1

description: Compares the count of customers with exactly one lifetime order, an edge case for the order-count/revenue ratio.
sql: SELECT 'single_order_customers_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS reference_value

description: Compares avg_order_value for the top 20 customers by reference lifetime_revenue, a high-impact slice for catching material dollar errors.
sql: WITH top20 AS (SELECT customer_id FROM reference_output ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.avg_order_value AS model_value, r.avg_order_value AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top20)

description: Compares the simple mean of avg_order_supply_cost bucketed by lifetime_orders size, sensitive to item-join fan-out that scales with order count.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders = 1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders = 1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.bucket, r.bucket) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.bucket = r.bucket ORDER BY 1

description: Compares customer counts bucketed by the year of first_order_date.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, CAST(m.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(r.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr ORDER BY 1

description: Compares lifetime_revenue totals bucketed by calendar quarter of first_order_date.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS q, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CAST(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) AS VARCHAR) AS q, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS rev FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.q, r.q) AS slice, m.rev AS model_value, r.rev AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q ORDER BY 1

description: Counts customers whose first_order_date differs between model and reference; expected value is zero.
sql: SELECT 'first_order_date_mismatch_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.first_order_date <> r.first_order_date) AS model_value, 0.0 AS reference_value

description: Counts customers whose last_order_date differs between model and reference; expected value is zero.
sql: SELECT 'last_order_date_mismatch_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.last_order_date <> r.last_order_date) AS model_value, 0.0 AS reference_value

description: Counts customers whose customer_name differs between model and reference; expected value is zero.
sql: SELECT 'customer_name_mismatch_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.customer_name <> r.customer_name) AS model_value, 0.0 AS reference_value

description: Compares the total number of customer rows between model and reference outputs.
sql:
SELECT 'total' AS slice,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output)::double AS reference_value

description: Compares the grand total of lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql:
SELECT 'total' AS slice,
       (SELECT sum(lifetime_orders) FROM model_output)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT sum(lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output)::double AS reference_value

description: Compares the grand total of lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql:
SELECT 'total' AS slice,
       (SELECT sum(lifetime_revenue) FROM model_output)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT sum(lifetime_revenue) FROM reference_output)::double AS reference_value

description: Compares the revenue-weighted overall average order value (sum revenue / sum orders).
sql:
SELECT 'total' AS slice,
       (SELECT sum(lifetime_revenue)::double / sum(lifetime_orders) FROM model_output) AS model_value,
       (SELECT sum(lifetime_revenue)::double / sum(lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares the unweighted mean of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost across all customers.
sql:
SELECT 'total' AS slice,
       (SELECT avg(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM model_output) AS model_value,
       (SELECT avg(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Lists customer_id keys present in only one of the two tables (full outer join), flagging coverage gaps.
sql:
SELECT coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice,
       CASE WHEN m.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS model_value,
       CASE WHEN r.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS reference_value
FROM model_output m
FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r USING (customer_id)
WHERE m.customer_id IS NULL OR r.customer_id IS NULL

description: Checks for duplicate customer_id values (row count minus distinct count) in each table independently.
sql:
SELECT 'model_dupes' AS slice,
       (count(*) - count(DISTINCT customer_id))::double AS model_value,
       NULL AS reference_value
FROM model_output
UNION ALL
SELECT 'reference_dupes' AS slice,
       NULL AS model_value,
       (count(*) - count(DISTINCT customer_id))::double AS reference_value
FROM reference_output

description: Row-level comparison of lifetime_orders for every customer_id via full outer join.
sql:
SELECT coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice,
       m.lifetime_orders::double AS model_value,
       r.lifetime_orders::double AS reference_value
FROM model_output m
FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r USING (customer_id)

description: Row-level comparison of lifetime_revenue for every customer_id via full outer join.
sql:

FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r USING (customer_id)

description: Row-level comparison of first_order_date (as days since epoch) for every customer_id.
sql:
SELECT coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice,
       (m.first_order_date - DATE '1970-01-01')::double AS model_value,
       (r.first_order_date - DATE '1970-01-01')::double AS reference_value
FROM model_output m
FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r USING (customer_id)

FROM model_output m
FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r USING (customer_id)

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by the year of first_order_date, independently aggregated then outer-joined.
sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) AS varchar) AS yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM model_output GROUP BY 1
), r AS (
  SELECT cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) AS varchar) AS yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value
FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr
ORDER BY 1

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by year-month of first_order_date.
sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val

ORDER BY 1

sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) AS varchar) || '-Q' || cast(date_part('quarter', first_order_date) AS varchar) AS qtr, sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM model_output GROUP BY 1
), r AS (
  SELECT cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) AS varchar) || '-Q' || cast(date_part('quarter', first_order_date) AS varchar) AS qtr, sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.qtr, r.qtr) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value
FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.qtr = r.qtr
ORDER BY 1

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by week-start (Monday) of first_order_date.
sql:
WITH m AS (

  FROM model_output GROUP BY 1

description: Compares the unweighted mean of avg_order_supply_cost by year-month of first_order_date, exposing averaging distortions from item-less orders.
sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, avg(avg_order_supply_cost) AS val
  FROM model_output GROUP BY 1
), r AS (
  SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, avg(avg_order_supply_cost) AS val
  FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value
FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.ym = r.ym
ORDER BY 1

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by a lifetime_orders bucket (1, 2-5, 6-10, 11+) to expose fan-out distortions concentrated in multi-order customers.
sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders = 1 THEN '1'
              WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5'
              WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10'
              ELSE '11+' END AS bucket,
         sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM model_output GROUP BY 1
), r AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders = 1 THEN '1'
              WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5'
              WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10'
              ELSE '11+' END AS bucket,
         sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value
FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.bucket = r.bucket
ORDER BY 1

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date across all customers (days since epoch).
sql:
SELECT 'min_first_order_date' AS slice,
       (SELECT min(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT min(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output)::double AS reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date across all customers (days since epoch).
sql:
SELECT 'max_last_order_date' AS slice,
       (SELECT max(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT max(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output)::double AS reference_value

description: Counts customers with a NULL avg_order_supply_cost, which should occur only when all qualifying orders lack item records.
sql:
SELECT 'null_avg_order_supply_cost_count' AS slice,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL)::double AS reference_value

description: Counts rows with lifetime_orders <= 0, which should never occur per the business definition (at least one qualifying order).
sql:
SELECT 'lifetime_orders_le_0_count' AS slice,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_orders <= 0)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_orders <= 0)::double AS reference_value

description: Counts rows in each table where stored avg_order_value deviates from lifetime_revenue/lifetime_orders by more than 0.01, an internal consistency check.
sql:
SELECT 'inconsistent_avg_order_value_rows' AS slice,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE abs(avg_order_value - (lifetime_revenue::double / lifetime_orders)) > 0.01)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE abs(avg_order_value - (lifetime_revenue::double / lifetime_orders)) > 0.01)::double AS reference_value

description: Counts customer_id keys present in both tables where customer_name differs between model and reference.
sql:
SELECT 'customer_name_mismatch_count' AS slice,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.customer_name IS DISTINCT FROM r.customer_name)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.customer_name IS DISTINCT FROM r.customer_name)::double AS reference_value

description: Compares the count of distinct first_order_date values, a coarse check on date range/coverage differences.
sql:
SELECT 'distinct_first_order_date_count' AS slice,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT first_order_date) FROM model_output)::double AS model_value,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT first_order_date) FROM reference_output)::double AS reference_value

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by day-of-week of first_order_date to catch boundary/off-by-one date issues.
sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT dayofweek(first_order_date) AS dow, sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM model_output GROUP BY 1
), r AS (
  SELECT dayofweek(first_order_date) AS dow, sum(lifetime_revenue) AS val
  FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cast(coalesce(m.dow, r.dow) AS varchar) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value
FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.dow = r.dow
ORDER BY 1

description: Counts customers grouped by the year of last_order_date.

WITH m AS (

FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr
ORDER BY 1

description: Compares the revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders) grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) AS varchar) AS yr, sum(lifetime_revenue)::double / sum(lifetime_orders) AS val
  FROM model_output GROUP BY 1
), r AS (
  SELECT cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) AS varchar) AS yr, sum(lifetime_revenue)::double / sum(lifetime_orders) AS val
  FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value
FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr
ORDER BY 1

description: Compares total number of customer rows between model and reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders) across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the simple (unweighted) average of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost across customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares order-count-weighted average supply cost, excluding customers with null avg_order_supply_cost.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders)/sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is not null) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders)/sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is not null) as reference_value

description: Counts customer_ids present only in model_output and only in reference_output, exposing dropped or extra keys (e.g. customers whose orders all lack item records).
sql: select 'only_in_model' as slice, count(*)::double as model_value, 0.0 as reference_value from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where r.customer_id is null union all select 'only_in_reference' as slice, 0.0 as model_value, count(*)::double as reference_value from reference_output r left join model_output m on r.customer_id = m.customer_id where m.customer_id is null

description: Compares distinct customer_id counts between both outputs to check for duplicate keys.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_id' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Row-level comparison of lifetime_revenue per customer via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Row-level comparison of lifetime_orders per customer via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_orders as model_value, r.lifetime_orders as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Row-level comparison of avg_order_value per customer via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, r.avg_order_value as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Row-level comparison of avg_order_supply_cost per customer via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost as model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Row-level comparison of first_order_date per customer (as epoch seconds) via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, epoch(cast(m.first_order_date as timestamp)) as model_value, epoch(cast(r.first_order_date as timestamp)) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Row-level comparison of last_order_date per customer (as epoch seconds) via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, epoch(cast(m.last_order_date as timestamp)) as model_value, epoch(cast(r.last_order_date as timestamp)) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Counts customers with null avg_order_supply_cost (orders with no item records), checking the exclusion-from-average rule is applied consistently.
sql: select 'null_avg_order_supply_cost_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Counts rows with null or non-positive lifetime_orders, which should not occur at this grain.
sql: select 'lifetime_orders_le_zero_or_null' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders is null or lifetime_orders <= 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders is null or lifetime_orders <= 0) as reference_value

description: Counts rows with a null customer_name, which would indicate a join issue.
sql: select 'customer_name_null_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customer_name is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customer_name is null) as reference_value

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date across all customers (boundary of the dataset).
sql: select 'global_min_first_order_date' as slice, (select epoch(cast(min(first_order_date) as timestamp)) from model_output) as model_value, (select epoch(cast(min(first_order_date) as timestamp)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date across all customers (boundary of the dataset).
sql: select 'global_max_last_order_date' as slice, (select epoch(cast(max(last_order_date) as timestamp)) from model_output) as model_value, (select epoch(cast(max(last_order_date) as timestamp)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Counts customers grouped by acquisition year (year of first_order_date).
