sql: with m as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by acquisition year (year of first_order_date).
sql: with m as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_part('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.rev as model_value, r.rev as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr

description: Counts customers grouped by acquisition year-quarter (quarter of first_order_date).
sql: with m as (select date_part('year', first_order_date)||'-Q'||date_part('quarter', first_order_date) as q, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_part('year', first_order_date)||'-Q'||date_part('quarter', first_order_date) as q, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q

description: Counts customers grouped by acquisition year-month (month of first_order_date).
sql: with m as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by year of last_order_date (recency cohort).
sql: with m as (select cast(date_part('year', last_order_date) as varchar) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_part('year', last_order_date) as varchar) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.rev as model_value, r.rev as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr

description: Sums lifetime_orders grouped by year-month of last_order_date (recency cohort).
sql: with m as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_orders) as ord from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_orders) as ord from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.ord as model_value, r.ord as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Counts customers grouped by week of last_order_date to catch fine-grained period boundary issues.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('week', last_order_date) as varchar) as wk, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('week', last_order_date) as varchar) as wk, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.wk, r.wk) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.wk = r.wk

description: Compares the model's stored avg_order_value to the reference's revenue/orders ratio recomputed from its own raw fields, per customer.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, (r.lifetime_revenue / r.lifetime_orders) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Sums lifetime_revenue for customers first acquired in the current year (2026), the most recent partial cohort.
sql: select 'cohort_2026_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_part('year', first_order_date) = 2026) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_part('year', first_order_date) = 2026) as reference_value

description: Counts customers first acquired in the current year (2026), the most recent partial cohort.
sql: select 'cohort_2026_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where date_part('year', first_order_date) = 2026) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where date_part('year', first_order_date) = 2026) as reference_value

description: Sums lifetime_revenue for customers whose last order was in September 2026, the most recent complete month before today's date.
sql: select 'last_order_2026_09_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2026-09') as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') = '2026-09') as reference_value

description: Counts customers with exactly one lifetime order, a common edge case for ratio calculations.
sql: select 'single_order_customers_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Counts customers whose first and last order dates are identical, an edge case for date-boundary logic.
sql: select 'first_eq_last_order_date_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where first_order_date = last_order_date) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where first_order_date = last_order_date) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Compares total number of customer rows between model and reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total of lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total of lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares overall revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/nullif(sum(lifetime_orders),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)/nullif(sum(lifetime_orders),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares simple (unweighted) mean of per-customer avg_order_value, sensitive to fan-out or null distortion.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_value) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_value) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares simple mean of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost, which should ignore nulls on both sides.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Counts customer_ids present in one table but missing from the other.
sql: select 'in_model_not_in_reference' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m left join reference_output r using(customer_id) where r.customer_id is null) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'in_reference_not_in_model' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r left join model_output m using(customer_id) where m.customer_id is null) as reference_value

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_revenue via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_orders via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_orders as model_value, r.lifetime_orders as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_value via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, r.avg_order_value as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_supply_cost via full outer join on customer_id, exposing null-handling differences.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost as model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of first_order_date (as epoch days) via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', m.first_order_date) as model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', r.first_order_date) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of last_order_date (as epoch days) via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', m.last_order_date) as model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', r.last_order_date) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Counts customers where customer_name differs between model and reference for the same customer_id; reference expected to be 0.
sql: select 'customer_name_mismatches' as slice, count(*) filter (where m.customer_name is distinct from r.customer_name) as model_value, 0 as reference_value from model_output m join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(a.yr, b.yr) as slice, a.rev as model_value, b.rev as reference_value from (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) b on a.yr = b.yr

description: Counts customers grouped by year of first_order_date (acquisition cohort).
sql: select coalesce(a.yr, b.yr) as slice, a.cnt as model_value, b.cnt as reference_value from (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') as yr, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') as yr, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) b on a.yr = b.yr

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by year-month of first_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(a.ym, b.ym) as slice, a.rev as model_value, b.rev as reference_value from (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) b on a.ym = b.ym

description: Sums lifetime_orders grouped by year-month of first_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(a.ym, b.ym) as slice, a.ords as model_value, b.ords as reference_value from (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_orders) as ords from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select strftime(first_order_date,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_orders) as ords from reference_output group by 1) b on a.ym = b.ym

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by year-month of last_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(a.ym, b.ym) as slice, a.rev as model_value, b.rev as reference_value from (select strftime(last_order_date,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select strftime(last_order_date,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) b on a.ym = b.ym

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by year-week of last_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(a.wk, b.wk) as slice, a.rev as model_value, b.rev as reference_value from (select strftime(last_order_date,'%Y-%W') as wk, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select strftime(last_order_date,'%Y-%W') as wk, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) b on a.wk = b.wk

description: Sums lifetime_revenue grouped by quarter of first_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(a.q, b.q) as slice, a.rev as model_value, b.rev as reference_value from (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) b on a.q = b.q

description: Counts customers grouped by year of last_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(a.yr, b.yr) as slice, a.cnt as model_value, b.cnt as reference_value from (select strftime(last_order_date,'%Y') as yr, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1) a full outer join (select strftime(last_order_date,'%Y') as yr, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) b on a.yr = b.yr

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date (as epoch days) across all customers.
sql: select 'min_first_order_date_epoch' as slice, (select date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', min(first_order_date)) from model_output) as model_value, (select date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', min(first_order_date)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date (as epoch days) across all customers.
sql: select 'max_last_order_date_epoch' as slice, (select date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', max(last_order_date)) from model_output) as model_value, (select date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', max(last_order_date)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares total revenue of customers whose first_order_date equals the earliest first_order_date in each table.
sql: select 'revenue_of_customers_with_earliest_first_order_date' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where first_order_date = (select min(first_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where first_order_date = (select min(first_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Compares total revenue of customers whose last_order_date equals the latest last_order_date in each table.
sql: select 'revenue_of_customers_with_latest_last_order_date' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where last_order_date = (select max(last_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where last_order_date = (select max(last_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Counts customers bucketed by lifetime_orders value (1,2,...,10+), exposing join fan-out or de-dup differences in order counting.
sql: select coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from (select case when lifetime_orders>=10 then '10+' else cast(lifetime_orders as varchar) end as bucket, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select case when lifetime_orders>=10 then '10+' else cast(lifetime_orders as varchar) end as bucket, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) r on m.bucket = r.bucket

description: Compares count of customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost (no item records on any qualifying order).
sql: select 'customers_with_null_avg_order_supply_cost' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Compares count of distinct customer_name values between model and reference.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_name_count' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_name) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_name) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the minimum lifetime_orders value across customers, flags unexpected zero/negative values.
sql: select 'min_lifetime_orders' as slice, (select min(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the maximum single-customer lifetime_revenue value between model and reference.
sql: select 'max_lifetime_revenue' as slice, (select max(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares sum(avg_order_value * lifetime_orders) against total lifetime_revenue, exposing inconsistencies in the stored ratio.
sql: select 'sum_avg_order_value_times_orders' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_value * lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_value * lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares total row counts between model and reference outputs.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Compares distinct customer_id counts between model and reference.
sql: SELECT 'distinct_customers' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM model_output)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM reference_output)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Lists customer_ids present in only one of the two tables with a presence flag for each side.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM model_output), r AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM reference_output) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, CASE WHEN m.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS model_value, CASE WHEN r.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.customer_id IS NULL OR r.customer_id IS NULL

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: SELECT 'total_lifetime_revenue' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: SELECT 'total_lifetime_orders' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM model_output)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Overall average order value computed as total revenue divided by total orders, to catch fan-out or division distortions.
sql: SELECT 'weighted_avg_order_value' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue)/SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue)/SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Unweighted mean of avg_order_supply_cost across customers, ignoring nulls.
sql: SELECT 'mean_avg_order_supply_cost' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Order-weighted average of avg_order_supply_cost, to detect distortion from null handling on no-item orders.
sql: SELECT 'weighted_avg_order_supply_cost' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders)/SUM(CASE WHEN avg_order_supply_cost IS NOT NULL THEN lifetime_orders ELSE 0 END) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders)/SUM(CASE WHEN avg_order_supply_cost IS NOT NULL THEN lifetime_orders ELSE 0 END) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Count of customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost (should only occur when all qualifying orders lack item records).
sql: SELECT 'null_avg_order_supply_cost_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Count of customers with avg_order_supply_cost exactly zero, to catch no-item orders incorrectly treated as zero cost instead of excluded.
sql: SELECT 'zero_avg_order_supply_cost_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost = 0)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost = 0)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Count of customers with zero lifetime_orders, which should never occur given the qualifying-order join.
sql: SELECT 'zero_order_customers' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 0)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 0)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_revenue.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.lifetime_revenue AS model_value, r.lifetime_revenue AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_orders.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.lifetime_orders AS model_value, r.lifetime_orders AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_value.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.avg_order_value AS model_value, r.avg_order_value AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_supply_cost.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost AS model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of first_order_date expressed as days since epoch.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', m.first_order_date) AS model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', r.first_order_date) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of last_order_date expressed as days since epoch.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', m.last_order_date) AS model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', r.last_order_date) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Count of matching customer_ids where customer_name differs between model and reference; expected to be zero.
sql: SELECT 'customer_name_mismatch_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.customer_name IS DISTINCT FROM r.customer_name)::DOUBLE AS model_value, 0::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Lifetime revenue summed by the year of first_order_date.
sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(m.first_order_date, r.first_order_date)) AS VARCHAR) AS slice, SUM(m.lifetime_revenue) AS model_value, SUM(r.lifetime_revenue) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Lifetime revenue summed by the year-month of first_order_date.
sql: SELECT STRFTIME(COALESCE(m.first_order_date, r.first_order_date), '%Y-%m') AS slice, SUM(m.lifetime_revenue) AS model_value, SUM(r.lifetime_revenue) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Lifetime revenue summed by the year of last_order_date.
sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(m.last_order_date, r.last_order_date)) AS VARCHAR) AS slice, SUM(m.lifetime_revenue) AS model_value, SUM(r.lifetime_revenue) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Lifetime revenue summed by the year-month of last_order_date.
sql: SELECT STRFTIME(COALESCE(m.last_order_date, r.last_order_date), '%Y-%m') AS slice, SUM(m.lifetime_revenue) AS model_value, SUM(r.lifetime_revenue) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Count of customers by the week (Monday-start) of first_order_date.
sql: SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('week', COALESCE(m.first_order_date, r.first_order_date)), '%Y-%m-%d') AS slice, COUNT(m.customer_id) AS model_value, COUNT(r.customer_id) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Count of customers by the exact day of first_order_date.
sql: SELECT STRFTIME(COALESCE(m.first_order_date, r.first_order_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS slice, COUNT(m.customer_id) AS model_value, COUNT(r.customer_id) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Lifetime_orders summed by the year of first_order_date.
sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(m.first_order_date, r.first_order_date)) AS VARCHAR) AS slice, SUM(m.lifetime_orders) AS model_value, SUM(r.lifetime_orders) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Lifetime_orders summed by the year of last_order_date.
sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(m.last_order_date, r.last_order_date)) AS VARCHAR) AS slice, SUM(m.lifetime_orders) AS model_value, SUM(r.lifetime_orders) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Earliest first_order_date overall, expressed as days since epoch, to check boundary alignment.
sql: SELECT 'min_first_order_date' AS slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: Latest last_order_date overall, expressed as days since epoch, to check boundary alignment.
sql: SELECT 'max_last_order_date' AS slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: Total revenue among customers with exactly one lifetime order.
sql: SELECT 'single_order_customers_revenue' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS reference_value

description: Count of single-order customers where avg_order_value does not equal lifetime_revenue; expected zero mismatches.
sql: SELECT 'single_order_avg_value_mismatch_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1 AND ABS(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue) > 0.01)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1 AND ABS(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue) > 0.01)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Lifetime_revenue comparison for the top 20 customers ranked by reference revenue.
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT customer_id FROM reference_output ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT t.customer_id AS slice, m.lifetime_revenue AS model_value, r.lifetime_revenue AS reference_value FROM top t LEFT JOIN model_output m ON m.customer_id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN reference_output r ON r.customer_id = t.customer_id

description: Lifetime revenue summed by year-quarter of first_order_date.
sql: SELECT CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(m.first_order_date, r.first_order_date)) AS VARCHAR), '-Q', CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM COALESCE(m.first_order_date, r.first_order_date)) AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, SUM(m.lifetime_revenue) AS model_value, SUM(r.lifetime_revenue) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

description: Count of customers with a non-null avg_order_supply_cost, i.e. at least one qualifying order with item records.
sql: SELECT 'customers_with_supply_cost_data' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NOT NULL)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NOT NULL)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Unweighted mean of per-customer avg_order_value across all customers.
sql: SELECT 'simple_mean_avg_order_value' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_value) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_value) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Maximum lifetime_orders value across all customers, to check for outlier/fan-out distortions.
sql: SELECT 'max_lifetime_orders' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(lifetime_orders) FROM model_output)::DOUBLE AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output)::DOUBLE AS reference_value

description: Compares total row counts (customer coverage) between model and reference.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Counts customer_ids present only in model vs only in reference to detect join/filter mismatches.
sql: select 'key_coverage_only_in_one_side' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where r.customer_id is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r left join model_output m on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_id is null) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Order-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders) across all customers.
sql: select 'avg_order_value_weighted' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)::double / sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue)::double / sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Simple mean of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost values to check null-handling parity.
sql: select 'avg_order_supply_cost_mean_of_means' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Counts customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost (no item records), checking exclusion-vs-zero handling parity.
sql: select 'null_avg_order_supply_cost' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Distinct customer_id count to confirm grain and detect duplicate rows per customer.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_id' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Distinct customer_name count to detect join fan-out producing duplicate names per id or vice versa.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_name' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_name) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_name) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_orders.
sql: with m as (select customer_id, lifetime_orders as val from model_output), r as (select customer_id, lifetime_orders as val from reference_output) select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_revenue.
sql: with m as (select customer_id, lifetime_revenue as val from model_output), r as (select customer_id, lifetime_revenue as val from reference_output) select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_value.
sql: with m as (select customer_id, avg_order_value as val from model_output), r as (select customer_id, avg_order_value as val from reference_output) select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_supply_cost.
sql: with m as (select customer_id, avg_order_supply_cost as val from model_output), r as (select customer_id, avg_order_supply_cost as val from reference_output) select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of first_order_date expressed as days since epoch.
sql: with m as (select customer_id, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', first_order_date) as val from model_output), r as (select customer_id, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', first_order_date) as val from reference_output) select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer comparison of last_order_date expressed as days since epoch.
sql: with m as (select customer_id, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', last_order_date) as val from model_output), r as (select customer_id, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', last_order_date) as val from reference_output) select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from first_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from first_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by month of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by quarter of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as q, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q

description: Total lifetime_orders grouped by year of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from last_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from last_order_date) as yr, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr

description: Total lifetime_orders grouped by month of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by week (week-start) of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('week', last_order_date) as varchar) as wk, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('week', last_order_date) as varchar) as wk, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.wk, r.wk) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.wk = r.wk

description: Earliest first_order_date across all customers, expressed as days since epoch.
sql: select 'min_first_order_date' as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select min(first_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select min(first_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Latest last_order_date across all customers, expressed as days since epoch.
sql: select 'max_last_order_date' as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select max(last_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select max(last_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct first_order_date values, checking for date truncation/timezone errors.
sql: select 'distinct_first_order_dates' as slice, (select count(distinct first_order_date) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct first_order_date) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct last_order_date values, checking for date truncation/timezone errors.
sql: select 'distinct_last_order_dates' as slice, (select count(distinct last_order_date) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct last_order_date) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of customers whose first_order_date equals the overall earliest date, checking the earliest-cohort boundary.
sql: with mn_m as (select min(first_order_date) as mn from model_output), mn_r as (select min(first_order_date) as mn from reference_output) select 'customers_at_min_first_order_date' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output, mn_m where first_order_date = mn_m.mn) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output, mn_r where first_order_date = mn_r.mn) as reference_value

description: Count of customers whose last_order_date equals the overall latest date, checking the most-recent-cohort boundary.
sql: with mx_m as (select max(last_order_date) as mx from model_output), mx_r as (select max(last_order_date) as mx from reference_output) select 'customers_at_max_last_order_date' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output, mx_m where last_order_date = mx_m.mx) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output, mx_r where last_order_date = mx_r.mx) as reference_value

description: Count of customers with exactly one lifetime order (edge case for avg_order_value and avg_order_supply_cost).
sql: select 'single_order_customers_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Total revenue among customers with exactly one lifetime order.
sql: select 'single_order_customers_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by customer_name, exposing join fan-out or name-mapping errors.
sql: with m as (select customer_name, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_name, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_name, r.customer_name) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_name = r.customer_name

description: Total lifetime_orders grouped by customer_name, exposing join fan-out or name-mapping errors.
sql: with m as (select customer_name, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_name, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_name, r.customer_name) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_name = r.customer_name

description: Mean avg_order_supply_cost split by single-order vs multi-order customers, testing the exclusion-of-itemless-orders logic.
sql: with m as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then 'single_order' else 'multi_order' end as bucket, avg(avg_order_supply_cost) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then 'single_order' else 'multi_order' end as bucket, avg(avg_order_supply_cost) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.bucket = r.bucket

description: Sum of lifetime_revenue restricted to customer_ids present in both tables, isolating value errors from coverage gaps.
sql: select 'revenue_sum_matched_customers' as slice, (select sum(m.lifetime_revenue) from model_output m inner join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id) as model_value, (select sum(r.lifetime_revenue) from model_output m inner join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id) as reference_value

description: Sum of lifetime_orders restricted to customer_ids present in both tables, isolating value errors from coverage gaps.
sql: select 'orders_sum_matched_customers' as slice, (select sum(m.lifetime_orders) from model_output m inner join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id) as model_value, (select sum(r.lifetime_orders) from model_output m inner join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id) as reference_value

description: Count of customers with non-positive lifetime_revenue, an implausible edge case worth flagging if counts differ.
sql: select 'zero_or_negative_revenue_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_revenue <= 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_revenue <= 0) as reference_value

description: Count of customers with a null first_order_date or last_order_date.
sql: select 'null_date_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where first_order_date is null or last_order_date is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where first_order_date is null or last_order_date is null) as reference_value

description: Count of customers where first_order_date is after last_order_date, an internal-consistency edge case.
sql: select 'first_after_last_date_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where first_order_date > last_order_date) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where first_order_date > last_order_date) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of lifetime_revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', first_order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', first_order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Compares total row (customer) counts between model and reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Revenue-weighted average order value across the whole book (sum revenue / sum orders), exposing per-customer averaging errors.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output)/(select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output)/(select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Unweighted mean of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost; sensitive to null-handling differences for customers with no item records.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Order-weighted average supply cost (weighted by lifetime_orders) to expose weighting/fan-out discrepancies.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders) from model_output)/(select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_supply_cost*lifetime_orders) from reference_output)/(select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Distinct customer_id counts in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_count' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_id) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_id) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Lists customer_ids present in only one of the two tables.
sql: with m as (select distinct customer_id from model_output), r as (select distinct customer_id from reference_output) select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, case when m.customer_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.customer_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_id is null or r.customer_id is null

description: Per-customer lifetime_revenue comparison via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer lifetime_orders comparison via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_orders::double as model_value, r.lifetime_orders::double as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer avg_order_value comparison via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, r.avg_order_value as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer avg_order_supply_cost comparison via full outer join on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost as model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer first_order_date comparison, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', m.first_order_date)::double as model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', r.first_order_date)::double as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Per-customer last_order_date comparison, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', m.last_order_date)::double as model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', r.last_order_date)::double as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by first-order cohort month.
sql: with m as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', first_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', first_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.k, r.k) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.k = r.k order by 1

description: Total lifetime_orders grouped by first-order cohort month.
sql: with m as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', first_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, sum(lifetime_orders) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', first_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, sum(lifetime_orders) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.k, r.k) as slice, m.v::double as model_value, r.v::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.k = r.k order by 1

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by first-order cohort year.
sql: with m as (select strftime(date_trunc('year', first_order_date), '%Y') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(date_trunc('year', first_order_date), '%Y') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.k, r.k) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.k = r.k order by 1

description: Count of customers acquired (first order) per month.
sql: with m as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', first_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', first_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.k, r.k) as slice, m.v::double as model_value, r.v::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.k = r.k order by 1

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by last-order (recency) month.
sql: with m as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', last_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', last_order_date), '%Y-%m') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.k, r.k) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.k = r.k order by 1

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by first-order week to check week-boundary handling.
sql: with m as (select strftime(date_trunc('week', first_order_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(date_trunc('week', first_order_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.k, r.k) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.k = r.k order by 1

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by first-order cohort quarter.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as k, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.k, r.k) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.k = r.k order by 1

description: Earliest first_order_date in each table (days since epoch).
sql: select 'min_first_order_date' as slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (select min(first_order_date) from model_output))::double as model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (select min(first_order_date) from reference_output))::double as reference_value

description: Latest last_order_date in each table (days since epoch).
sql: select 'max_last_order_date' as slice, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (select max(last_order_date) from model_output))::double as model_value, date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', (select max(last_order_date) from reference_output))::double as reference_value

description: Count of customers with exactly one lifetime order, a boundary case for avg_order_value.
sql: select 'single_order_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1)::double as reference_value

description: Total revenue for single-order customers, where avg_order_value equals lifetime_revenue exactly.
sql: select 'single_order_customers_revenue' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Count of customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost (all qualifying orders lack item records).
sql: select 'null_avg_order_supply_cost' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null)::double as reference_value

description: Count of customers with non-positive lifetime_revenue, which should be rare/impossible if refunds are properly excluded.
sql: select 'negative_or_zero_revenue_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_revenue <= 0)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_revenue <= 0)::double as reference_value

description: Count of customers with zero or negative lifetime_orders, which should not occur given at least one qualifying order is required.
sql: select 'zero_or_negative_orders_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders <= 0)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders <= 0)::double as reference_value

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by lifetime_orders buckets, to expose fan-out/duplication affecting high-order customers.
sql: with m as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.bucket = r.bucket order by 1

description: Count of customers grouped by lifetime_orders buckets, to expose fan-out/duplication affecting order counts.
sql: with m as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) as slice, m.v::double as model_value, r.v::double as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.bucket = r.bucket order by 1

description: Average tenure in days (last_order_date minus first_order_date) across all customers, sensitive to date logic bugs.
sql: select 'avg_tenure_days' as slice, (select avg(date_diff('day', first_order_date, last_order_date)) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(date_diff('day', first_order_date, last_order_date)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the total number of customer rows between model and reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares overall revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) / (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) / (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the overall average of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Lists customer_id keys present in only one of the two tables.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, case when m.customer_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.customer_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_id is null or r.customer_id is null limit 5000

description: Totals of keys found only in model vs only in reference.
sql: select 'count_only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where r.customer_id is null) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'count_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r left join model_output m on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_id is null) as reference_value

description: Checks that customer_id is unique (grain) in each table.
sql: select 'duplicate_customer_ids' as slice, (select count(*) from (select customer_id from model_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1)) as model_value, (select count(*) from (select customer_id from reference_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1)) as reference_value

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_revenue via full outer join.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of lifetime_orders via full outer join.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_orders as model_value, r.lifetime_orders as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_value via full outer join.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, r.avg_order_value as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of avg_order_supply_cost, sensitive to null-vs-zero handling.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost as model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of first_order_date expressed as days since epoch.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', m.first_order_date) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', r.first_order_date) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Per-customer comparison of last_order_date expressed as days since epoch.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', m.last_order_date) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', r.last_order_date) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id limit 5000

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by month of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.grp, r.grp) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.grp = r.grp order by 1

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by month of last_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('month', last_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('month', last_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.grp, r.grp) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.grp = r.grp order by 1

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by week of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.grp, r.grp) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.grp = r.grp order by 1 limit 5000

description: Number of customers whose last_order_date falls on each calendar day.
sql: with m as (select cast(last_order_date as varchar) as grp, count(*) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(last_order_date as varchar) as grp, count(*) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.grp, r.grp) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.grp = r.grp order by 1 limit 5000

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by quarter of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.grp, r.grp) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.grp = r.grp order by 1

description: Total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('year', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.grp, r.grp) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.grp = r.grp order by 1

description: Total lifetime_orders grouped by month of first_order_date.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as grp, sum(lifetime_orders) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.grp, r.grp) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.grp = r.grp order by 1

description: Compares the earliest first_order_date across all customers (as days since epoch).
sql: select 'min_first_order_date' as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select min(first_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select min(first_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Compares the latest last_order_date across all customers (as days since epoch).
sql: select 'max_last_order_date' as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select max(last_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select max(last_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Customer counts bucketed by lifetime_orders to spot distributional shifts.
sql: with m as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select case when lifetime_orders = 1 then '1' when lifetime_orders between 2 and 5 then '2-5' when lifetime_orders between 6 and 10 then '6-10' else '11+' end as bucket, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.bucket, r.bucket) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.bucket = r.bucket

description: Counts customers where avg_order_supply_cost is null, testing exclusion-of-no-item-orders logic.
sql: select 'null_avg_order_supply_cost_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Counts customers where avg_order_supply_cost is exactly zero, a signature of coalesce-to-zero vs exclude-null bugs.
sql: select 'zero_avg_order_supply_cost_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of distinct customer_name values.
sql: select 'distinct_customer_name_count' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_name) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_name) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Counts customers with negative lifetime_revenue, which should not occur after refund exclusion.
sql: select 'negative_lifetime_revenue_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_revenue < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_revenue < 0) as reference_value

description: Counts customers where avg_order_value is null, which should be impossible given at-least-one-order qualification.
sql: select 'null_avg_order_value_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_value is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_value is null) as reference_value

description: Total count of customer rows in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_revenue across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of lifetime_orders across all customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall average of avg_order_value across customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_value) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_value) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall average of avg_order_supply_cost across customers.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_order_supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders) to catch ratio-of-ratios distortions.
sql: select 'weighted_avg_order_value' as slice, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from model_output) / (select sum(lifetime_orders) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(lifetime_revenue) from reference_output) / (select sum(lifetime_orders) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Customer_ids present in only one of the two tables.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, case when r.customer_id is null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when m.customer_id is null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_id is null or r.customer_id is null

description: Checks for duplicate customer_id rows in model_output vs reference_output (grain violation).
sql: select 'duplicate_customer_ids' as slice, (select count(*) from (select customer_id, count(*) c from model_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1)) as model_value, (select count(*) from (select customer_id, count(*) c from reference_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1)) as reference_value

description: Lifetime_revenue per customer, full outer joined on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_revenue as model_value, r.lifetime_revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Lifetime_orders per customer, full outer joined on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.lifetime_orders as model_value, r.lifetime_orders as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Avg_order_value per customer, full outer joined on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_value as model_value, r.avg_order_value as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Avg_order_supply_cost per customer, full outer joined on customer_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, m.avg_order_supply_cost as model_value, r.avg_order_supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: First_order_date per customer, cast to epoch days for numeric comparison.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, epoch(m.first_order_date) as model_value, epoch(r.first_order_date) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Last_order_date per customer, cast to epoch days for numeric comparison.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, epoch(m.last_order_date) as model_value, epoch(r.last_order_date) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id

description: Flags customers where customer_name differs between model and reference (hashed to numeric).
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) as slice, case when m.customer_name is distinct from r.customer_name then 1 else 0 end as model_value, 0 as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.customer_id = r.customer_id where m.customer_name is distinct from r.customer_name

description: Sum of lifetime_revenue grouped by first_order_date (day grain) to expose date-boundary issues.
sql: select coalesce(m.d, r.d) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from (select cast(first_order_date as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select cast(first_order_date as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) r on m.d = r.d

description: Sum of lifetime_revenue grouped by week of first_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(m.d, r.d) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from (select cast(date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select cast(date_trunc('week', first_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) r on m.d = r.d

description: Sum of lifetime_revenue grouped by month of first_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(m.d, r.d) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) r on m.d = r.d

description: Count of customers grouped by month of first_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(m.d, r.d) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as d, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select cast(date_trunc('month', first_order_date) as varchar) as d, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) r on m.d = r.d

description: Sum of lifetime_revenue grouped by quarter of last_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(m.d, r.d) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', last_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', last_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) r on m.d = r.d

description: Sum of lifetime_revenue grouped by year of last_order_date.
sql: select coalesce(m.d, r.d) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from (select cast(date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select cast(date_trunc('year', last_order_date) as varchar) as d, sum(lifetime_revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) r on m.d = r.d

description: Earliest first_order_date observed overall (epoch days).
sql: select 'min_first_order_date' as slice, epoch((select min(first_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, epoch((select min(first_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Latest last_order_date observed overall (epoch days).
sql: select 'max_last_order_date' as slice, epoch((select max(last_order_date) from model_output)) as model_value, epoch((select max(last_order_date) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Count of customers with exactly 1 lifetime order (boundary case for avg calculations).
sql: select 'single_order_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Sum of avg_order_value for single-order customers; should equal their lifetime_revenue sum exactly.
sql: select 'single_order_avg_value_sum' as slice, (select sum(avg_order_value) from model_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as model_value, (select sum(avg_order_value) from reference_output where lifetime_orders = 1) as reference_value

description: Count of customers whose avg_order_supply_cost is exactly zero, a potential sign of coalesce-to-zero vs exclude-null divergence.
sql: select 'zero_supply_cost_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_order_supply_cost = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of customers with null avg_order_supply_cost in each table.
