sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.mo as varchar), cast(r.mo as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compare customer_count aggregated by calendar month (sum of daily distincts).
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(customer_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(customer_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.mo as varchar), cast(r.mo as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compare item_count aggregated by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(item_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(item_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.mo as varchar), cast(r.mo as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compare revenue_gross aggregated by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.mo as varchar), cast(r.mo as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compare avg_items_per_order (weighted by order_count) aggregated by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(avg_items_per_order * order_count) / sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(avg_items_per_order * order_count) / sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.mo as varchar), cast(r.mo as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compare order_count aggregated by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare revenue_gross aggregated by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare order_count aggregated by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Compare revenue_gross aggregated by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Compare order_count on the earliest date present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_date) as d from (select order_date from model_output union all select order_date from reference_output)) select cast(b.d as varchar) as slice, (select order_count from model_output where order_date = b.d) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where order_date = b.d) as reference_value from bounds b

description: Compare order_count on the latest date present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_date) as d from (select order_date from model_output union all select order_date from reference_output)) select cast(b.d as varchar) as slice, (select order_count from model_output where order_date = b.d) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where order_date = b.d) as reference_value from bounds b

description: Compare order_count for the first 3 calendar days to catch week/month boundary truncation or timezone shift issues.
sql: with m as (select order_date, order_count from model_output order by order_date limit 3), r as (select order_date, order_count from reference_output order by order_date limit 3) select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Compare order_count for the last 3 calendar days to catch late-arriving data or boundary truncation issues.
sql: with m as (select order_date, order_count from model_output order by order_date desc limit 3), r as (select order_date, order_count from reference_output order by order_date desc limit 3) select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Compare order_count specifically on the last calendar day of each month, where timezone/date_trunc bugs often surface.
sql: with m as (select order_date, order_count from model_output where order_date = last_day(order_date)), r as (select order_date, order_count from reference_output where order_date = last_day(order_date)) select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Compare order_count specifically on the first calendar day of each month.
sql: with m as (select order_date, order_count from model_output where extract(day from order_date) = 1), r as (select order_date, order_count from reference_output where extract(day from order_date) = 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Compare item_count on days where model's item_count is zero or null, to check null/zero handling for orders with no item records.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.item_count as model_value, r.item_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where coalesce(m.item_count, 0) = 0 or coalesce(r.item_count, 0) = 0 order by 1

description: Compare avg_items_per_order on days where it differs most in magnitude, surfacing null-vs-zero averaging discrepancies (model coalesces null item counts to 0 in the average, which may not match reference's exclude-nulls approach).
sql: select cast(m.order_date as varchar) as slice, m.avg_items_per_order as model_value, r.avg_items_per_order as reference_value from model_output m join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where abs(coalesce(m.avg_items_per_order,0) - coalesce(r.avg_items_per_order,0)) > 0.001 order by abs(coalesce(m.avg_items_per_order,0) - coalesce(r.avg_items_per_order,0)) desc limit 100

description: Compare model's reported avg_items_per_order against an implied ratio of item_count/order_count per day, to detect the null-exclusion vs zero-coalescing discrepancy described in the business definition.
sql: select cast(order_date as varchar) as slice, avg_items_per_order as model_value, case when order_count > 0 then cast(item_count as double) / order_count else null end as reference_value from model_output order by 1

description: Compare reference's reported avg_items_per_order against an implied ratio of item_count/order_count per day.
sql: select cast(order_date as varchar) as slice, case when order_count > 0 then cast(item_count as double) / order_count else null end as model_value, avg_items_per_order as reference_value from reference_output order by 1

description: Compare the ratio of order_count to customer_count per day (detects join fan-out from the refunds left join in the model vs reference).
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, case when m.customer_count > 0 then cast(m.order_count as double) / m.customer_count else null end as model_value, case when r.customer_count > 0 then cast(r.order_count as double) / r.customer_count else null end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Compare average revenue per order per day, which would expose discrepancies in revenue totals or order counts that offset each other.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, case when m.order_count > 0 then m.revenue_gross / m.order_count else null end as model_value, case when r.order_count > 0 then r.revenue_gross / r.order_count else null end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Compare revenue_gross on days where either side reports negative or null revenue, which may indicate refund-exclusion failures.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where m.revenue_gross < 0 or r.revenue_gross < 0 or m.revenue_gross is null or r.revenue_gross is null order by 1

description: Flag days where customer_count exceeds order_count (impossible under business logic; would indicate a data/join bug) on both sides.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, case when m.customer_count > m.order_count then m.order_count else null end as model_value, case when r.customer_count > r.order_count then r.order_count else null end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where m.customer_count > m.order_count or r.customer_count > r.order_count order by 1

description: Identify and compare the single day with the maximum order_count on each side, exposing spikes or data duplication issues.
sql: with m as (select order_date, order_count from model_output order by order_count desc limit 1), r as (select order_date, order_count from reference_output order by order_count desc limit 1) select 'max_day' as slice, (select order_count from m) as model_value, (select order_count from r) as reference_value

description: Compare the count of distinct order_date rows present per calendar year, to detect missing or duplicated days.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Grand total of order_count
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of order_count in the most recent day
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('day', order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest day' as slice,
  (select sum(order_count) from model_output where date_trunc('day', order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where date_trunc('day', order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of order_count in the most recent day
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('day', order_date)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest day' as slice,
  (select sum(order_count) from model_output where date_trunc('day', order_date) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where date_trunc('day', order_date) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Compare total order_count across all dates.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total customer_count across all dates (note: sum of per-day distinct counts, not globally distinct).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(customer_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(customer_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total item_count across all dates.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(item_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(item_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total revenue_gross across all dates.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare overall average of avg_items_per_order weighted by order_count to check ratio distortion.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) from model_output where avg_items_per_order is not null) as model_value, (select sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) from reference_output where avg_items_per_order is not null) as reference_value

description: Compare total number of date rows in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare distinct order_date counts to ensure no duplicate-date rows.
sql: select 'distinct_dates' as slice, (select count(distinct order_date) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_date) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Find dates present in model but missing in reference.
sql: select cast(m.order_date as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where r.order_date is null

description: Find dates present in reference but missing in model.
sql: select cast(r.order_date as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from reference_output r left join model_output m on m.order_date = r.order_date where m.order_date is null

description: Full outer join by day comparing order_count.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Full outer join by day comparing customer_count.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.customer_count as model_value, r.customer_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Full outer join by day comparing item_count.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.item_count as model_value, r.item_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Full outer join by day comparing avg_items_per_order.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.avg_items_per_order as model_value, r.avg_items_per_order as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Full outer join by day comparing revenue_gross.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Weekly aggregated order_count comparison (ISO week start).
sql: with mw as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), rw as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mw.wk, rw.wk) as varchar) as slice, mw.v as model_value, rw.v as reference_value from mw full outer join rw on mw.wk = rw.wk order by 1

description: Weekly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with mw as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), rw as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mw.wk, rw.wk) as varchar) as slice, mw.v as model_value, rw.v as reference_value from mw full outer join rw on mw.wk = rw.wk order by 1

description: Weekly aggregated item_count comparison.
sql: with mw as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(item_count) as v from model_output group by 1), rw as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(item_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mw.wk, rw.wk) as varchar) as slice, mw.v as model_value, rw.v as reference_value from mw full outer join rw on mw.wk = rw.wk order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated order_count comparison.
sql: with mm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), rm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mm.mo, rm.mo) as varchar) as slice, mm.v as model_value, rm.v as reference_value from mm full outer join rm on mm.mo = rm.mo order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated customer_count comparison (sum of daily distincts).
sql: with mm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(customer_count) as v from model_output group by 1), rm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(customer_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mm.mo, rm.mo) as varchar) as slice, mm.v as model_value, rm.v as reference_value from mm full outer join rm on mm.mo = rm.mo order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated item_count comparison.
sql: with mm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(item_count) as v from model_output group by 1), rm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(item_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mm.mo, rm.mo) as varchar) as slice, mm.v as model_value, rm.v as reference_value from mm full outer join rm on mm.mo = rm.mo order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with mm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), rm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mm.mo, rm.mo) as varchar) as slice, mm.v as model_value, rm.v as reference_value from mm full outer join rm on mm.mo = rm.mo order by 1

description: Monthly weighted average of avg_items_per_order (weighted by order_count) comparison.
sql: with mm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) as v from model_output where avg_items_per_order is not null group by 1), rm as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as mo, sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) as v from reference_output where avg_items_per_order is not null group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mm.mo, rm.mo) as varchar) as slice, mm.v as model_value, rm.v as reference_value from mm full outer join rm on mm.mo = rm.mo order by 1

description: Quarterly aggregated order_count comparison.
sql: with mq as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), rq as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mq.q, rq.q) as varchar) as slice, mq.v as model_value, rq.v as reference_value from mq full outer join rq on mq.q = rq.q order by 1

description: Quarterly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with mq as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), rq as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(mq.q, rq.q) as varchar) as slice, mq.v as model_value, rq.v as reference_value from mq full outer join rq on mq.q = rq.q order by 1

description: Yearly aggregated order_count comparison.
sql: with my as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), ry as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(my.y, ry.y) as varchar) as slice, my.v as model_value, ry.v as reference_value from my full outer join ry on my.y = ry.y order by 1

description: Yearly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with my as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), ry as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(my.y, ry.y) as varchar) as slice, my.v as model_value, ry.v as reference_value from my full outer join ry on my.y = ry.y order by 1

description: Compare the earliest order_date present in each table (epoch days for numeric comparison).
sql: select 'first_date' as slice, (select min(order_date) from model_output)::varchar::date - date '1970-01-01' as model_value, (select min(order_date) from reference_output)::varchar::date - date '1970-01-01' as reference_value

description: Compare the latest order_date present in each table (epoch days for numeric comparison).
sql: select 'last_date' as slice, (select max(order_date) from model_output)::varchar::date - date '1970-01-01' as model_value, (select max(order_date) from reference_output)::varchar::date - date '1970-01-01' as reference_value

description: Compare order_count on the earliest common order_date (boundary / timezone shift check).
sql: with mn as (select min(order_date) as d from model_output), rn as (select min(order_date) as d from reference_output) select 'first_day' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where order_date = (select d from mn)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where order_date = (select d from rn)) as reference_value

description: Compare order_count on the latest common order_date (boundary / timezone shift check).
sql: with mx as (select max(order_date) as d from model_output), rx as (select max(order_date) as d from reference_output) select 'last_day' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where order_date = (select d from mx)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where order_date = (select d from rx)) as reference_value

description: Check for days with non-positive order_count in either table (should not exist per grain definition).
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where coalesce(m.order_count,0) <= 0 or coalesce(r.order_count,0) <= 0

description: Flag days where item_count / order_count ratio differs materially between model and reference, signalling fan-out or null handling bugs.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, (m.item_count * 1.0 / nullif(m.order_count,0)) as model_value, (r.item_count * 1.0 / nullif(r.order_count,0)) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Flag days where customer_count exceeds order_count (impossible under business rules) in either table.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, cast(m.customer_count > m.order_count as int) as model_value, cast(r.customer_count > r.order_count as int) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where (m.customer_count > m.order_count) or (r.customer_count > r.order_count)

description: Compare count of days where avg_items_per_order is null between model and reference (edge case for zero-item-record days).
sql: select 'null_avg_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_items_per_order is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_items_per_order is null) as reference_value

description: Cross-check total item_count against sum(avg_items_per_order * order_count) to detect if avg excludes orders differently than sum includes them.
sql: select 'implied_vs_actual_items' as slice, (select sum(avg_items_per_order * order_count) from model_output where avg_items_per_order is not null) as model_value, (select sum(item_count) from model_output) as reference_value

description: Same cross-check as above but run against reference_output alone, to confirm internal consistency used as the baseline.
sql: select 'implied_vs_actual_items_ref' as slice, (select sum(avg_items_per_order * order_count) from reference_output where avg_items_per_order is not null) as model_value, (select sum(item_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total order_count aggregated by day-of-week, to catch systematic timezone/date-boundary shifts (e.g. -8hr offset bug).
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%w') as dow, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%w') as dow, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.dow, r.dow) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.dow = r.dow order by 1

description: Compare total order_count aggregated by calendar month number across all years, to catch seasonal join issues.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%m') as mo, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%m') as mo, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.mo, r.mo) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mo = r.mo order by 1

description: Compare number of distinct dates present per year, to detect missing date coverage in a specific year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as y, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Flag any days with negative revenue_gross in either table (possible sign/refund handling bug).
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where coalesce(m.revenue_gross,0) < 0 or coalesce(r.revenue_gross,0) < 0

description: Compares grand total order_count across all days.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total item_count across all days.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(item_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(item_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total revenue_gross across all days.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares sum of daily distinct customer_count values (consistent proxy across both sides even though it double counts repeat customers).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(customer_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(customer_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares an order_count-weighted overall average items per order.
sql: select 'total_weighted' as slice, (select sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares a simple unweighted mean of daily avg_items_per_order to catch distortions hidden by weighting.
sql: select 'total_unweighted' as slice, (select avg(avg_items_per_order) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_items_per_order) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares total number of day rows present in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Lists dates present in model_output but missing from reference_output.
sql: select cast(m.order_date as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where r.order_date is null

description: Lists dates present in reference_output but missing from model_output.
sql: select cast(r.order_date as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from reference_output r left join model_output m on m.order_date = r.order_date where m.order_date is null

description: Compares the earliest order_date (as epoch seconds) between model and reference to catch timezone shift off-by-one errors.
sql: select 'min_date' as slice, (select cast(epoch(cast(min(order_date) as timestamp)) as bigint) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(epoch(cast(min(order_date) as timestamp)) as bigint) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the latest order_date (as epoch seconds) between model and reference to catch timezone shift off-by-one errors.
sql: select 'max_date' as slice, (select cast(epoch(cast(max(order_date) as timestamp)) as bigint) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(epoch(cast(max(order_date) as timestamp)) as bigint) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares order_count on the earliest and latest calendar day present across either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_date) as min_d, max(order_date) as max_d from (select order_date from model_output union select order_date from reference_output) u) select 'first_day' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where order_date = (select min_d from bounds)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where order_date = (select min_d from bounds)) as reference_value union all select 'last_day' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where order_date = (select max_d from bounds)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where order_date = (select max_d from bounds)) as reference_value

description: Compares revenue_gross on the earliest and latest calendar day present across either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_date) as min_d, max(order_date) as max_d from (select order_date from model_output union select order_date from reference_output) u) select 'first_day' as slice, (select revenue_gross from model_output where order_date = (select min_d from bounds)) as model_value, (select revenue_gross from reference_output where order_date = (select min_d from bounds)) as reference_value union all select 'last_day' as slice, (select revenue_gross from model_output where order_date = (select max_d from bounds)) as model_value, (select revenue_gross from reference_output where order_date = (select max_d from bounds)) as reference_value

description: Compares weekly totals of order_count.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares weekly totals of revenue_gross.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares monthly totals of order_count.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares monthly totals of item_count.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(item_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(item_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares monthly totals of revenue_gross.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares monthly sums of daily distinct customer_count.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(customer_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(customer_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares monthly order_count-weighted average items per order.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(avg_items_per_order*order_count)/sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares quarterly totals of order_count.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares quarterly totals of revenue_gross.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares yearly totals of order_count.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as period, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares yearly totals of revenue_gross.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares total order_count grouped by day of week name to expose weekday boundary shift bugs.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%A') as dow, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%A') as dow, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.dow, r.dow) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.dow = r.dow

description: Compares total revenue_gross grouped by day of week name to expose weekday boundary shift bugs.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%A') as dow, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%A') as dow, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.dow, r.dow) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.dow = r.dow

description: Compares order_count on known US DST transition dates where the -8h timezone shift logic is most likely to break.
sql: with candidates (dt) as (values (date '2023-03-12'), (date '2023-11-05'), (date '2024-03-10'), (date '2024-11-03'), (date '2025-03-09'), (date '2025-11-02'), (date '2026-03-08'), (date '2026-11-01')) select cast(c.dt as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from candidates c left join model_output m on m.order_date = c.dt left join reference_output r on r.order_date = c.dt where m.order_date is not null or r.order_date is not null

description: Compares monthly ratio of total item_count to total order_count, which should differ from avg_items_per_order if orders without item records are miscounted.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(item_count)*1.0/nullif(sum(order_count),0) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(item_count)*1.0/nullif(sum(order_count),0) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares overall average revenue per order.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares monthly ratio of total revenue_gross to total customer_count to expose fan-out or join duplication issues.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/nullif(sum(customer_count),0) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/nullif(sum(customer_count),0) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.period as varchar), cast(r.period as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.period = r.period order by 1

description: Compares count of days with order_count equal to zero in each table.
sql: select 'zero_order_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count = 0) as reference_value

description: Compares count of days with negative revenue_gross, which should not normally occur.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Compares count of days where avg_items_per_order is null, i.e. no orders with item records that day.
sql: select 'null_avg_items_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_items_per_order is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_items_per_order is null) as reference_value

description: Compares count of days where customer_count exceeds order_count, an impossible condition that signals a join fan-out or logic bug.
sql: select 'customer_gt_order_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customer_count > order_count) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customer_count > order_count) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total order_count across all days.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total customer_count across all days.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(customer_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(customer_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total item_count across all days.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(item_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(item_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total revenue_gross across all days.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare number of rows (distinct order_date grain) in each output.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Weighted average items per order computed as total items divided by total orders.
sql: select 'avg_items_per_order_weighted' as slice, (select sum(item_count)*1.0/sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(item_count)*1.0/sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Simple (unweighted) mean of the daily avg_items_per_order column.
sql: select 'avg_items_per_order_simple_mean' as slice, (select avg(avg_items_per_order) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(avg_items_per_order) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall revenue per order ratio.
sql: select 'revenue_per_order' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall items per distinct customer ratio.
sql: select 'items_per_customer' as slice, (select sum(item_count)*1.0/sum(customer_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(item_count)*1.0/sum(customer_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall revenue per distinct customer ratio.
sql: select 'revenue_per_customer' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(customer_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(customer_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Daily order_count comparison for every calendar day present on either side.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Daily revenue_gross comparison for every calendar day present on either side.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Daily customer_count comparison for every calendar day present on either side.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.customer_count as model_value, r.customer_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Daily item_count comparison for every calendar day present on either side.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.item_count as model_value, r.item_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Daily avg_items_per_order comparison for every calendar day present on either side.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_date as varchar), cast(r.order_date as varchar)) as slice, m.avg_items_per_order as model_value, r.avg_items_per_order as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date order by 1

description: Weekly aggregated order_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.wk as varchar), cast(r.wk as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.wk = r.wk order by 1

description: Weekly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.wk as varchar), cast(r.wk as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.wk = r.wk order by 1

description: Weekly aggregated (summed) customer_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(customer_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(customer_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.wk as varchar), cast(r.wk as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.wk = r.wk order by 1

description: Weekly aggregated item_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(item_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('week', order_date) as wk, sum(item_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.wk as varchar), cast(r.wk as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.wk = r.wk order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated order_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mth = r.mth order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mth = r.mth order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated (summed) customer_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(customer_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(customer_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mth = r.mth order by 1

description: Monthly aggregated item_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(item_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(item_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mth = r.mth order by 1

description: Monthly weighted avg items per order (sum items / sum orders) comparison.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(item_count) as items, sum(order_count) as orders from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(item_count) as items, sum(order_count) as orders from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, case when m.orders > 0 then m.items*1.0/m.orders end as model_value, case when r.orders > 0 then r.items*1.0/r.orders end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.mth = r.mth order by 1

description: Quarterly aggregated order_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Quarterly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Yearly aggregated order_count comparison.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y') as yr, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y') as yr, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Yearly aggregated revenue_gross comparison.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y') as yr, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%Y') as yr, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Order_count summed by day-of-week, to detect shifted weekday boundaries from timezone handling differences.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%w') as dow, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%w') as dow, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.dow, r.dow) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.dow = r.dow order by 1

description: Revenue_gross summed by day-of-week, to detect shifted weekday boundaries from timezone handling differences.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_date, '%w') as dow, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_date, '%w') as dow, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.dow, r.dow) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.dow = r.dow order by 1

description: Order_count on the earliest date seen in either table (timezone boundary edge check).
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_date) as d from (select order_date from model_output union select order_date from reference_output)) select 'first_date_order_count' as slice, (select order_count from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_date = bounds.d) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_date = bounds.d) as reference_value

description: Order_count on the latest date seen in either table (timezone boundary edge check).
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_date) as d from (select order_date from model_output union select order_date from reference_output)) select 'last_date_order_count' as slice, (select order_count from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_date = bounds.d) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_date = bounds.d) as reference_value

description: Revenue_gross on the earliest date seen in either table (timezone boundary edge check).
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_date) as d from (select order_date from model_output union select order_date from reference_output)) select 'first_date_revenue' as slice, (select revenue_gross from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_date = bounds.d) as model_value, (select revenue_gross from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_date = bounds.d) as reference_value

description: Revenue_gross on the latest date seen in either table (timezone boundary edge check).
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_date) as d from (select order_date from model_output union select order_date from reference_output)) select 'last_date_revenue' as slice, (select revenue_gross from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_date = bounds.d) as model_value, (select revenue_gross from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_date = bounds.d) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_date keys present in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_date_count' as slice, (select count(distinct order_date) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_date) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Lists every order_date that exists on only one side of the join, showing NULL on the missing side.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.order_date, r.order_date) as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_date = r.order_date where m.order_date is null or r.order_date is null order by 1

description: Count of days where avg_items_per_order is null (no orders with item records that day).
sql: select 'null_avg_items_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where avg_items_per_order is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where avg_items_per_order is null) as reference_value

description: Count of days where customer_count exceeds order_count, which should be impossible and signals a join fan-out bug.
sql: select 'customer_count_gt_order_count_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customer_count > order_count) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customer_count > order_count) as reference_value

description: Count of days with negative revenue_gross, which should not occur after excluding refunds.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_days' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of days where item_count is zero despite having qualifying orders, a signal of item-join issues.
sql: select 'item_count_zero_but_orders_positive' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where item_count = 0 and order_count > 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where item_count = 0 and order_count > 0) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of active_customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', activity_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of active_customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', activity_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers summed across all months.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT sum(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT sum(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all months.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Total number of rows (months) in each output.
sql: SELECT 'row_count' AS slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Checks for months present only in model, only in reference, and total distinct month counts.
sql: SELECT 'months_only_in_model' AS slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output m LEFT JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month WHERE r.activity_month IS NULL) AS model_value, 0 AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'months_only_in_reference' AS slice, 0 AS model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output r LEFT JOIN model_output m ON r.activity_month = m.activity_month WHERE m.activity_month IS NULL) AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_month_count' AS slice, (SELECT count(DISTINCT activity_month) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT count(DISTINCT activity_month) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Active customers per month, full outer joined so missing months on either side surface as NULL.
sql: SELECT coalesce(cast(m.activity_month AS varchar), cast(r.activity_month AS varchar)) AS slice, m.active_customers AS model_value, r.active_customers AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: Order count per month, full outer joined so missing months on either side surface as NULL.
sql: SELECT coalesce(cast(m.activity_month AS varchar), cast(r.activity_month AS varchar)) AS slice, m.order_count AS model_value, r.order_count AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: Stored orders_per_active_customer per month, full outer joined so missing months on either side surface as NULL.
sql: SELECT coalesce(cast(m.activity_month AS varchar), cast(r.activity_month AS varchar)) AS slice, m.orders_per_active_customer AS model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: Active customers summed by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS q, sum(active_customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS q, sum(active_customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(cast(m.q AS varchar), cast(r.q AS varchar)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q ORDER BY 1

description: Order count summed by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS q, sum(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS q, sum(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(cast(m.q AS varchar), cast(r.q AS varchar)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q ORDER BY 1

description: Active customers summed by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS y, sum(active_customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS y, sum(active_customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(cast(m.y AS varchar), cast(r.y AS varchar)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.y = r.y ORDER BY 1

description: Order count summed by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS y, sum(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS y, sum(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(cast(m.y AS varchar), cast(r.y AS varchar)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.y = r.y ORDER BY 1

description: Active customers in the earliest activity_month on each side.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT active_customers FROM model_output ORDER BY activity_month ASC LIMIT 1) AS model_value, (SELECT active_customers FROM reference_output ORDER BY activity_month ASC LIMIT 1) AS reference_value

description: Order count in the earliest activity_month on each side.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT order_count FROM model_output ORDER BY activity_month ASC LIMIT 1) AS model_value, (SELECT order_count FROM reference_output ORDER BY activity_month ASC LIMIT 1) AS reference_value

description: Active customers in the latest activity_month on each side.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT active_customers FROM model_output ORDER BY activity_month DESC LIMIT 1) AS model_value, (SELECT active_customers FROM reference_output ORDER BY activity_month DESC LIMIT 1) AS reference_value

description: Order count in the latest activity_month on each side.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT order_count FROM model_output ORDER BY activity_month DESC LIMIT 1) AS model_value, (SELECT order_count FROM reference_output ORDER BY activity_month DESC LIMIT 1) AS reference_value

description: Stored orders_per_active_customer in the latest activity_month on each side.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_orders_per_active_customer' AS slice, (SELECT orders_per_active_customer FROM model_output ORDER BY activity_month DESC LIMIT 1) AS model_value, (SELECT orders_per_active_customer FROM reference_output ORDER BY activity_month DESC LIMIT 1) AS reference_value

description: Peak active_customers value across all months.
sql: SELECT 'max_active_customers_any_month' AS slice, (SELECT max(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT max(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Minimum active_customers value across all months.
sql: SELECT 'min_active_customers_any_month' AS slice, (SELECT min(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT min(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Count of months where orders_per_active_customer is NULL, which could indicate divide-by-zero or join issues.
sql: SELECT 'null_orders_per_active_customer_count' AS slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE orders_per_active_customer IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE orders_per_active_customer IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Count of months with zero active_customers, an edge case that could cause ratio distortion.
sql: SELECT 'zero_active_customers_months' AS slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE active_customers = 0) AS model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE active_customers = 0) AS reference_value

description: Population standard deviation of active_customers across months, to catch distributional shape differences.
sql: SELECT 'stddev_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT stddev_pop(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT stddev_pop(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Simple (unweighted) average of the monthly orders_per_active_customer ratio across all months.
sql: SELECT 'avg_orders_per_active_customer_unweighted' AS slice, (SELECT avg(orders_per_active_customer) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT avg(orders_per_active_customer) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Overall ratio of total order_count to total active_customers across all months, distinct from the average of per-month ratios.
sql: SELECT 'overall_ratio_sum_orders_over_sum_active' AS slice, (SELECT sum(order_count)::double / NULLIF(sum(active_customers),0) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT sum(order_count)::double / NULLIF(sum(active_customers),0) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Internal consistency check: model's stored orders_per_active_customer vs order_count/active_customers recomputed from the same model row.
sql: SELECT cast(activity_month AS varchar) AS slice, orders_per_active_customer AS model_value, cast(order_count AS double) / NULLIF(active_customers,0) AS reference_value FROM model_output ORDER BY 1

description: Internal consistency check: reference's stored orders_per_active_customer vs order_count/active_customers recomputed from the same reference row.
sql: SELECT cast(activity_month AS varchar) AS slice, orders_per_active_customer AS model_value, cast(order_count AS double) / NULLIF(active_customers,0) AS reference_value FROM reference_output ORDER BY 1

description: Count of months where order_count exactly equals active_customers (ratio of 1), to spot fan-out or dedup issues.
sql: SELECT 'months_order_count_eq_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE order_count = active_customers) AS model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE order_count = active_customers) AS reference_value

description: Sum of active_customers over the most recent 12 calendar months, to catch issues isolated to recent data.
sql: SELECT 'last_12_months_active_customers_total' AS slice, (SELECT sum(active_customers) FROM model_output WHERE activity_month >= date '2025-10-01') AS model_value, (SELECT sum(active_customers) FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month >= date '2025-10-01') AS reference_value

description: Sum of order_count over the most recent 12 calendar months, to catch issues isolated to recent data.
sql: SELECT 'last_12_months_order_count_total' AS slice, (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM model_output WHERE activity_month >= date '2025-10-01') AS model_value, (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month >= date '2025-10-01') AS reference_value

description: Count of months with negative active_customers or order_count, which should never occur.
sql: SELECT 'negative_active_customers_or_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE active_customers < 0 OR order_count < 0) AS model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE active_customers < 0 OR order_count < 0) AS reference_value

description: Count of months with zero order_count but positive active_customers, an internal inconsistency that should not occur in either source.
sql: SELECT 'order_count_zero_active_customers_positive' AS slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE order_count = 0 AND active_customers > 0) AS model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE order_count = 0 AND active_customers > 0) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers summed across all months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall ratio recomputed as total order_count divided by total active_customers, avoiding averaging distortion.
sql: select 'total_weighted_ratio' as slice, (select cast(sum(order_count) as double)/sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(sum(order_count) as double)/sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows (months) in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct activity_month keys in each table, checking for duplicate or missing keys.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select count(distinct activity_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Full outer join on activity_month to flag months present on only one side (NULL indicates missing).
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, case when m.activity_month is not null then 1 end as model_value, case when r.activity_month is not null then 1 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Summary counts of months only in model, only in reference, and in both.
sql: with m as (select activity_month from model_output), r as (select activity_month from reference_output) select 'only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from m where activity_month not in (select activity_month from r)) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from r where activity_month not in (select activity_month from m)) as reference_value union all select 'in_both' as slice, (select count(*) from m where activity_month in (select activity_month from r)) as model_value, (select count(*) from r where activity_month in (select activity_month from m)) as reference_value

description: active_customers per calendar month, model vs reference, full outer joined.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: order_count per calendar month, model vs reference, full outer joined.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: orders_per_active_customer per calendar month, model vs reference, full outer joined.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.orders_per_active_customer as model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: active_customers summed by calendar quarter, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: order_count summed by calendar quarter, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Ratio recomputed per calendar quarter as total order_count divided by total active_customers within the quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, cast(sum(order_count) as double) / sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, cast(sum(order_count) as double) / sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: active_customers summed by calendar year, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: order_count summed by calendar year, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Ratio recomputed per calendar year as total order_count divided by total active_customers within the year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, cast(sum(order_count) as double) / sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, cast(sum(order_count) as double) / sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: active_customers in the earliest available month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'first_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as reference_value

description: active_customers in the latest available month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'last_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as reference_value

description: order_count in the earliest available month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'first_month' as slice, (select order_count from model_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as reference_value

description: order_count in the latest available month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'last_month' as slice, (select order_count from model_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as reference_value

description: orders_per_active_customer in the earliest available month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'first_month' as slice, (select orders_per_active_customer from model_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as model_value, (select orders_per_active_customer from reference_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as reference_value

description: orders_per_active_customer in the latest available month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'last_month' as slice, (select orders_per_active_customer from model_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as model_value, (select orders_per_active_customer from reference_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as reference_value

description: Simple unweighted average of orders_per_active_customer across months, to detect weighting/averaging discrepancies versus the weighted total.
sql: select 'avg_ratio_unweighted' as slice, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of months where orders_per_active_customer is null or active_customers is zero, indicating potential division-by-zero handling differences.
