sql: select 'null_or_zero_ratio_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where orders_per_active_customer is null or active_customers = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where orders_per_active_customer is null or active_customers = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of months with negative active_customers, a data quality impossibility that should be zero on both sides.
sql: select 'negative_active_customers_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of months with negative order_count, a data quality impossibility that should be zero on both sides.
sql: select 'negative_order_count_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of months where order_count is less than active_customers, which should be impossible since each active customer has at least one qualifying order.
sql: select 'order_count_lt_active_customers_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count < active_customers) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count < active_customers) as reference_value

description: Maximum active_customers value across all months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'max_active_customers_value' as slice, (select max(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Minimum active_customers value across all months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'min_active_customers_value' as slice, (select min(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall weighted orders-per-active-customer ratio (sum order_count / sum active_customers) to avoid distortion from averaging monthly ratios.
sql: select 'total_weighted_ratio' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output)::double / (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output)::double / (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows (months) in each output.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Presence flag (1/0) per month to expose months that exist only in one side.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, case when m.activity_month is null then 0 else 1 end as model_value, case when r.activity_month is null then 0 else 1 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: active_customers compared per calendar month.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: order_count compared per calendar month.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: orders_per_active_customer compared per calendar month using the stored ratio field.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, m.orders_per_active_customer as model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: active_customers totals rolled up to quarter grain.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: order_count totals rolled up to quarter grain.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Weighted orders-per-active-customer ratio rolled up to quarter grain.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count)::double / sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count)::double / sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: active_customers totals rolled up to year grain.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from activity_month) as yr, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from activity_month) as yr, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: order_count totals rolled up to year grain.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from activity_month) as yr, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from activity_month) as yr, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Weighted orders-per-active-customer ratio rolled up to year grain.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from activity_month) as yr, sum(order_count)::double / sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from activity_month) as yr, sum(order_count)::double / sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: active_customers for the earliest activity_month in each output (boundary check).
sql: select 'first_month_active_customers' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as reference_value

description: order_count for the earliest activity_month in each output (boundary check).
sql: select 'first_month_order_count' as slice, (select order_count from model_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output order by activity_month asc limit 1) as reference_value

description: active_customers for the latest (most recent, possibly partial) activity_month in each output.
sql: select 'last_month_active_customers' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as reference_value

description: order_count for the latest (most recent, possibly partial) activity_month in each output.
sql: select 'last_month_order_count' as slice, (select order_count from model_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output order by activity_month desc limit 1) as reference_value

description: Minimum active_customers value seen across all months, checking low-end outliers.
sql: select 'min_active_customers' as slice, (select min(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Maximum active_customers value seen across all months, checking peak-month outliers.
sql: select 'max_active_customers' as slice, (select max(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Unweighted average of active_customers across months (sensitive to missing/extra month rows).
sql: select 'avg_active_customers_per_month' as slice, (select avg(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Unweighted average of order_count across months (sensitive to missing/extra month rows).
sql: select 'avg_order_count_per_month' as slice, (select avg(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Sum of the per-month orders_per_active_customer ratio field (unweighted), exposing distortion if the ratio column itself is miscomputed.
sql: select 'sum_orders_per_active_customer_unweighted' as slice, (select sum(orders_per_active_customer) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(orders_per_active_customer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where orders_per_active_customer is null, which would indicate a divide-by-zero or join issue.
sql: select 'null_ratio_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where orders_per_active_customer is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where orders_per_active_customer is null) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where active_customers equals zero, which is logically invalid for an active month.
sql: select 'zero_active_customers_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct activity_month values present in each output.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct activity_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where order_count is less than active_customers, which is logically impossible since every active customer needs at least one order.
sql: select 'order_count_lt_active_customers_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count < active_customers) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count < active_customers) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where the stored orders_per_active_customer disagrees with order_count/active_customers recomputed from the same row, flagging internal calculation drift.
sql: select 'ratio_mismatch_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers > 0 and abs(orders_per_active_customer - order_count * 1.0 / active_customers) > 0.0001) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers > 0 and abs(orders_per_active_customer - order_count * 1.0 / active_customers) > 0.0001) as reference_value

description: Counts of months that exist only in model_output versus only in reference_output, exposing key coverage gaps.
sql: select 'only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m where not exists (select 1 from reference_output r where r.activity_month = m.activity_month)) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r where not exists (select 1 from model_output m where m.activity_month = r.activity_month)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of active_customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', activity_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of active_customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', activity_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Simple (unweighted) average of the monthly orders_per_active_customer ratio.
sql: select 'avg_simple' as slice, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Weighted average ratio computed as total order_count divided by total active_customers.
sql: select 'weighted_avg' as slice, (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows (months) in each output.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct activity_month values in each output.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select count(distinct activity_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Lists any activity_month keys present on only one side as a presence flag (1/0).
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, case when m.activity_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.activity_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month where m.activity_month is null or r.activity_month is null

description: active_customers compared for every activity_month, full outer joined.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: order_count compared for every activity_month, full outer joined.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: orders_per_active_customer compared for every activity_month, full outer joined.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.orders_per_active_customer as model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: active_customers in the earliest activity_month observed across both outputs.
sql: with first_month as (select min(activity_month) as mn from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output where activity_month = (select mn from first_month)) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output where activity_month = (select mn from first_month)) as reference_value

description: active_customers in the latest activity_month observed across both outputs.
sql: with last_month as (select max(activity_month) as mx from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'last_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output where activity_month = (select mx from last_month)) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output where activity_month = (select mx from last_month)) as reference_value

description: order_count in the earliest activity_month observed across both outputs.
sql: with first_month as (select min(activity_month) as mn from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where activity_month = (select mn from first_month)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where activity_month = (select mn from first_month)) as reference_value

description: order_count in the latest activity_month observed across both outputs.
sql: with last_month as (select max(activity_month) as mx from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'last_month' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where activity_month = (select mx from last_month)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where activity_month = (select mx from last_month)) as reference_value

description: Sum of active_customers grouped by calendar year.
sql: select cast(date_trunc('year', coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month)) as varchar) as slice, sum(m.active_customers) as model_value, sum(r.active_customers) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month group by 1 order by 1

description: Sum of order_count grouped by calendar year.
sql: select cast(date_trunc('year', coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month)) as varchar) as slice, sum(m.order_count) as model_value, sum(r.order_count) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month group by 1 order by 1

description: Weighted average orders_per_active_customer (sum order_count / sum active_customers) grouped by year.
sql: select cast(date_trunc('year', coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month)) as varchar) as slice, sum(m.order_count)*1.0/sum(m.active_customers) as model_value, sum(r.order_count)*1.0/sum(r.active_customers) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month group by 1 order by 1

description: Sum of active_customers grouped by calendar quarter.
sql: select cast(date_trunc('quarter', coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month)) as varchar) as slice, sum(m.active_customers) as model_value, sum(r.active_customers) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month group by 1 order by 1

description: Sum of order_count grouped by calendar quarter.
sql: select cast(date_trunc('quarter', coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month)) as varchar) as slice, sum(m.order_count) as model_value, sum(r.order_count) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month group by 1 order by 1

description: Weighted average orders_per_active_customer grouped by calendar quarter.
sql: select cast(date_trunc('quarter', coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month)) as varchar) as slice, sum(m.order_count)*1.0/sum(m.active_customers) as model_value, sum(r.order_count)*1.0/sum(r.active_customers) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month group by 1 order by 1

description: At the month where model_output reports its maximum active_customers, compare both sides' value.
sql: with model_peak as (select activity_month from model_output order by active_customers desc limit 1) select 'model_peak_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output where activity_month = (select activity_month from model_peak)) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output where activity_month = (select activity_month from model_peak)) as reference_value

description: At the month where model_output reports its minimum active_customers, compare both sides' value.
sql: with model_trough as (select activity_month from model_output order by active_customers asc limit 1) select 'model_trough_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output where activity_month = (select activity_month from model_trough)) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output where activity_month = (select activity_month from model_trough)) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where active_customers is null in each output.
sql: select 'null_active_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers is null) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where order_count is null in each output.
sql: select 'null_order_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count is null) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where orders_per_active_customer is null in each output.
sql: select 'null_ratio' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where orders_per_active_customer is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where orders_per_active_customer is null) as reference_value

description: Count of months where active_customers equals zero in each output.
sql: select 'zero_active_customers_months' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative active_customers or order_count in each output.
sql: select 'negative_values' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers < 0 or order_count < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers < 0 or order_count < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of months where the stored orders_per_active_customer disagrees with order_count/active_customers recomputed from the same table, exposing fan-out or stale ratio issues.
sql: select 'ratio_mismatch_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers > 0 and abs(orders_per_active_customer - order_count*1.0/active_customers) > 0.0001) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers > 0 and abs(orders_per_active_customer - order_count*1.0/active_customers) > 0.0001) as reference_value

description: Checks for duplicate activity_month rows (grain violation) in each output.
sql: select 'duplicate_month_keys' as slice, (select count(*) - count(distinct activity_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) - count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Population standard deviation of active_customers across all months, sensitive to distributional shifts not caught by sums.
sql: select 'stddev_active_customers' as slice, (select stddev_pop(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select stddev_pop(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Median active_customers across all months, robust to outlier months.
sql: select 'median_active_customers' as slice, (select median(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select median(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of months with order_count > 0 but active_customers = 0, an impossible state indicating a join or filter bug.
sql: select 'orders_without_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count > 0 and active_customers = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count > 0 and active_customers = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of months with active_customers > 0 but order_count = 0, an impossible state given the business definition.
sql: select 'customers_without_orders' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers > 0 and order_count = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers > 0 and order_count = 0) as reference_value

description: active_customers for the current (possibly partial) month, 2026-10, which is prone to incomplete-data discrepancies.
sql: select 'current_month_2026_10' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output where activity_month = date '2026-10-01') as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output where activity_month = date '2026-10-01') as reference_value

description: order_count for the current (possibly partial) month, 2026-10.
sql: select 'current_month_2026_10' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where activity_month = date '2026-10-01') as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where activity_month = date '2026-10-01') as reference_value

description: Sum of active_customers over the trailing 12 months ending at the latest available month, a common dashboard window.
sql: with last_month as (select max(activity_month) as mx from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'trailing_12m_active_customers_sum' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where activity_month > (select mx from last_month) - interval '12 months') as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where activity_month > (select mx from last_month) - interval '12 months') as reference_value

description: Sum of order_count over the trailing 12 months ending at the latest available month.
sql: with last_month as (select max(activity_month) as mx from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'trailing_12m_order_count_sum' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output where activity_month > (select mx from last_month) - interval '12 months') as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where activity_month > (select mx from last_month) - interval '12 months') as reference_value

description: Weighted orders_per_active_customer over the trailing 12 months ending at the latest available month.
sql: with last_month as (select max(activity_month) as mx from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'trailing_12m_weighted_ratio' as slice, (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(active_customers) from model_output where activity_month > (select mx from last_month) - interval '12 months') as model_value, (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(active_customers) from reference_output where activity_month > (select mx from last_month) - interval '12 months') as reference_value

description: At the month where model_output reports its maximum order_count, compare both sides' value.
sql: with model_peak as (select activity_month from model_output order by order_count desc limit 1) select 'model_peak_order_month' as slice, (select order_count from model_output where activity_month = (select activity_month from model_peak)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where activity_month = (select activity_month from model_peak)) as reference_value

description: Count of months whose orders_per_active_customer exceeds that table's own overall average, a shape check on the ratio distribution.
sql: select 'months_above_avg_ratio' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where orders_per_active_customer > (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from model_output)) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where orders_per_active_customer > (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers across all months.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count across all months.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Overall weighted ratio (sum order_count / sum active_customers) across all months.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count)::DOUBLE / SUM(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count)::DOUBLE / SUM(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Total number of rows (months) in each output.
sql: SELECT 'row_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: active_customers per calendar month, full outer joined on month.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.active_customers AS model_value, r.active_customers AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: order_count per calendar month, full outer joined on month.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.order_count AS model_value, r.order_count AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: orders_per_active_customer per calendar month, full outer joined on month.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.orders_per_active_customer AS model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: active_customers summed by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS yr, SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS yr, SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.yr AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.yr AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr ORDER BY 1

description: order_count summed by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS yr, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS yr, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.yr AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.yr AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr ORDER BY 1

description: Weighted orders_per_active_customer (sum order_count / sum active_customers) by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS yr, SUM(order_count)::DOUBLE / SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', activity_month) AS yr, SUM(order_count)::DOUBLE / SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.yr AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.yr AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr ORDER BY 1

description: active_customers summed by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS qtr, SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS qtr, SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.qtr AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.qtr AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.qtr = r.qtr ORDER BY 1

description: order_count summed by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS qtr, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS qtr, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.qtr AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.qtr AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.qtr = r.qtr ORDER BY 1

description: Weighted orders_per_active_customer by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS qtr, SUM(order_count)::DOUBLE / SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) AS qtr, SUM(order_count)::DOUBLE / SUM(active_customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.qtr AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.qtr AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.qtr = r.qtr ORDER BY 1

description: Count of activity_month keys present in model_output but missing from reference_output.
sql: SELECT 'months_only_in_model' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output m LEFT JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month WHERE r.activity_month IS NULL) AS model_value, 0 AS reference_value

description: Count of activity_month keys present in reference_output but missing from model_output.
sql: SELECT 'months_only_in_reference' AS slice, 0 AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output r LEFT JOIN model_output m ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month WHERE m.activity_month IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Count of distinct activity_month values in each output (grain/coverage check).
sql: SELECT 'distinct_months' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT activity_month) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT activity_month) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: active_customers in the earliest month of each respective output.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT active_customers FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT active_customers FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: active_customers in the latest month of each respective output.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT active_customers FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT active_customers FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: order_count in the earliest month of each respective output.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT order_count FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT order_count FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: order_count in the latest month of each respective output.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT order_count FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT order_count FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: orders_per_active_customer in the earliest month of each respective output.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_ratio' AS slice, (SELECT orders_per_active_customer FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT orders_per_active_customer FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: orders_per_active_customer in the latest month of each respective output.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_ratio' AS slice, (SELECT orders_per_active_customer FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT orders_per_active_customer FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: Earliest activity_month in each output, expressed as days since epoch, to catch boundary/truncation mismatches.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_date_days_since_epoch' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM model_output) - DATE '1970-01-01' AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM reference_output) - DATE '1970-01-01' AS reference_value

description: Latest activity_month in each output, expressed as days since epoch, to catch boundary/truncation mismatches.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_date_days_since_epoch' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output) - DATE '1970-01-01' AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output) - DATE '1970-01-01' AS reference_value

description: Simple unweighted average of orders_per_active_customer across all months.
sql: SELECT 'avg_ratio_unweighted' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(orders_per_active_customer) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(orders_per_active_customer) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Maximum single-month active_customers value in each output.
sql: SELECT 'max_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Minimum single-month active_customers value in each output.
sql: SELECT 'min_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Maximum single-month order_count value in each output.
sql: SELECT 'max_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Minimum single-month order_count value in each output.
sql: SELECT 'min_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(order_count) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(order_count) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Maximum single-month orders_per_active_customer value in each output.
sql: SELECT 'max_ratio' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(orders_per_active_customer) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(orders_per_active_customer) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Minimum single-month orders_per_active_customer value in each output.
sql: SELECT 'min_ratio' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(orders_per_active_customer) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(orders_per_active_customer) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Sum of active_customers over the trailing 12 months from the latest available month across both outputs.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT GREATEST((SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output), (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS maxd) SELECT 'last_12_months_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(active_customers) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > maxd - INTERVAL '12 months') AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(active_customers) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > maxd - INTERVAL '12 months') AS reference_value

description: Sum of order_count over the trailing 12 months from the latest available month across both outputs.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT GREATEST((SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output), (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS maxd) SELECT 'last_12_months_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > maxd - INTERVAL '12 months') AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > maxd - INTERVAL '12 months') AS reference_value

description: Count of rows where orders_per_active_customer is NULL, which could indicate divide-by-zero or join issues.
sql: SELECT 'null_ratio_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE orders_per_active_customer IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE orders_per_active_customer IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Count of rows where active_customers is zero, which should not occur given the model's inner joins.
sql: SELECT 'zero_active_customers_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE active_customers = 0) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE active_customers = 0) AS reference_value

description: Sum of active_customers * orders_per_active_customer in each output, to detect rounding or fan-out distortions in the ratio column.
sql: SELECT 'recomputed_order_count_from_ratio' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(active_customers * orders_per_active_customer) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(active_customers * orders_per_active_customer) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Weighted overall ratio of total order_count to total active_customers across all months.
sql: select 'total_ratio_weighted' as slice, (select sum(order_count)::double / nullif(sum(active_customers),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count)::double / nullif(sum(active_customers),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows (months) in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Count of distinct activity_month values in each table, to catch duplicate-month rows.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct activity_month) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: active_customers for every calendar month, full outer joined so missing months on either side surface as NULL.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by slice

description: order_count for every calendar month, full outer joined so missing months on either side surface as NULL.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by slice

description: orders_per_active_customer for every calendar month, full outer joined so missing months on either side surface as NULL.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.orders_per_active_customer as model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by slice

description: active_customers for the earliest activity_month observed across both tables.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select min(activity_month) as fm from all_months) select 'first_month:' || cast((select fm from bounds) as varchar) as slice, (select active_customers from model_output where activity_month = (select fm from bounds)) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output where activity_month = (select fm from bounds)) as reference_value

description: order_count for the earliest activity_month observed across both tables.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select min(activity_month) as fm from all_months) select 'first_month:' || cast((select fm from bounds) as varchar) as slice, (select order_count from model_output where activity_month = (select fm from bounds)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where activity_month = (select fm from bounds)) as reference_value

description: active_customers for the latest activity_month observed across both tables.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select max(activity_month) as lm from all_months) select 'last_month:' || cast((select lm from bounds) as varchar) as slice, (select active_customers from model_output where activity_month = (select lm from bounds)) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output where activity_month = (select lm from bounds)) as reference_value

description: order_count for the latest activity_month observed across both tables.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select max(activity_month) as lm from all_months) select 'last_month:' || cast((select lm from bounds) as varchar) as slice, (select order_count from model_output where activity_month = (select lm from bounds)) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output where activity_month = (select lm from bounds)) as reference_value

description: Count of months present only in model_output and only in reference_output.
sql: select 'only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month where r.activity_month is null)::double as model_value, 0.0 as reference_value union all select 'only_in_reference' as slice, 0.0 as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r left join model_output m on r.activity_month = m.activity_month where m.activity_month is null)::double as reference_value

description: Lists each specific month missing from either model_output or reference_output along with the active_customers value on the present side.
sql: select 'missing_in_reference: ' || cast(m.activity_month as varchar) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, cast(null as bigint) as reference_value from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month where r.activity_month is null union all select 'missing_in_model: ' || cast(r.activity_month as varchar) as slice, cast(null as bigint) as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from reference_output r left join model_output m on r.activity_month = m.activity_month where m.activity_month is null

description: active_customers summed up to quarterly grain for each calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by slice

description: order_count summed up to quarterly grain for each calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by slice

description: active_customers summed up to yearly grain for each calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by slice

description: order_count summed up to yearly grain for each calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by slice

description: Simple (unweighted) average of active_customers across all months.
sql: select 'avg_active_customers_per_month' as slice, (select avg(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Simple (unweighted) average of order_count across all months.
sql: select 'avg_order_count_per_month' as slice, (select avg(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Simple (unweighted) average of the per-month orders_per_active_customer ratio.
sql: select 'avg_orders_per_active_customer_simple' as slice, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Maximum single-month active_customers value, a boundary/outlier check.
sql: select 'max_active_customers' as slice, (select max(active_customers) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select max(active_customers) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Minimum single-month active_customers value, a boundary/outlier check.
sql: select 'min_active_customers' as slice, (select min(active_customers) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select min(active_customers) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Maximum single-month order_count value, a boundary/outlier check.
sql: select 'max_order_count' as slice, (select max(order_count) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select max(order_count) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Minimum single-month order_count value, a boundary/outlier check.
sql: select 'min_order_count' as slice, (select min(order_count) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select min(order_count) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null active_customers value in each table.
sql: select 'null_active_customers_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers is null)::double as reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null order_count value in each table.
sql: select 'null_order_count_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count is null)::double as reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null orders_per_active_customer value in each table, which could indicate divide-by-zero handling differences.
sql: select 'null_orders_per_active_customer_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where orders_per_active_customer is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where orders_per_active_customer is null)::double as reference_value

description: Count of months where active_customers equals zero, an edge case that could cause ratio divide-by-zero issues.
sql: select 'zero_active_customers_months' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers = 0)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers = 0)::double as reference_value

description: Count of months where order_count is less than active_customers, which should be impossible if every active customer placed at least one qualifying order; a mismatch signals a join/fan-out bug.
sql: select 'invariant_order_count_lt_active_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count < active_customers)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count < active_customers)::double as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of active_customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', activity_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of active_customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', activity_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', activity_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers summed across all months, model vs reference.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(SUM(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(SUM(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all months, model vs reference.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(SUM(order_count) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(SUM(order_count) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Overall weighted ratio (sum order_count / sum active_customers) across all months to avoid distortion from averaging ratios.
sql: SELECT 'total_weighted_ratio' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(SUM(order_count) AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(SUM(active_customers),0) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(SUM(order_count) AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(SUM(active_customers),0) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Simple unweighted average of the stored orders_per_active_customer column across months.
sql: SELECT 'total_simple_avg_ratio' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(orders_per_active_customer) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(orders_per_active_customer) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Total row count in each output table.
sql: SELECT 'row_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Count of distinct activity_month keys present in each table.
sql: SELECT 'distinct_months' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT activity_month) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT activity_month) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Active customers per calendar month, full outer joined to expose any missing or mismatched months.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(m.active_customers AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(r.active_customers AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: Order count per calendar month, full outer joined to expose any missing or mismatched months.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(m.order_count AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(r.order_count AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: Stored orders_per_active_customer ratio per calendar month, model vs reference.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.orders_per_active_customer AS model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: Months present in only one of the two tables (key coverage gap), flagged with 1/0 presence indicators.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CASE WHEN m.activity_month IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS model_value, CASE WHEN r.activity_month IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month WHERE m.activity_month IS NULL OR r.activity_month IS NULL

description: Row count per activity_month in each table, to detect grain violations (duplicate month rows).
sql: WITH mc AS (SELECT activity_month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), rc AS (SELECT activity_month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(mc.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(rc.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(mc.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(rc.cnt AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM mc FULL OUTER JOIN rc ON mc.activity_month = rc.activity_month ORDER BY 1

description: Earliest activity_month in each table, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: SELECT 'min_activity_month_epoch_days' AS slice, (SELECT CAST((MIN(activity_month) - DATE '1970-01-01') AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST((MIN(activity_month) - DATE '1970-01-01') AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Latest activity_month in each table, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: SELECT 'max_activity_month_epoch_days' AS slice, (SELECT CAST((MAX(activity_month) - DATE '1970-01-01') AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST((MAX(activity_month) - DATE '1970-01-01') AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Active customers in each table's own first (earliest) activity month.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT active_customers FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT active_customers FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: Active customers in each table's own last (latest) activity month.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT active_customers FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT active_customers FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: Order count in each table's own first (earliest) activity month.
sql: SELECT 'first_month_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT order_count FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT order_count FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MIN(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: Order count in each table's own last (latest) activity month.
sql: SELECT 'last_month_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT order_count FROM model_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output)) AS model_value, (SELECT order_count FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month = (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS reference_value

description: Active customers summed by calendar quarter, model vs reference.
sql: WITH mq AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', activity_month) AS q, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), rq AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', activity_month) AS q, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(mq.q AS VARCHAR), CAST(rq.q AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(mq.ac AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(rq.ac AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM mq FULL OUTER JOIN rq ON mq.q = rq.q ORDER BY 1

description: Order count summed by calendar quarter, model vs reference.
sql: WITH mq AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', activity_month) AS q, SUM(order_count) AS oc FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), rq AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', activity_month) AS q, SUM(order_count) AS oc FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(mq.q AS VARCHAR), CAST(rq.q AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(mq.oc AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(rq.oc AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM mq FULL OUTER JOIN rq ON mq.q = rq.q ORDER BY 1

description: Weighted orders-per-active-customer ratio (sum order_count / sum active_customers) by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH mq AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', activity_month) AS q, SUM(order_count) AS oc, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), rq AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', activity_month) AS q, SUM(order_count) AS oc, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(mq.q AS VARCHAR), CAST(rq.q AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(mq.oc AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(mq.ac,0) AS model_value, CAST(rq.oc AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(rq.ac,0) AS reference_value FROM mq FULL OUTER JOIN rq ON mq.q = rq.q ORDER BY 1

description: Active customers summed by calendar year, model vs reference.
sql: WITH my AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', activity_month) AS y, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), ry AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', activity_month) AS y, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(my.y AS VARCHAR), CAST(ry.y AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(my.ac AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(ry.ac AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM my FULL OUTER JOIN ry ON my.y = ry.y ORDER BY 1

description: Order count summed by calendar year, model vs reference.
sql: WITH my AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', activity_month) AS y, SUM(order_count) AS oc FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), ry AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', activity_month) AS y, SUM(order_count) AS oc FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(my.y AS VARCHAR), CAST(ry.y AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(my.oc AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(ry.oc AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM my FULL OUTER JOIN ry ON my.y = ry.y ORDER BY 1

description: Weighted orders-per-active-customer ratio (sum order_count / sum active_customers) by calendar year.
sql: WITH my AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', activity_month) AS y, SUM(order_count) AS oc, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), ry AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', activity_month) AS y, SUM(order_count) AS oc, SUM(active_customers) AS ac FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(my.y AS VARCHAR), CAST(ry.y AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(my.oc AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(my.ac,0) AS model_value, CAST(ry.oc AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(ry.ac,0) AS reference_value FROM my FULL OUTER JOIN ry ON my.y = ry.y ORDER BY 1

description: Within model_output, compares the stored orders_per_active_customer value to a freshly recomputed order_count/active_customers to catch fan-out or rounding errors.
sql: SELECT CAST(activity_month AS VARCHAR) AS slice, orders_per_active_customer AS model_value, CAST(order_count AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(active_customers,0) AS reference_value FROM model_output ORDER BY 1

description: Within reference_output, compares the stored orders_per_active_customer value to a freshly recomputed order_count/active_customers to catch inconsistencies in the reference itself.
sql: SELECT CAST(activity_month AS VARCHAR) AS slice, orders_per_active_customer AS model_value, CAST(order_count AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(active_customers,0) AS reference_value FROM reference_output ORDER BY 1

description: Months where active_customers is zero in either table, an edge case that would make the ratio undefined or division-by-zero prone.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.activity_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.activity_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, CAST(m.active_customers AS DOUBLE) AS model_value, CAST(r.active_customers AS DOUBLE) AS reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.activity_month = r.activity_month WHERE COALESCE(m.active_customers,0) = 0 OR COALESCE(r.active_customers,0) = 0

description: Count of months where order_count is less than active_customers, which should never happen since each active customer has at least one qualifying order.
sql: SELECT 'months_order_count_lt_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE order_count < active_customers) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE order_count < active_customers) AS reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null active_customers value in each table.
sql: SELECT 'null_active_customers_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE active_customers IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE active_customers IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null order_count value in each table.
sql: SELECT 'null_order_count_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE order_count IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE order_count IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null activity_month key in each table.
sql: SELECT 'null_activity_month_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE activity_month IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE activity_month IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative active_customers or order_count values, an impossible business state.
sql: SELECT 'negative_values_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output WHERE active_customers < 0 OR order_count < 0) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output WHERE active_customers < 0 OR order_count < 0) AS reference_value

description: The single highest active_customers value observed across all months in each table.
sql: SELECT 'max_active_customers_value' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(MAX(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(MAX(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: The single lowest active_customers value observed across all months in each table.
sql: SELECT 'min_active_customers_value' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(MIN(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(MIN(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Population standard deviation of active_customers across months, to detect distributional differences.
sql: SELECT 'stddev_pop_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT STDDEV_POP(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT STDDEV_POP(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Simple average of active_customers across all months.
sql: SELECT 'avg_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(active_customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(active_customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Simple average of order_count across all months.
sql: SELECT 'avg_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Sum of active_customers over the trailing 12 months from the latest observed month, a common dashboard window that could mask older-period errors.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT GREATEST((SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output), (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS max_d) SELECT 'last_12_months_active_customers' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(SUM(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > bounds.max_d - INTERVAL '12 months') AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(SUM(active_customers) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > bounds.max_d - INTERVAL '12 months') AS reference_value

description: Sum of order_count over the trailing 12 months from the latest observed month.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT GREATEST((SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM model_output), (SELECT MAX(activity_month) FROM reference_output)) AS max_d) SELECT 'last_12_months_order_count' AS slice, (SELECT CAST(SUM(order_count) AS DOUBLE) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > bounds.max_d - INTERVAL '12 months') AS model_value, (SELECT CAST(SUM(order_count) AS DOUBLE) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE activity_month > bounds.max_d - INTERVAL '12 months') AS reference_value

description: Grand total of active_customers summed across all months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows (months) in each output table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Count of distinct activity_month keys in each table to check for grain/duplication issues.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(distinct activity_month) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Difference between row count and distinct month count, exposing duplicate rows per month in either table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) - count(distinct activity_month) from model_output)::double as model_value, (select count(*) - count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output)::double as reference_value

description: Count of null active_customers values in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers is null)::double as reference_value

description: Count of null order_count values in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count is null)::double as reference_value

description: Count of null orders_per_active_customer values in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where orders_per_active_customer is null)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where orders_per_active_customer is null)::double as reference_value

description: Count of months with zero or negative order_count, a sanity edge case.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count <= 0)::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count <= 0)::double as reference_value

description: Simple average of active_customers across months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Simple average of order_count across months, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Maximum active_customers value observed in any month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select max(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Minimum active_customers value observed in any month, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select min(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Simple unweighted average of the orders_per_active_customer column across months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Weighted ratio of total order_count to total active_customers, more robust than averaging the per-month ratio.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Sum of absolute differences between the stored orders_per_active_customer and a recomputed order_count/active_customers ratio per row, checking internal consistency of each table.
sql: select 'stored_vs_recomputed_ratio_abs_diff_sum' as slice, (select sum(abs(orders_per_active_customer - (order_count*1.0/active_customers))) from model_output where active_customers <> 0) as model_value, (select sum(abs(orders_per_active_customer - (order_count*1.0/active_customers))) from reference_output where active_customers <> 0) as reference_value

description: Per-month active_customers comparison, full outer joined on activity_month.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Per-month order_count comparison, full outer joined on activity_month.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Per-month orders_per_active_customer comparison, full outer joined on activity_month.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, m.orders_per_active_customer as model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Yearly sum of active_customers, comparing model vs reference per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as yr, sum(active_customers) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as yr, sum(active_customers) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Yearly sum of order_count, comparing model vs reference per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as yr, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', activity_month) as yr, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Quarterly sum of active_customers, comparing model vs reference per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as qtr, sum(active_customers) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as qtr, sum(active_customers) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.qtr as varchar), cast(r.qtr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.qtr = r.qtr order by 1

description: Quarterly sum of order_count, comparing model vs reference per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as qtr, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as qtr, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.qtr as varchar), cast(r.qtr as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.qtr = r.qtr order by 1

description: For every month present in either table, flag whether it exists in model (1/0) vs reference (1/0) to catch missing or extra periods.
