sql: select coalesce(cast(m.activity_month as varchar), cast(r.activity_month as varchar)) as slice, case when m.activity_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.activity_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Count of months present in model but missing from reference; expected to be zero.
sql: select 'months_in_model_missing_from_reference' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month where r.activity_month is null)::double as model_value, 0::double as reference_value

description: Count of months present in reference but missing from model; expected to be zero.
sql: select 'months_in_reference_missing_from_model' as slice, 0::double as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r left join model_output m on r.activity_month = m.activity_month where m.activity_month is null)::double as reference_value

description: active_customers for the earliest month present across either table, a boundary/edge check.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select min(activity_month) as first_month from all_months) select 'first_month:' || cast(b.first_month as varchar) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from bounds b left join model_output m on m.activity_month = b.first_month left join reference_output r on r.activity_month = b.first_month

description: order_count for the earliest month present across either table, a boundary/edge check.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select min(activity_month) as first_month from all_months) select 'first_month:' || cast(b.first_month as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from bounds b left join model_output m on m.activity_month = b.first_month left join reference_output r on r.activity_month = b.first_month

description: active_customers for the latest month present across either table, a boundary/edge check for partial-period data.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select max(activity_month) as last_month from all_months) select 'last_month:' || cast(b.last_month as varchar) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from bounds b left join model_output m on m.activity_month = b.last_month left join reference_output r on r.activity_month = b.last_month

description: order_count for the latest month present across either table, a boundary/edge check for partial-period data.
sql: with all_months as (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output), bounds as (select max(activity_month) as last_month from all_months) select 'last_month:' || cast(b.last_month as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from bounds b left join model_output m on m.activity_month = b.last_month left join reference_output r on r.activity_month = b.last_month

description: Sum of active_customers over the trailing 12 months ending at the latest available month, an edge/recent-period check.
sql: with anchor as (select max(activity_month) as max_month from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output) t) select 'last_12_months_active_customers' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where activity_month > (select max_month - interval '11 months' from anchor) and activity_month <= (select max_month from anchor)) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where activity_month > (select max_month - interval '11 months' from anchor) and activity_month <= (select max_month from anchor)) as reference_value

description: Sum of order_count over the trailing 12 months ending at the latest available month, an edge/recent-period check.
sql: with anchor as (select max(activity_month) as max_month from (select activity_month from model_output union select activity_month from reference_output) t) select 'last_12_months_order_count' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output where activity_month > (select max_month - interval '11 months' from anchor) and activity_month <= (select max_month from anchor)) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where activity_month > (select max_month - interval '11 months' from anchor) and activity_month <= (select max_month from anchor)) as reference_value

description: Compare the grand total of active_customers summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the grand total of order_count summed across all months.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare overall weighted ratio of total orders to total active customers across all months.
sql: select 'total_weighted_ratio' as slice, (select sum(order_count)::double / nullif(sum(active_customers),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count)::double / nullif(sum(active_customers),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total number of rows (months) present in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare count of distinct activity_month values present in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct activity_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct activity_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: List months present in model_output but missing from reference_output.
sql: select cast(m.activity_month as varchar) as slice, 1 as model_value, 0 as reference_value from (select distinct activity_month from model_output) m left join (select distinct activity_month from reference_output) r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month where r.activity_month is null

description: List months present in reference_output but missing from model_output.
sql: select cast(r.activity_month as varchar) as slice, 0 as model_value, 1 as reference_value from (select distinct activity_month from reference_output) r left join (select distinct activity_month from model_output) m on m.activity_month = r.activity_month where m.activity_month is null

description: Compare active_customers for each calendar month between model and reference.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.active_customers as model_value, r.active_customers as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare order_count for each calendar month between model and reference.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare orders_per_active_customer for each calendar month between model and reference.
sql: select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.orders_per_active_customer as model_value, r.orders_per_active_customer as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare active_customers summed by calendar year between model and reference.
sql: with m as (select cast(extract(year from activity_month) as varchar) as yr, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(extract(year from activity_month) as varchar) as yr, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compare order_count summed by calendar year between model and reference.
sql: with m as (select cast(extract(year from activity_month) as varchar) as yr, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(extract(year from activity_month) as varchar) as yr, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compare weighted orders_per_active_customer (total orders / total active customers) by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select cast(extract(year from activity_month) as varchar) as yr, sum(order_count)::double / nullif(sum(active_customers),0) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(extract(year from activity_month) as varchar) as yr, sum(order_count)::double / nullif(sum(active_customers),0) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compare active_customers summed by calendar quarter between model and reference.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as varchar) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as varchar) as q, sum(active_customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare order_count summed by calendar quarter between model and reference.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as varchar) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', activity_month) as varchar) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare active_customers for the earliest activity_month present across both tables.
sql: with earliest as (select min(activity_month) as mn from (select activity_month from model_output union all select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output, earliest where activity_month = mn) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output, earliest where activity_month = mn) as reference_value

description: Compare active_customers for the latest activity_month present across both tables.
sql: with latest as (select max(activity_month) as mx from (select activity_month from model_output union all select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'last_month' as slice, (select active_customers from model_output, latest where activity_month = mx) as model_value, (select active_customers from reference_output, latest where activity_month = mx) as reference_value

description: Compare order_count for the earliest activity_month present across both tables.
sql: with earliest as (select min(activity_month) as mn from (select activity_month from model_output union all select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month' as slice, (select order_count from model_output, earliest where activity_month = mn) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output, earliest where activity_month = mn) as reference_value

description: Compare order_count for the latest activity_month present across both tables.
sql: with latest as (select max(activity_month) as mx from (select activity_month from model_output union all select activity_month from reference_output)) select 'last_month' as slice, (select order_count from model_output, latest where activity_month = mx) as model_value, (select order_count from reference_output, latest where activity_month = mx) as reference_value

description: Compare the minimum active_customers value seen in either table (boundary low activity month check).
sql: select 'min_active_customers' as slice, (select min(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the maximum active_customers value seen in either table (peak month check).
sql: select 'max_active_customers' as slice, (select max(active_customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(active_customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the minimum order_count value seen in either table.
sql: select 'min_order_count' as slice, (select min(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the maximum order_count value seen in either table.
sql: select 'max_order_count' as slice, (select max(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare count of months where active_customers is zero or null, which would cause division issues in orders_per_active_customer.
sql: select 'zero_or_null_active_customers_months' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where active_customers is null or active_customers = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where active_customers is null or active_customers = 0) as reference_value

description: Compare count of months where orders_per_active_customer is null across both tables.
sql: select 'null_ratio_months' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where orders_per_active_customer is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where orders_per_active_customer is null) as reference_value

description: Check internal consistency: model's stated ratio vs recomputed order_count/active_customers, surfaced as a month-level comparison against reference's same consistency check.
sql: with m as (select activity_month, orders_per_active_customer as stated, order_count::double / nullif(active_customers,0) as recomputed from model_output), r as (select activity_month, orders_per_active_customer as stated, order_count::double / nullif(active_customers,0) as recomputed from reference_output) select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.stated - m.recomputed as model_value, r.stated - r.recomputed as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare cumulative running total of active_customers through each month to catch drift accumulating over time.
sql: with m as (select activity_month, sum(active_customers) over (order by activity_month) as cum from model_output), r as (select activity_month, sum(active_customers) over (order by activity_month) as cum from reference_output) select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.cum as model_value, r.cum as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare cumulative running total of order_count through each month to catch drift accumulating over time.
sql: with m as (select activity_month, sum(order_count) over (order by activity_month) as cum from model_output), r as (select activity_month, sum(order_count) over (order by activity_month) as cum from reference_output) select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.cum as model_value, r.cum as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare month-over-month change in active_customers to detect divergent trend shapes even if cumulative totals match.
sql: with m as (select activity_month, active_customers - lag(active_customers) over (order by activity_month) as delta from model_output), r as (select activity_month, active_customers - lag(active_customers) over (order by activity_month) as delta from reference_output) select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.delta as model_value, r.delta as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare month-over-month change in order_count to detect divergent trend shapes even if cumulative totals match.
sql: with m as (select activity_month, order_count - lag(order_count) over (order by activity_month) as delta from model_output), r as (select activity_month, order_count - lag(order_count) over (order by activity_month) as delta from reference_output) select cast(coalesce(m.activity_month, r.activity_month) as varchar) as slice, m.delta as model_value, r.delta as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.activity_month = r.activity_month order by 1

description: Compare the simple (unweighted) average of orders_per_active_customer across all months, which is sensitive to outlier months with few customers.
sql: select 'simple_avg_ratio' as slice, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(orders_per_active_customer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare count of implausible months where order_count is less than active_customers (should be impossible since each active customer has at least one order).
sql: select 'order_count_lt_active_customers' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count < active_customers) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count < active_customers) as reference_value

description: Compare count of activity_month values that appear more than once (grain violation) in each table.
sql: with m as (select activity_month, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1), r as (select activity_month, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1 having count(*) > 1) select 'duplicate_month_keys' as slice, (select count(*) from m) as model_value, (select count(*) from r) as reference_value

description: Compare active_customers totaled for all activity_months before year 2024 as a boundary-period check.
sql: select 'active_customers_pre_2024' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where activity_month < date '2024-01-01') as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where activity_month < date '2024-01-01') as reference_value

description: Compare active_customers totaled for 2026 year-to-date months (most recent, possibly incomplete data boundary).
sql: select 'active_customers_2026_ytd' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where activity_month >= date '2026-01-01') as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where activity_month >= date '2026-01-01') as reference_value

description: Compare order_count totaled for 2026 year-to-date months (most recent, possibly incomplete data boundary).
sql: select 'order_count_2026_ytd' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output where activity_month >= date '2026-01-01') as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where activity_month >= date '2026-01-01') as reference_value

description: Compare total active_customers across all Decembers to check for holiday-season-specific discrepancies (e.g., timezone edge effects at year boundary).
sql: select 'december_active_customers' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where extract(month from activity_month) = 12) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where extract(month from activity_month) = 12) as reference_value

description: Compare total active_customers across all Januaries to check for timezone edge effects at year boundary.
sql: select 'january_active_customers' as slice, (select sum(active_customers) from model_output where extract(month from activity_month) = 1) as model_value, (select sum(active_customers) from reference_output where extract(month from activity_month) = 1) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_gross
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue_gross in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_gross
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue_gross in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_gross across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_pretax across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of (month, location) rows in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total revenue_gross summed by location_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Total revenue_pretax summed by location_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Total order_count summed by location_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Total revenue_gross summed by calendar month.
sql: select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.mth = r.mth

description: Total revenue_pretax summed by calendar month.
sql: select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(revenue_pretax) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(revenue_pretax) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.mth = r.mth

description: Total order_count summed by calendar month.
sql: select coalesce(m.mth, r.mth) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as mth, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.mth = r.mth

description: Total revenue_gross summed by calendar quarter (labeled by quarter start date).
sql: select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select strftime(date_trunc('quarter', order_month), '%Y-%m-%d') as q, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select strftime(date_trunc('quarter', order_month), '%Y-%m-%d') as q, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.q = r.q

description: Total order_count summed by calendar quarter (labeled by quarter start date).
sql: select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select strftime(date_trunc('quarter', order_month), '%Y-%m-%d') as q, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select strftime(date_trunc('quarter', order_month), '%Y-%m-%d') as q, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.q = r.q

description: Total revenue_gross summed by calendar year.
sql: select coalesce(m.y, r.y) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select strftime(date_trunc('year', order_month), '%Y') as y, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select strftime(date_trunc('year', order_month), '%Y') as y, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.y = r.y

description: Total order_count summed by calendar year.
sql: select coalesce(m.y, r.y) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select strftime(date_trunc('year', order_month), '%Y') as y, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select strftime(date_trunc('year', order_month), '%Y') as y, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.y = r.y

description: Total revenue_gross in each table's own earliest month (checks boundary handling).
sql: select 'first_month_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = (select min(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = (select min(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Total revenue_gross in each table's own latest month (checks boundary handling).
sql: select 'last_month_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = (select max(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = (select max(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Revenue_gross in each location's own first active month, per table.
sql: with mf as (select location_id, min(order_month) as fm from model_output group by 1), mv as (select mo.location_id, sum(mo.revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output mo join mf on mo.location_id = mf.location_id and mo.order_month = mf.fm group by 1), rf as (select location_id, min(order_month) as fm from reference_output group by 1), rv as (select ro.location_id, sum(ro.revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output ro join rf on ro.location_id = rf.location_id and ro.order_month = rf.fm group by 1) select coalesce(mv.location_id, rv.location_id) as slice, mv.model_value, rv.reference_value from mv full outer join rv on mv.location_id = rv.location_id

description: Revenue_gross in each location's own last active month, per table.
sql: with ml as (select location_id, max(order_month) as lm from model_output group by 1), mv as (select mo.location_id, sum(mo.revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output mo join ml on mo.location_id = ml.location_id and mo.order_month = ml.lm group by 1), rl as (select location_id, max(order_month) as lm from reference_output group by 1), rv as (select ro.location_id, sum(ro.revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output ro join rl on ro.location_id = rl.location_id and ro.order_month = rl.lm group by 1) select coalesce(mv.location_id, rv.location_id) as slice, mv.model_value, rv.reference_value from mv full outer join rv on mv.location_id = rv.location_id

description: Counts of (month, location) keys present only in model_output vs only in reference_output.
sql: with keys as (select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as order_month, coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as location_id, case when m.location_id is null then 1 else 0 end as ref_only, case when r.location_id is null then 1 else 0 end as model_only from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id) select 'model_only_keys' as slice, sum(model_only) as model_value, 0 as reference_value from keys union all select 'reference_only_keys' as slice, 0 as model_value, sum(ref_only) as reference_value from keys

description: Count of distinct location_id values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_location_count' as slice, (select count(distinct location_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct location_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall average order value (revenue_gross / order_count), computed from summed totals to avoid distortion.
sql: select 'avg_order_value_gross' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average order value by location (sum revenue_gross / sum order_count), per table.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Overall ratio of revenue_pretax to revenue_gross, computed from summed totals.
sql: select 'pretax_to_gross_ratio' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Ratio of revenue_pretax to revenue_gross by location, per table.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Full-grain comparison of revenue_gross for every (month, location) cell.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1,2) m full outer join (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1,2) r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Full-grain comparison of revenue_pretax for every (month, location) cell.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as model_value from model_output group by 1,2) m full outer join (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1,2) r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Full-grain comparison of order_count for every (month, location) cell.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, location_id, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1,2) m full outer join (select order_month, location_id, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1,2) r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Count of rows with negative revenue_gross, which would indicate a data quality or refund-handling issue.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_gross_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Number of distinct active months per location, to detect missing or extra months per location.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, count(distinct order_month) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, count(distinct order_month) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Count of distinct location_name values per location_id, to detect inconsistent naming between tables.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, count(distinct location_name) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, count(distinct location_name) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Count of rows with order_count equal to zero, which should not normally exist at this grain.
sql: select 'zero_order_count_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with null revenue_gross or revenue_pretax, which would indicate join fan-out or aggregation issues.
sql: select 'null_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross is null or revenue_pretax is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross is null or revenue_pretax is null) as reference_value

description: Grand total order count across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select cast(sum(order_count) as double) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(sum(order_count) as double) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total pretax revenue across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total gross revenue across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows (month-location grain) in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select cast(count(*) as double) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(count(*) as double) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Distinct location_id count in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_locations' as slice, (select cast(count(distinct location_id) as double) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(count(distinct location_id) as double) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Distinct order_month count in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select cast(count(distinct order_month) as double) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(count(distinct order_month) as double) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Full outer join on (order_month, location_id) to find keys present in only one table.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar),'NULL') || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id,'NULL') as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1.0 else 0.0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1.0 else 0.0 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Order count totals by location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Pretax revenue totals by location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Gross revenue totals by location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Check that location_name mapping per location_id is consistent (count distinct names) between tables.
sql: with m as (select location_id, count(distinct location_name) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, count(distinct location_name) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Order count totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Pretax revenue totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Gross revenue totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Order count totals by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Pretax revenue totals by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Order count totals by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Gross revenue totals by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Gross revenue in the earliest month present across both tables.
sql: with mn as (select min(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)) , m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from mn)), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from mn)) select 'first_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Gross revenue in the latest month present across both tables.
sql: with mx as (select max(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)) , m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from mx)), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from mx)) select 'last_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Order count in the earliest month present across both tables.
sql: with mn as (select min(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)) , m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from mn)), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from mn)) select 'first_month_order_count' as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m, r

description: Order count in the latest month present across both tables.
sql: with mx as (select max(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)) , m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from mx)), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from mx)) select 'last_month_order_count' as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m, r

description: Average pretax order value (total pretax revenue / total order count) overall.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_pretax' as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.cnt,0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.cnt,0) as reference_value from m, r

description: Average gross order value (total gross revenue / total order count) overall.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_gross' as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.cnt,0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.cnt,0) as reference_value from m, r

description: Average gross order value per location, to detect fan-out or join distortion by location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.cnt,0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.cnt,0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Average gross order value per month, to detect fan-out or join distortion by month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.cnt,0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.cnt,0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Implied overall tax rate ((gross-pretax)/pretax) to detect subtotal/total mixups.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from reference_output) select 'implied_tax_rate' as slice, (m.g - m.p) / nullif(m.p,0) as model_value, (r.g - r.p) / nullif(r.p,0) as reference_value from m, r

description: Implied tax rate by location to detect location-specific subtotal/total mixups.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, (m.g - m.p) / nullif(m.p,0) as model_value, (r.g - r.p) / nullif(r.p,0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Count of rows with null location_id in each table (would indicate failed location join / unmatched location).
sql: select 'null_location_id' as slice, (select cast(count(*) as double) from model_output where location_id is null) as model_value, (select cast(count(*) as double) from reference_output where location_id is null) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with null location_name in each table (would indicate an unmatched location lookup).
sql: select 'null_location_name' as slice, (select cast(count(*) as double) from model_output where location_name is null) as model_value, (select cast(count(*) as double) from reference_output where location_name is null) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with order_count <= 0 (should be zero on both sides, flags aggregation bugs).
sql: select 'zero_or_negative_order_count' as slice, (select cast(count(*) as double) from model_output where order_count <= 0) as model_value, (select cast(count(*) as double) from reference_output where order_count <= 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative pretax revenue, which could indicate refund leakage into qualifying orders.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_pretax' as slice, (select cast(count(*) as double) from model_output where revenue_pretax < 0) as model_value, (select cast(count(*) as double) from reference_output where revenue_pretax < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative gross revenue, which could indicate refund leakage into qualifying orders.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_gross' as slice, (select cast(count(*) as double) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (select cast(count(*) as double) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Order count at full month-location grain to pinpoint exact mismatching cells.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, cast(m.order_count as double) as model_value, cast(r.order_count as double) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Pretax revenue at full month-location grain to pinpoint exact mismatching cells.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.revenue_pretax as model_value, r.revenue_pretax as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Gross revenue at full month-location grain to pinpoint exact mismatching cells.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Number of distinct locations reporting per month, to catch missing or extra location rows per period.
sql: with m as (select order_month, count(distinct location_id) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, count(distinct location_id) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Number of distinct months reporting per location, to catch missing or extra month rows per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, count(distinct order_month) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, count(distinct order_month) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, cast(m.v as double) as model_value, cast(r.v as double) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Gross revenue for the current partial calendar month (2026-10), a common edge case for in-flight period boundaries.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output where order_month = date '2026-10-01'), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output where order_month = date '2026-10-01') select 'current_month_2026_10' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Check for duplicate (order_month, location_id) keys in each table, which would indicate a grain violation from timezone/truncation issues.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1), r as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1) select 'duplicate_key_rows' as slice, (select cast(coalesce(sum(c),0) as double) from m) as model_value, (select cast(coalesce(sum(c),0) as double) from r) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total order_count across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total revenue_pretax across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total revenue_gross across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total number of (month, location) rows in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total order_count per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare total revenue_pretax per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare total revenue_gross per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare total order_count per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compare total revenue_pretax per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compare total revenue_gross per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compare total revenue_gross per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q

description: Compare total revenue_gross per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y

description: Compare revenue_gross for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = (select mn from bounds)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = (select mn from bounds)) as reference_value

description: Compare revenue_gross for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'last_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = (select mx from bounds)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = (select mx from bounds)) as reference_value

description: Count of (month, location) keys present only in model vs only in reference; both should be zero.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, location_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, location_id from reference_output), model_only as (select count(*) as c from (select * from m except select * from r)), ref_only as (select count(*) as c from (select * from r except select * from m)) select 'missing_keys' as slice, model_only.c as model_value, ref_only.c as reference_value from model_only, ref_only

description: For each location_id, flag whether model and reference location_name agree (1=match); reference always expects 1.
sql: with m as (select distinct location_id, location_name from model_output), r as (select distinct location_id, location_name from reference_output) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, case when m.location_name = r.location_name then 1 else 0 end as model_value, 1 as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Count of (month, location) keys that appear more than once in each table; both should be zero.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1,2) select 'duplicate_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from m where c > 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from r where c > 1) as reference_value

description: Compare overall average pretax revenue per order (sum revenue_pretax / sum order_count).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax)/sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax)/sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare overall average gross revenue per order (sum revenue_gross / sum order_count).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare average gross revenue per order by location; sensitive to join fan-out distorting order_count or revenue.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare total implied tax amount (revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total implied tax amount (revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare the number of distinct location_id values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_locations' as slice, (select count(distinct location_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct location_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the number of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count rows with negative revenue_gross or revenue_pretax, which should not occur after refund exclusion.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0 or revenue_pretax < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0 or revenue_pretax < 0) as reference_value

description: Count rows with order_count equal to zero, which would indicate an unexpected grouping artifact.
sql: select 'zero_order_count_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count = 0) as reference_value

description: Compare number of monthly rows present per location between model and reference.
sql: with m as (select location_id, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare number of location rows present per calendar month between model and reference.
sql: with m as (select order_month, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compare implied tax rate (sum revenue_gross / sum revenue_pretax) per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compare revenue_gross at the full (month, location) grain to catch cell-level discrepancies.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare order_count at the full (month, location) grain to catch cell-level discrepancies or fan-out.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Total revenue_gross by location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Total revenue_pretax by calendar month.

description: Total revenue_gross by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Total revenue_pretax by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_pretax) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_pretax) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Total order_count by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Total revenue_gross by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Total revenue_pretax by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_pretax) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_pretax) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Total order_count by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Revenue_gross compared at the full grain (order_month x location_id) to pinpoint exact mismatched cells.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Lists grain keys (order_month, location_id) present on only one side, flagging coverage gaps.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, location_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, location_id from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Count of grain-key groups appearing more than once (grain violation / fan-out risk) in each table.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1,2) select 'duplicate_keys_total' as slice, (select count(*) from m where cnt > 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from r where cnt > 1) as reference_value

description: Count of location_ids whose location_name differs between model and reference (expected to be zero).
sql: with m as (select distinct location_id, location_name from model_output), r as (select distinct location_id, location_name from reference_output) select 'location_name_mismatches' as slice, (select count(*) from m join r on m.location_id = r.location_id where m.location_name <> r.location_name) as model_value, 0 as reference_value

description: Revenue_gross for the earliest order_month present in either table (boundary period check).
sql: with months as (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output), fm as (select min(order_month) as mn from months) select 'first_month:' || cast(fm.mn as varchar) as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = fm.mn) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = fm.mn) as reference_value from fm

description: Revenue_gross for the latest order_month present in either table (boundary period check).
sql: with months as (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output), lm as (select max(order_month) as mx from months) select 'last_month:' || cast(lm.mx as varchar) as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = lm.mx) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = lm.mx) as reference_value from lm

description: Overall average order value (revenue_gross / order_count) as a sensitive ratio check.
sql: select 'avg_order_value_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average order value by location to catch join fan-out or filtering issues affecting specific locations.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Average order value by calendar month to catch month-specific distortions from nulls or fan-out.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Overall implied tax ratio ((revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / revenue_gross) across all rows.
sql: select 'tax_ratio_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Implied tax ratio by location to detect location-specific subtotal/total mixups.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / sum(revenue_gross) as val from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Count of rows with negative revenue_gross (should be zero on both sides).
sql: select 'negative_revenue_gross_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where revenue_pretax exceeds revenue_gross, which should not happen if gross includes tax.
sql: select 'pretax_gt_gross_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_pretax > revenue_gross) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_pretax > revenue_gross) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with order_count = 0, which would be an unexpected empty grain cell.
sql: select 'zero_order_count_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null revenue_gross value.
sql: select 'null_revenue_gross_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross is null) as reference_value

description: Compares model vs reference total revenue_gross for the single location with the highest total revenue in the trusted reference.
sql: with r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as val from reference_output group by 1 order by val desc limit 1) select 'top_ref_location:' || r.location_id as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where location_id = r.location_id) as model_value, r.val as reference_value from r

description: Number of distinct months reported per location in each table, to catch locations with missing or extra months.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, count(distinct order_month) as val from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, count(distinct order_month) as val from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Revenue_pretax totals by location_id.

description: Order_count totals by location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Revenue_gross totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(strftime(m.order_month,'%Y-%m'), strftime(r.order_month,'%Y-%m')) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Revenue_pretax totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(strftime(m.order_month,'%Y-%m'), strftime(r.order_month,'%Y-%m')) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Order_count totals by calendar month.

description: Revenue_gross totals rolled up to calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(strftime(m.q,'%Y-%m'), strftime(r.q,'%Y-%m')) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Revenue_gross totals rolled up to calendar year.

description: Revenue_pretax totals rolled up to calendar year.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from order_month) as y, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from order_month) as y, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Order_count totals rolled up to calendar year.
