description: Lists (month, location_id) keys present in only one table.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, location_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, location_id from reference_output) select coalesce(strftime(m.order_month,'%Y-%m'), strftime(r.order_month,'%Y-%m')) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, case when m.location_id is null then 0 else 1 end as model_value, case when r.location_id is null then 0 else 1 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where m.location_id is null or r.location_id is null

description: Count of distinct location_id values in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(distinct location_id) as v from model_output), r as (select count(distinct location_id) as v from reference_output) select 'distinct_locations' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Count of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(distinct order_month) as v from model_output), r as (select count(distinct order_month) as v from reference_output) select 'distinct_months' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Checks for duplicate (month, location_id) grain rows in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as c from model_output), mk as (select count(*) as c from (select distinct order_month, location_id from model_output) t), r as (select count(*) as c from reference_output), rk as (select count(*) as c from (select distinct order_month, location_id from reference_output) t) select 'duplicate_row_count' as slice, (m.c - mk.c) as model_value, (r.c - rk.c) as reference_value from m, mk, r, rk

description: Revenue_gross for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mn as (select min(order_month) as d from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'first_month_revenue_gross' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = mn.d) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = mn.d) as reference_value from mn

description: Revenue_gross for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mx as (select max(order_month) as d from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'last_month_revenue_gross' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = mx.d) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = mx.d) as reference_value from mx

description: Order_count for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mn as (select min(order_month) as d from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'first_month_order_count' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output where order_month = mn.d) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where order_month = mn.d) as reference_value from mn

description: Order_count for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mx as (select max(order_month) as d from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'last_month_order_count' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output where order_month = mx.d) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where order_month = mx.d) as reference_value from mx

description: Overall average order value (gross) = total revenue_gross / total order_count.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(order_count) as oc from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(order_count) as oc from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_gross' as slice, m.rg / m.oc as model_value, r.rg / r.oc as reference_value from m, r

description: Overall average order value (pretax) = total revenue_pretax / total order_count.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as rp, sum(order_count) as oc from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as rp, sum(order_count) as oc from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_pretax' as slice, m.rp / m.oc as model_value, r.rp / r.oc as reference_value from m, r

description: Overall implied tax rate = (revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / revenue_pretax.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp from reference_output) select 'implied_tax_rate_total' as slice, (m.rg - m.rp)/m.rp as model_value, (r.rg - r.rp)/r.rp as reference_value from m, r

description: Implied tax rate by location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, (m.rg - m.rp)/m.rp as model_value, (r.rg - r.rp)/r.rp as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Revenue_gross totals by location_name, to catch id-to-name mapping issues.
sql: with m as (select location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_name = r.location_name order by 1

description: Count of distinct location_name values per location_id, to detect inconsistent mapping.
sql: with m as (select location_id, count(distinct location_name) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, count(distinct location_name) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Row-level comparison of revenue_gross at the native (month, location) grain.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from reference_output) select coalesce(strftime(m.order_month,'%Y-%m'), strftime(r.order_month,'%Y-%m')) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Row-level comparison of revenue_pretax at the native (month, location) grain.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_pretax as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_pretax as v from reference_output) select coalesce(strftime(m.order_month,'%Y-%m'), strftime(r.order_month,'%Y-%m')) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Row-level comparison of order_count at the native (month, location) grain.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from reference_output) select coalesce(strftime(m.order_month,'%Y-%m'), strftime(r.order_month,'%Y-%m')) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Count of rows with null revenue_gross in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where revenue_gross is null), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where revenue_gross is null) select 'null_revenue_gross_rows' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Count of rows with negative revenue_gross in each table (possible refund leakage).
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where revenue_gross < 0), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) select 'negative_revenue_gross_rows' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Count of rows with order_count = 0 in each table (should not exist from a group-by-count).
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where order_count = 0), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where order_count = 0) select 'zero_order_count_rows' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Average order_count per (month, location) row, overall.
sql: with m as (select avg(order_count) as v from model_output), r as (select avg(order_count) as v from reference_output) select 'avg_order_count_per_row' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Count of (month, location) rows per calendar year in each table.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from order_month) as y, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from order_month) as y, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Compare grand total revenue_gross across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total revenue_pretax across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total order_count across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total number of rows (month x location grain) between model and reference.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Find keys (order_month, location_id) present in one table but not the other.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id from reference_output), fo as (select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as order_month, coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as location_id, m.order_month as m_month, r.order_month as r_month from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id) select cast(order_month as varchar) || ' | ' || location_id as slice, case when m_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from fo where m_month is null or r_month is null

description: Compare total revenue_gross by location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare total revenue_pretax by location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare total order_count by location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare total revenue_gross by calendar month across all locations.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_pretax by calendar month across all locations.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare total order_count by calendar month across all locations.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare revenue_gross at the full grain (month x location) to catch cell-level discrepancies.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from reference_output) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare order_count at the full grain (month x location) to catch cell-level discrepancies.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from reference_output) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compare revenue_gross totals for the earliest order_month present in either table (boundary check).
sql: with min_month as (select min(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from min_month)), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from min_month)) select 'first_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare revenue_gross totals for the latest order_month present in either table (boundary check).
sql: with max_month as (select max(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from max_month)), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from max_month)) select 'last_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare order_count totals for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with min_month as (select min(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from min_month)), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from min_month)) select 'first_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare order_count totals for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with max_month as (select max(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mm from max_month)), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mm from max_month)) select 'last_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare overall average order value (gross revenue / order count) to detect fan-out or null distortion.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(order_count) as oc from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(order_count) as oc from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_gross' as slice, m.rg / m.oc as model_value, r.rg / r.oc as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare overall average pretax order value (pretax revenue / order count).
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as rp, sum(order_count) as oc from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as rp, sum(order_count) as oc from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_pretax' as slice, m.rp / m.oc as model_value, r.rp / r.oc as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare the ratio of (gross - pretax)/pretax by location to catch tax calculation discrepancies.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rg, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, (m.rg - m.rp) / m.rp as model_value, (r.rg - r.rp) / r.rp as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Check for rows with null location_name (would indicate join fan-out or missing dim records) in each table.
sql: select 'null_location_name' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where location_name is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where location_name is null) as reference_value

description: Compare the number of distinct location_id values represented in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_locations' as slice, (select count(distinct location_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct location_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the number of distinct order_month values represented in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Detect cases where the same location_id maps to different location_name values between tables (dimension drift).
sql: with m as (select distinct location_id, location_name from model_output), r as (select distinct location_id, location_name from reference_output) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, case when m.location_name is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.location_name is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id and m.location_name = r.location_name where m.location_id is null or r.location_id is null

description: Check for duplicate (order_month, location_id) keys in model_output vs reference_output (grain violation check).
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1), r as (select order_month, location_id, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1) select 'duplicate_key_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from m) as model_value, (select count(*) from r) as reference_value

description: Check for rows with negative revenue_gross values in each table, which could indicate refund handling bugs.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_gross_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Check for rows with zero order_count but non-zero revenue, which would indicate an aggregation bug.
sql: select 'zero_order_count_nonzero_revenue' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count = 0 and revenue_gross <> 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count = 0 and revenue_gross <> 0) as reference_value

description: Compare total revenue_gross aggregated by quarter to catch month-boundary / date_trunc issues.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_gross aggregated by year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by slice

description: Compare revenue_gross for the top 5 locations by model-side total revenue, to spot high-impact discrepancies.
sql: with mtot as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1 order by v desc limit 5), m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select m.location_id as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m left join r on m.location_id = r.location_id where m.location_id in (select location_id from mtot)

description: Compare average order value (pretax revenue / order count) by month to detect month-specific skew from fan-out or filtering bugs.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp, sum(order_count) as oc from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as rp, sum(order_count) as oc from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.rp / m.oc as model_value, r.rp / r.oc as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare the number of distinct locations reporting revenue in each month, to catch missing-location issues at specific periods.
sql: with m as (select order_month, count(distinct location_id) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, count(distinct location_id) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare the total implied tax amount (gross - pretax) across all rows.
sql: select 'total_tax_amount' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the number of distinct months each location reports data for, to catch locations with partial/missing history.
sql: with m as (select location_id, count(distinct order_month) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, count(distinct order_month) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Check for rows where revenue_pretax exceeds revenue_gross (should not happen since gross includes tax), a sign of a calculation bug.
sql: select 'pretax_gt_gross_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_pretax > revenue_gross) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_pretax > revenue_gross) as reference_value

description: Compare revenue_gross by month for only the locations common to both tables, isolating time-based discrepancies from location-coverage discrepancies.
sql: with common_locs as (select location_id from model_output intersect select location_id from reference_output), m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output where location_id in (select location_id from common_locs) group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output where location_id in (select location_id from common_locs) group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare the maximum single-cell revenue_gross value in each table, a quick check for outlier/fan-out bugs.
sql: select 'max_cell_revenue_gross' as slice, (select max(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select max(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the minimum single-cell revenue_gross value in each table.
sql: select 'min_cell_revenue_gross' as slice, (select min(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select min(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the average order_count per (month, location) row, sensitive to grain duplication or missing rows.
sql: select 'avg_order_count_per_row' as slice, (select avg(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total revenue_pretax aggregated by location_name (rather than location_id) to catch name-join mismatches.
sql: with m as (select location_name, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_name, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_name = r.location_name

description: Grand total of revenue_gross
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue_gross in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_gross
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue_gross in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_gross across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_pretax across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of grain rows in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: revenue_gross totals by calendar month.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: revenue_pretax totals by calendar month.

sql: select 'null_location_name_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where location_name is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where location_name is null) as reference_value

description: Monthly revenue_gross for the original location_id involved in the 2025-03-15 location remap, to validate remap boundary logic.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as revenue_gross from model_output where location_id = '40e6ddd6-b8f6-4e17-8bd6-5e53966809d2' group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as revenue_gross from reference_output where location_id = '40e6ddd6-b8f6-4e17-8bd6-5e53966809d2' group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Monthly revenue_gross for the remapped-to location_id involved in the 2025-03-15 location remap, to validate remap boundary logic.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as revenue_gross from model_output where location_id = '4b6c2304-2b9e-41e4-942a-cf11a1819378' group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as revenue_gross from reference_output where location_id = '4b6c2304-2b9e-41e4-942a-cf11a1819378' group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Ratio of revenue_gross to revenue_pretax per location to detect tax-handling discrepancies.
sql: select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(revenue_pretax),0) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(revenue_pretax),0) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Overall ratio of total revenue_gross to total revenue_pretax to detect systematic tax-handling discrepancies.
sql: select 'tax_ratio_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(revenue_pretax),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(revenue_pretax),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total revenue_gross across all months and locations.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Grand total revenue_pretax across all months and locations.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Grand total order_count across all months and locations.
sql: with m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Count of distinct location_id values in each table.

description: Total revenue_pretax per calendar month.

description: Total revenue_gross per location across all months.
sql: with m as (select location_id, max(location_name) as location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, max(location_name) as location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Total revenue_pretax per location across all months.
sql: with m as (select location_id, max(location_name) as location_name, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, max(location_name) as location_name, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Total order_count per location across all months.

description: revenue_gross at the model's native grain of month and location.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select order_month, location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: revenue_pretax at the model's native grain of month and location.

description: order_count at the model's native grain of month and location.

sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Total order_count rolled up to calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: revenue_gross for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with combined as (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output), fm as (select min(order_month) as mn from combined), m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output, fm where model_output.order_month = fm.mn), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output, fm where reference_output.order_month = fm.mn) select 'first_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: revenue_gross for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with combined as (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output), lm as (select max(order_month) as mx from combined), m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output, lm where model_output.order_month = lm.mx), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output, lm where reference_output.order_month = lm.mx) select 'last_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: order_count for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with combined as (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output), fm as (select min(order_month) as mn from combined), m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output, fm where model_output.order_month = fm.mn), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output, fm where reference_output.order_month = fm.mn) select 'first_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: order_count for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with combined as (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output), lm as (select max(order_month) as mx from combined), m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output, lm where model_output.order_month = lm.mx), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output, lm where reference_output.order_month = lm.mx) select 'last_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Overall average order value (gross) = sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count).
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_gross' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Average order value (gross) per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Average order value (gross) per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Month/location keys present in reference_output but missing from model_output.

description: Month/location keys present in model_output but missing from reference_output.

description: Implied tax amount (revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Total revenue_gross for the old location id that the model reassigns for orders before 2025-03-15.

description: Number of month rows reported per location.

sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q

description: Total revenue_gross per calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.y = r.y

description: location_id values present in only one of the two tables.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT location_id FROM model_output), r AS (SELECT DISTINCT location_id FROM reference_output) SELECT coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, CASE WHEN m.location_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as model_value, CASE WHEN r.location_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id WHERE m.location_id IS NULL OR r.location_id IS NULL

description: order_month values present in only one of the two tables.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_month FROM model_output), r AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_month FROM reference_output) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, CASE WHEN m.order_month IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as model_value, CASE WHEN r.order_month IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month WHERE m.order_month IS NULL OR r.order_month IS NULL

description: Full grain (month, location) keys present in only one of the two tables.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_month, location_id FROM model_output), r AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_month, location_id FROM reference_output) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, CASE WHEN m.order_month IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as model_value, CASE WHEN r.order_month IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id WHERE m.order_month IS NULL OR r.order_month IS NULL LIMIT 5000

description: revenue_gross totals for the earliest and latest order_month observed across both tables.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT min(order_month) as mn, max(order_month) as mx FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION ALL SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) t) SELECT 'first_month' as slice, (SELECT sum(revenue_gross) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE model_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as model_value, (SELECT sum(revenue_gross) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'last_month', (SELECT sum(revenue_gross) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE model_output.order_month = bounds.mx), (SELECT sum(revenue_gross) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx)

description: order_count totals for the earliest and latest order_month observed across both tables.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT min(order_month) as mn, max(order_month) as mx FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION ALL SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) t) SELECT 'first_month' as slice, (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE model_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as model_value, (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'last_month', (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE model_output.order_month = bounds.mx), (SELECT sum(order_count) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx)

description: Average revenue_gross per order overall (sum revenue_gross / sum order_count).
sql: SELECT 'avg_revenue_per_order' as slice, (SELECT sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) FROM model_output) as model_value, (SELECT sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) FROM reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average revenue_gross per order by location, exposes join fan-out distortions.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Total implied tax amount (revenue_gross minus revenue_pretax) across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total_tax' as slice, (SELECT sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) FROM model_output) as model_value, (SELECT sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) FROM reference_output) as reference_value

description: Implied tax amount (revenue_gross minus revenue_pretax) by calendar month.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) as v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, sum(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) as v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Implied tax rate (revenue_gross / revenue_pretax) by calendar month.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(revenue_pretax) as v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(revenue_pretax) as v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Flags (month, location) keys that appear more than once in either table, which would indicate unexpected fan-out.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, count(*) as cnt FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, count(*) as cnt FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id WHERE m.cnt > 1 OR r.cnt > 1 LIMIT 5000

description: revenue_gross compared at the full (month, location) grain for every key present in either table.
sql: SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id LIMIT 5000

description: revenue_pretax compared at the full (month, location) grain for every key present in either table.
sql: SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.revenue_pretax as model_value, r.revenue_pretax as reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id LIMIT 5000

description: order_count compared at the full (month, location) grain for every key present in either table.
sql: SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) || '|' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value FROM model_output m FULL OUTER JOIN reference_output r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id LIMIT 5000

description: Count of rows with negative revenue_gross, which should not occur in either table.
sql: SELECT 'negative_revenue_rows' as slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null location_name in each table.
sql: SELECT 'null_location_name_rows' as slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE location_name IS NULL) as model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE location_name IS NULL) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where revenue_pretax exceeds revenue_gross, which should not occur since gross includes tax.
sql: SELECT 'pretax_gt_gross_rows' as slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE revenue_pretax > revenue_gross) as model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE revenue_pretax > revenue_gross) as reference_value

description: Average order_count per (month, location) row, sensitive to grain or grouping differences.
sql: SELECT 'avg_order_count_per_row' as slice, (SELECT avg(order_count) FROM model_output) as model_value, (SELECT avg(order_count) FROM reference_output) as reference_value

description: Number of location rows reported per calendar month.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, count(*) as v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, count(*) as v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Number of month rows reported per location.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, count(*) as v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, count(*) as v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Earliest order_month present in each table, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: SELECT 'min_order_month' as slice, (SELECT date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', min(order_month)) FROM model_output) as model_value, (SELECT date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', min(order_month)) FROM reference_output) as reference_value

description: Latest order_month present in each table, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: SELECT 'max_order_month' as slice, (SELECT date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', max(order_month)) FROM model_output) as model_value, (SELECT date_diff('day', DATE '1970-01-01', max(order_month)) FROM reference_output) as reference_value

description: Flags location_id values where the location_name differs between model and reference.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT location_id, location_name FROM model_output), r AS (SELECT DISTINCT location_id, location_name FROM reference_output) SELECT m.location_id as slice, CASE WHEN m.location_name = r.location_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as model_value, 1 as reference_value FROM m JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id WHERE m.location_name <> r.location_name

description: Count of rows where order_count is zero but revenue_gross is non-zero, indicating a logic error.
sql: SELECT 'zero_order_count_nonzero_revenue' as slice, (SELECT count(*) FROM model_output WHERE order_count = 0 AND revenue_gross <> 0) as model_value, (SELECT count(*) FROM reference_output WHERE order_count = 0 AND revenue_gross <> 0) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total order_count across all rows.
sql: with m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares grand total revenue_pretax across all rows.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares grand total revenue_gross across all rows.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares total number of rows (month x location keys) in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output) select 'total_row_count' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares total order_count per location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares total revenue_pretax per location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares total revenue_gross per location_id.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares total order_count per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Compares total revenue_pretax per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Compares total order_count per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as varchar) as q, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as varchar) as q, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q

description: Compares total revenue_pretax per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as varchar) as q, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as varchar) as q, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q

description: Compares total revenue_gross per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as varchar) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select cast(date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as varchar) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.q, r.q) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q

description: Compares total order_count per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y') as yr, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y') as yr, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr
