description: Compares total revenue_gross per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y') as yr, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_month, '%Y') as yr, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.yr, r.yr) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr

description: Counts (month, location) keys present only in model vs only in reference.
sql: with model_only as (select count(*) as c from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where r.location_id is null), reference_only as (select count(*) as c from reference_output r left join model_output m on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where m.location_id is null) select 'keys_only_in_model' as slice, model_only.c as model_value, 0 as reference_value from model_only union all select 'keys_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, reference_only.c as reference_value from reference_only

description: Counts distinct location_id values present only in model vs only in reference.
sql: with model_only as (select count(distinct m.location_id) as c from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.location_id = r.location_id where r.location_id is null), reference_only as (select count(distinct r.location_id) as c from reference_output r left join model_output m on m.location_id = r.location_id where m.location_id is null) select 'locations_only_in_model' as slice, model_only.c as model_value, 0 as reference_value from model_only union all select 'locations_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, reference_only.c as reference_value from reference_only

description: Counts distinct order_month values present only in model vs only in reference.
sql: with model_only as (select count(distinct m.order_month) as c from model_output m left join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month where r.order_month is null) , reference_only as (select count(distinct r.order_month) as c from reference_output r left join model_output m on m.order_month = r.order_month where m.order_month is null) select 'months_only_in_model' as slice, model_only.c as model_value, 0 as reference_value from model_only union all select 'months_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, reference_only.c as reference_value from reference_only

description: Compares revenue_gross for the earliest and latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn, max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t), m_first as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mn), r_first as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mn), m_last as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mx), r_last as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mx) select 'first_month_revenue_gross' as slice, m_first.v as model_value, r_first.v as reference_value from m_first, r_first union all select 'last_month_revenue_gross' as slice, m_last.v as model_value, r_last.v as reference_value from m_last, r_last

description: Compares order_count for the earliest and latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn, max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t), m_first as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mn), r_first as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mn), m_last as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mx), r_last as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.mx) select 'first_month_order_count' as slice, m_first.v as model_value, r_first.v as reference_value from m_first, r_first union all select 'last_month_order_count' as slice, m_last.v as model_value, r_last.v as reference_value from m_last, r_last

description: Compares overall average order value (revenue_gross / order_count).
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as v from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares average order value per location, exposing fan-out or join distortion.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares average order value per month.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_month,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_month,'%Y-%m') as ym, sum(revenue_gross) / nullif(sum(order_count),0) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Compares overall ratio of revenue_pretax to revenue_gross, which should be consistent if tax handling matches.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) as v from reference_output) select 'pretax_to_gross_ratio_total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares pretax-to-gross ratio per location to catch location-specific tax handling errors.
sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_pretax) / nullif(sum(revenue_gross),0) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Flags location_id values where location_name differs between model and reference (1 = match expected).
sql: with m as (select distinct location_id, location_name from model_output), r as (select distinct location_id, location_name from reference_output) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, case when m.location_name = r.location_name then 1 else 0 end as model_value, 1 as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares the number of distinct location_id values in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(distinct location_id) as v from model_output), r as (select count(distinct location_id) as v from reference_output) select 'distinct_location_count' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the number of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(distinct order_month) as v from model_output), r as (select count(distinct order_month) as v from reference_output) select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the count of rows with a null revenue_pretax value in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where revenue_pretax is null), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where revenue_pretax is null) select 'null_revenue_pretax_count' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the count of rows with a null revenue_gross value in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where revenue_gross is null), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where revenue_gross is null) select 'null_revenue_gross_count' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the count of rows with a null order_count value in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where order_count is null), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where order_count is null) select 'null_order_count_count' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the number of duplicate (month, location) keys (total rows minus distinct keys) in each table.
sql: with m_total as (select count(*) as c from model_output), m_distinct as (select count(*) as c from (select distinct order_month, location_id from model_output) t), r_total as (select count(*) as c from reference_output), r_distinct as (select count(*) as c from (select distinct order_month, location_id from reference_output) t) select 'duplicate_rows' as slice, (m_total.c - m_distinct.c) as model_value, (r_total.c - r_distinct.c) as reference_value from m_total, m_distinct, r_total, r_distinct

description: Compares the single highest revenue_gross value in each table, exposing outliers.
sql: with m as (select max(revenue_gross) as v from model_output), r as (select max(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output) select 'max_revenue_gross' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the single lowest revenue_gross value in each table, exposing negative or zero-revenue anomalies.
sql: with m as (select min(revenue_gross) as v from model_output), r as (select min(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output) select 'min_revenue_gross' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the average number of orders per distinct location, sensitive to location-count mismatches.
sql: with m as (select sum(order_count) * 1.0 / nullif(count(distinct location_id),0) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(order_count) * 1.0 / nullif(count(distinct location_id),0) as v from reference_output) select 'avg_orders_per_location' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compares the number of rows (months present) per location_id, exposing missing or duplicated month rows.
sql: with m as (select location_id, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares the number of rows (locations present) per order_month, exposing missing or duplicated location rows.
sql: with m as (select strftime(order_month,'%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select strftime(order_month,'%Y-%m') as ym, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.ym, r.ym) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.ym = r.ym

description: Compares grand total revenue_gross across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares grand total revenue_pretax across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_pretax) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_pretax) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares grand total order_count across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares total number of rows (month x location keys) in each table.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares count of distinct (order_month, location_id) keys to detect grain duplication.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_month, location_id FROM model_output) t) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_month, location_id FROM reference_output) t) AS reference_value

description: Compares revenue_gross totals per location_id.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares revenue_pretax totals per location_id.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_pretax) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_pretax) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares order_count totals per location_id.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares revenue_gross totals per calendar month across all locations.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compares revenue_pretax totals per calendar month across all locations.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_pretax) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_pretax) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compares order_count totals per calendar month across all locations.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compares revenue_gross at full model grain of month x location to catch localized discrepancies.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares order_count at full model grain of month x location to catch localized discrepancies, e.g. refund join fan-out.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares revenue_gross totals rolled up to calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.q AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.q AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q

description: Compares revenue_gross totals rolled up to calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.y AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.y AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.y = r.y

description: Compares revenue_gross for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MIN(order_month) AS min_m FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) t) SELECT 'first_month_' || CAST(b.min_m AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM model_output WHERE order_month = b.min_m) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM reference_output WHERE order_month = b.min_m) AS reference_value FROM bounds b

description: Compares revenue_gross for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(order_month) AS max_m FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) t) SELECT 'last_month_' || CAST(b.max_m AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM model_output WHERE order_month = b.max_m) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM reference_output WHERE order_month = b.max_m) AS reference_value FROM bounds b

description: Compares order_count for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MIN(order_month) AS min_m FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) t) SELECT 'first_month_' || CAST(b.min_m AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM model_output WHERE order_month = b.min_m) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM reference_output WHERE order_month = b.min_m) AS reference_value FROM bounds b

description: Compares order_count for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(order_month) AS max_m FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) t) SELECT 'last_month_' || CAST(b.max_m AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM model_output WHERE order_month = b.max_m) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM reference_output WHERE order_month = b.max_m) AS reference_value FROM bounds b

description: Flags rows whose order_month is not truncated to the first day of the month, indicating a date_trunc bug.
sql: SELECT 'non_first_day_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM order_month) <> 1) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM order_month) <> 1) AS reference_value

description: Compares row counts per location_id to find locations present in only one table.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.c AS model_value, r.c AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares row counts per order_month to find months present in only one table.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, COUNT(*) AS c FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, COUNT(*) AS c FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.c AS model_value, r.c AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compares row counts per (order_month, location_id) key to find keys missing from either table.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT order_month, location_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.c AS model_value, r.c AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares row counts per (location_id, location_name) pair to catch inconsistent or mismatched location names.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, location_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT location_id, location_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.location_name, r.location_name) AS slice, m.c AS model_value, r.c AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id AND m.location_name = r.location_name

description: Counts keys that appear more than once in each table, which would violate the stated grain.
sql: SELECT 'duplicate_key_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_month, location_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_month, location_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t) AS reference_value

description: Counts rows with a null location_id in each table.
sql: SELECT 'null_location_id_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE location_id IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE location_id IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Counts rows with a null order_month in each table.
sql: SELECT 'null_order_month_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE order_month IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE order_month IS NULL) AS reference_value

description: Compares overall average revenue_gross per order (sum/sum to avoid divide-by-zero distortion).
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares average revenue_gross per order by location, exposing fan-out or missing-order distortions.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_gross) AS g, SUM(order_count) AS c FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_gross) AS g, SUM(order_count) AS c FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.g * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.c, 0) AS model_value, r.g * 1.0 / NULLIF(r.c, 0) AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Compares overall implied tax rate, (gross - pretax) / pretax, across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_pretax), 0) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_pretax), 0) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares implied tax rate by month to catch tax calculation drift over time.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) AS g, SUM(revenue_pretax) AS p FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) AS g, SUM(revenue_pretax) AS p FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.g * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.p, 0) AS model_value, r.g * 1.0 / NULLIF(r.p, 0) AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Compares total tax amount (revenue_gross minus revenue_pretax) across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Compares total tax amount (revenue_gross minus revenue_pretax) by location_id.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT location_id, SUM(revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.location_id, r.location_id) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.location_id = r.location_id

description: Grand total of revenue_gross
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue_gross in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_gross
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue_gross in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total order_count across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total revenue_pretax across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare grand total revenue_gross across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total number of rows (grain cells) in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total order_count per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_pretax per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_gross per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by slice

description: Compare total order_count per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_pretax per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_gross per calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by slice

description: Compare order_count at full grain (month x location) to catch fan-out or cell-level errors.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, location_name, order_count from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, location_name, order_count from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_gross per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by slice

description: Compare total revenue_gross per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by slice

description: Flag location_ids present in only one of the two tables.
sql: with m as (select distinct location_id from model_output), r as (select distinct location_id from reference_output) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, case when m.location_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.location_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id where m.location_id is null or r.location_id is null

description: Flag calendar months present in only one of the two tables.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Count of (month, location) keys present in model but missing from reference, and vice versa.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, location_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, location_id from reference_output) select 'unmatched_keys' as slice, (select count(*) from m left join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where r.location_id is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from r left join m on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where m.location_id is null) as reference_value

description: Compare revenue_gross for the earliest calendar month present in either table (partial/edge period risk).
sql: with d as (select min(order_month) as fm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'first_month_revenue_gross' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output, d where model_output.order_month = d.fm) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output, d where reference_output.order_month = d.fm) as reference_value

description: Compare revenue_gross for the latest calendar month present in either table (partial/edge period risk).
sql: with d as (select max(order_month) as lm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'last_month_revenue_gross' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output, d where model_output.order_month = d.lm) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output, d where reference_output.order_month = d.lm) as reference_value

description: Compare order_count for the earliest calendar month present in either table.
sql: with d as (select min(order_month) as fm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'first_month_order_count' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output, d where model_output.order_month = d.fm) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output, d where reference_output.order_month = d.fm) as reference_value

description: Compare order_count for the latest calendar month present in either table.
sql: with d as (select max(order_month) as lm from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output) t) select 'last_month_order_count' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output, d where model_output.order_month = d.lm) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output, d where reference_output.order_month = d.lm) as reference_value

description: Compare overall average order value (revenue_gross / order_count) to catch distortions from fan-out or weighting errors.
sql: select 'avg_order_value' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare average order value per location.
sql: with m as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select location_id, location_name, sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by slice

description: Compare the overall ratio of revenue_pretax to revenue_gross, a proxy for implied tax rate consistency.
sql: select 'pretax_to_gross_ratio' as slice, (select sum(revenue_pretax) / sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_pretax) / sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the ratio of revenue_pretax to revenue_gross per calendar month.
