sql: with m as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, case when m.cnt is null or m.cnt = 0 then null else m.rev / m.cnt end as model_value, case when r.cnt is null or r.cnt = 0 then null else r.rev / r.cnt end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Average gross revenue per order by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as rev, sum(order_count) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, case when m.cnt is null or m.cnt = 0 then null else m.rev / m.cnt end as model_value, case when r.cnt is null or r.cnt = 0 then null else r.rev / r.cnt end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Implied tax rate overall: (revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / revenue_pretax.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from reference_output) select 'tax_rate_total' as slice, (m.g - m.p) / m.p as model_value, (r.g - r.p) / r.p as reference_value from m, r

description: Implied tax rate by calendar month: (revenue_gross - revenue_pretax) / revenue_pretax.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as g, sum(revenue_pretax) as p from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, case when m.p is null or m.p = 0 then null else (m.g - m.p) / m.p end as model_value, case when r.p is null or r.p = 0 then null else (r.g - r.p) / r.p end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Counts of (order_month, location_id) keys that exist only in model_output vs only in reference_output; both should be zero.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, location_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, location_id from reference_output), only_m as (select m.* from m left join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where r.order_month is null), only_r as (select r.* from r left join m on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id where m.order_month is null) select 'only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from only_m) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from only_r) as reference_value

description: Count of location_id values where the location_name differs between model and reference.
sql: with m as (select distinct location_id, location_name as name from model_output), r as (select distinct location_id, location_name as name from reference_output) select 'location_name_mismatches' as slice, (select count(*) from m join r on m.location_id = r.location_id where m.name <> r.name) as model_value, 0 as reference_value

description: Row-level comparison of revenue_gross at the native (order_month, location_id) grain.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_gross as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Row-level comparison of revenue_pretax at the native (order_month, location_id) grain.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_pretax as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, revenue_pretax as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Row-level comparison of order_count at the native (order_month, location_id) grain.
sql: with m as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, location_id, order_count as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Count of rows whose order_month is not truncated to the first day of the month (should be zero in both).
sql: select 'order_month_not_first_of_month' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where extract(day from order_month) <> 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where extract(day from order_month) <> 1) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative revenue_gross or revenue_pretax, a potential refund-handling bug indicator.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0 or revenue_pretax < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0 or revenue_pretax < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where order_count is zero or null but the row still exists, which would be unexpected at this grain.
sql: select 'zero_or_null_order_count_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count is null or order_count = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count is null or order_count = 0) as reference_value

description: Total order_count per location_name, to catch id-vs-name mapping discrepancies.
sql: with m as (select location_name, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_name, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_name, r.location_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_name = r.location_name order by 1

description: Total tax amount implied (sum revenue_gross - sum revenue_pretax).
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) - sum(revenue_pretax) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) - sum(revenue_pretax) as v from reference_output) select 'revenue_gross_minus_pretax_total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Number of month-rows present per location_id, exposing partial month coverage differences.
sql: with m as (select location_id, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select location_id, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.location_id, r.location_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.location_id = r.location_id order by 1

description: Grand total of customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of customers
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(customers) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of customers in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(customers) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(customers) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Compare total revenue across all rows.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare total customers (summed, not deduped) across all rows.
sql: with m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare total order count across all rows.
sql: with m as (select sum(order_count) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(order_count) as v from reference_output) select 'total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare total number of rows in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output) select 'row_count' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare total revenue split by customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare total customers split by customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare total order_count split by customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare total revenue by calendar month across both customer types.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare total customers by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare total order_count by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare revenue at full grain of month and customer_type.
sql: with m as (select order_month, customer_type, revenue_gross as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, customer_type, revenue_gross as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Compare customers at full grain of month and customer_type.
sql: with m as (select order_month, customer_type, customers as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, customer_type, customers as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Compare order_count at full grain of month and customer_type.
sql: with m as (select order_month, customer_type, order_count as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, customer_type, order_count as v from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Identify (month, customer_type) key combos present in one table but not the other.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, customer_type from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, customer_type from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Compare revenue in the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) select 'first_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare revenue in the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mx), r as (select sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx) select 'last_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare customers in the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) select 'first_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare customers in the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mx), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx) select 'last_month' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: In the earliest month, returning customers should be zero/absent; check new-customer count matches.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn and model_output.customer_type = 'new'), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn and reference_output.customer_type = 'new') select 'first_month_new' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: In the earliest month, returning customer count should be zero in both tables (or absent).
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn and model_output.customer_type = 'returning'), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn and reference_output.customer_type = 'returning') select 'first_month_returning' as slice, coalesce(m.v,0) as model_value, coalesce(r.v,0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare overall average order value (revenue / order_count) to detect fan-out or rounding distortion.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) as v from reference_output) select 'avg_order_value_total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare average order value by customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross)*1.0/sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare orders per customer ratio overall to detect distinct-count distortions.
sql: with m as (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(customers) as v from model_output), r as (select sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(customers) as v from reference_output) select 'orders_per_customer_total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare orders per customer ratio by customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(order_count)*1.0/sum(customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare the share of customers classified as new within each month, a sensitive ratio for first-order classification bugs.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(case when customer_type='new' then customers else 0 end)*1.0/sum(customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(case when customer_type='new' then customers else 0 end)*1.0/sum(customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare share of revenue from new customers within each month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(case when customer_type='new' then revenue_gross else 0 end)*1.0/sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(case when customer_type='new' then revenue_gross else 0 end)*1.0/sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare the number of distinct order_month values present in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(distinct order_month) as v from model_output), r as (select count(distinct order_month) as v from reference_output) select 'distinct_months' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare the number of distinct customer_type values present in each table.
sql: with m as (select count(distinct customer_type) as v from model_output), r as (select count(distinct customer_type) as v from reference_output) select 'distinct_customer_types' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Check for rows with null/unexpected customer_type values in either table.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where customer_type is null or customer_type not in ('new','returning')), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where customer_type is null or customer_type not in ('new','returning')) select 'unexpected_customer_type_rows' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Check for any rows with negative revenue_gross, which would indicate refund leakage.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where revenue_gross < 0), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) select 'negative_revenue_rows' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Check for rows where order_count is zero but customers > 0, an inconsistency flag.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where order_count = 0 and customers > 0), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where order_count = 0 and customers > 0) select 'zero_order_inconsistent_rows' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Check for rows where distinct customers exceed order_count, which should be impossible.
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from model_output where customers > order_count), r as (select count(*) as v from reference_output where customers > order_count) select 'customers_gt_orders_rows' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare total revenue aggregated by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare total customers aggregated by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare total revenue aggregated by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Compare order_count aggregated by year and customer_type.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, customer_type, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, customer_type, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Compare the row with maximum revenue_gross in model_output to the same key's value in reference_output, to catch outlier/precision issues.
sql: with mx as (select order_month, customer_type from model_output order by revenue_gross desc limit 1), m as (select o.revenue_gross as v from model_output o join mx on o.order_month = mx.order_month and o.customer_type = mx.customer_type), r as (select o.revenue_gross as v from reference_output o join mx on o.order_month = mx.order_month and o.customer_type = mx.customer_type) select 'max_revenue_row' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare total revenue computed with higher precision to detect decimal rounding drift across many small rows.
sql: with m as (select cast(sum(revenue_gross) as double) as v from model_output), r as (select cast(sum(revenue_gross) as double) as v from reference_output) select 'revenue_precision_total' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare count of months that have both new and returning rows present (checking classification completeness).
sql: with m as (select count(*) as v from (select order_month from model_output group by order_month having count(distinct customer_type) = 2)), r as (select count(*) as v from (select order_month from reference_output group by order_month having count(distinct customer_type) = 2)) select 'months_with_both_types' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare the sum of new customers over the last 3 available months, a boundary window check sensitive to classification drift near the end of the series.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output, bounds where model_output.customer_type='new' and model_output.order_month > bounds.mx - interval '3' month), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.customer_type='new' and reference_output.order_month > bounds.mx - interval '3' month) select 'new_customers_last_3_months' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on true

description: Compare total gross revenue across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total order count across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total customers summed across all rows (note: may double count repeat customers across months, but checks aggregate consistency).
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total number of rows in each table.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare total revenue by customer_type (new vs returning).
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare total order_count by customer_type.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select customer_type, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select customer_type, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare total customers by customer_type.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select customer_type, sum(customers) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select customer_type, sum(customers) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Compare total revenue per order_month across both customer types.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare total order_count per order_month across both customer types.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare total customers per order_month across both customer types.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, sum(customers) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(customers) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare revenue at full grain of order_month x customer_type.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.revenue_gross as model_value, r.revenue_gross as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Compare order_count at full grain of order_month x customer_type.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.order_count as model_value, r.order_count as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Compare customers at full grain of order_month x customer_type.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.customers as model_value, r.customers as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Identify (order_month, customer_type) keys present in one table but not the other.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from (select distinct order_month, customer_type from model_output) m full outer join (select distinct order_month, customer_type from reference_output) r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Identify order_month values present in one table but not the other.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from (select distinct order_month from model_output) m full outer join (select distinct order_month from reference_output) r on m.order_month = r.order_month where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Check the earliest order_month in either table: 'new' customers should dominate and 'returning' should be absent or minimal.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as min_m from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.customers as model_value, r.customers as reference_value from (select customer_type, customers, order_month from model_output) m full outer join (select customer_type, customers, order_month from reference_output) r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type, bounds where coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) = bounds.min_m

description: Check the latest order_month in either table for new vs returning customers split.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as max_m from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.customers as model_value, r.customers as reference_value from (select customer_type, customers, order_month from model_output) m full outer join (select customer_type, customers, order_month from reference_output) r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type, bounds where coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) = bounds.max_m

description: Edge case: in the very first month present, there should be zero 'returning' customers since no prior history exists; verify both tables agree (ideally both zero/absent).
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as min_m from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'returning_in_first_month' as slice, coalesce((select sum(customers) from model_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.min_m and customer_type = 'returning'), 0) as model_value, coalesce((select sum(customers) from reference_output, bounds where order_month = bounds.min_m and customer_type = 'returning'), 0) as reference_value

description: Total distinct-customer count (summed monthly) for 'new' type only, a proxy for lifetime unique first-time customers.
sql: select 'new_total' as slice, (select sum(customers) from model_output where customer_type = 'new') as model_value, (select sum(customers) from reference_output where customer_type = 'new') as reference_value

description: Total customers summed monthly for 'returning' type only.
sql: select 'returning_total' as slice, (select sum(customers) from model_output where customer_type = 'returning') as model_value, (select sum(customers) from reference_output where customer_type = 'returning') as reference_value

description: Average order value overall (total revenue / total order count) to catch distortions from join fan-out or missing orders.
sql: select 'avg_order_value_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output) / nullif((select sum(order_count) from model_output), 0) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output) / nullif((select sum(order_count) from reference_output), 0) as reference_value

description: Average order value by customer_type to detect if revenue/order misallocation is specific to new or returning.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(order_count),0) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(order_count),0) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Average orders per customer by type, sensitive to double counting or missing distinct customer logic.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select customer_type, sum(order_count)/nullif(sum(customers),0) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select customer_type, sum(order_count)/nullif(sum(customers),0) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Monthly revenue per customer by type, to detect subtle mismatches in both numerator and denominator simultaneously.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.revenue_gross/nullif(m.customers,0) as model_value, r.revenue_gross/nullif(r.customers,0) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Compare total revenue aggregated by calendar year.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compare total order_count aggregated by calendar year.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compare total customers aggregated by calendar year.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(customers) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(customers) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.yr = r.yr order by 1

description: Compare total revenue aggregated by calendar quarter.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare total order_count aggregated by calendar quarter.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(order_count) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(order_count) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Check for rows with null/unexpected customer_type values in either table.
sql: select 'null_or_unexpected_type' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customer_type is null or customer_type not in ('new','returning')) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customer_type is null or customer_type not in ('new','returning')) as reference_value

description: Check for rows with negative revenue_gross, which could indicate improper refund inclusion.
sql: select 'negative_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross < 0) as reference_value

description: Check for rows with zero or null order_count, which should not exist at this grain.
sql: select 'zero_or_null_order_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where order_count is null or order_count = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where order_count is null or order_count = 0) as reference_value

description: Compare the count of distinct order_month values present in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the count of distinct customer_type values present in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_type_count' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_type) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_type) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare revenue for the trailing 12 months from the max month present, a common dashboard window that may expose recent data issues.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as max_m from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.model_value, r.reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as model_value from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as reference_value from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month, bounds where coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) >= bounds.max_m - interval '11 months' order by 1

description: Compare the month matching today's date (2026-10) if present, a partial/in-progress period likely to reveal timing issues.
sql: select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.customers as model_value, r.customers as reference_value from (select customer_type, customers from model_output where order_month = date_trunc('month', date '2026-10-01')) m full outer join (select customer_type, customers from reference_output where order_month = date_trunc('month', date '2026-10-01')) r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Check for small rounding/precision differences between decimal(18,2) model output and double reference output at full grain.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, round(m.revenue_gross, 2) as model_value, round(r.revenue_gross, 2) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Check for any rows where distinct customers exceed order_count, which would be logically impossible and signal a join fan-out bug.
sql: select 'customers_gt_orders' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customers > order_count) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customers > order_count) as reference_value

description: Share of total revenue attributable to 'new' customers, a ratio sensitive to misclassification between new/returning.
sql: select 'new_revenue_share' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where customer_type='new') / nullif((select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output),0) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where customer_type='new') / nullif((select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output),0) as reference_value

description: Share of total summed customers attributable to 'new', sensitive to classification logic errors around first-order month.
sql: select 'new_customers_share' as slice, (select sum(customers) from model_output where customer_type='new') / nullif((select sum(customers) from model_output),0) as model_value, (select sum(customers) from reference_output where customer_type='new') / nullif((select sum(customers) from reference_output),0) as reference_value

description: Grand total of the customers column summed across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(customers) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(customers) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of order_count summed across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue_gross summed across all rows.
sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

sql: SELECT 'row_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

description: Total customers summed by customer_type.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Total order_count summed by customer_type.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Total revenue_gross summed by customer_type.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Customers summed by month across all customer types.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month ORDER BY 1

description: Order_count summed by month across all customer types.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month ORDER BY 1

description: Revenue_gross summed by month across all customer types.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month ORDER BY 1

description: Customers at full grain: month and customer_type.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, customer_type, SUM(customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT order_month, customer_type, SUM(customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.customer_type = r.customer_type ORDER BY 1

description: Order_count at full grain: month and customer_type.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, customer_type, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT order_month, customer_type, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.customer_type = r.customer_type ORDER BY 1

description: Revenue_gross at full grain: month and customer_type.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, customer_type, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT order_month, customer_type, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.customer_type = r.customer_type ORDER BY 1

description: Customers summed by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.q AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.q AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q ORDER BY 1

description: Order_count summed by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.q AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.q AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q ORDER BY 1

description: Revenue_gross summed by calendar quarter.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_month) AS q, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.q AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.q AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q ORDER BY 1

description: Customers summed by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(customers) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(customers) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.y AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.y AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.y = r.y ORDER BY 1

description: Order_count summed by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(order_count) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.y AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.y AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.y = r.y ORDER BY 1

description: Revenue_gross summed by calendar year.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', order_month) AS y, SUM(revenue_gross) AS v FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.y AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.y AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.v AS model_value, r.v AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.y = r.y ORDER BY 1

description: Customers total for the earliest order_month seen across both tables.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MIN(order_month) AS min_m FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION ALL SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) u) SELECT 'first_month' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(customers) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE model_output.order_month = bounds.min_m) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(customers) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE reference_output.order_month = bounds.min_m) AS reference_value

description: Order_count total for the earliest order_month seen across both tables.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MIN(order_month) AS min_m FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION ALL SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) u) SELECT 'first_month' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE model_output.order_month = bounds.min_m) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE reference_output.order_month = bounds.min_m) AS reference_value

description: Revenue_gross total for the earliest order_month seen across both tables.
sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MIN(order_month) AS min_m FROM (SELECT order_month FROM model_output UNION ALL SELECT order_month FROM reference_output) u) SELECT 'first_month' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM model_output, bounds WHERE model_output.order_month = bounds.min_m) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(revenue_gross) FROM reference_output, bounds WHERE reference_output.order_month = bounds.min_m) AS reference_value

description: Customers total for the latest order_month seen across both tables.

description: Order count by calendar year, summed across customer types.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

sql: with mn as (select min(order_month) as mo from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mo from mn)), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mo from mn)) select 'first_period' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Customers total in the latest month present across both tables.
sql: with mx as (select max(order_month) as mo from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(customers) as v from model_output where order_month = (select mo from mx)), r as (select sum(customers) as v from reference_output where order_month = (select mo from mx)) select 'last_period' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: First month should contain only 'new' customers; checks returning count is zero/absent in first month.
sql: with mn as (select min(order_month) as mo from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month_returning' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(customers),0) from model_output where order_month=(select mo from mn) and customer_type='returning') as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(customers),0) from reference_output where order_month=(select mo from mn) and customer_type='returning') as reference_value

description: Total row count comparison between model and reference outputs.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_month values present in each table.

description: Months present in model_output but missing from reference_output (reference_value will be NULL/0).
sql: select cast(m.order_month as varchar) as slice, count(*) as model_value, cast(null as bigint) as reference_value from model_output m left join (select distinct order_month from reference_output) r on m.order_month = r.order_month where r.order_month is null group by 1 order by 1

description: Months present in reference_output but missing from model_output (model_value will be NULL/0).
sql: select cast(r.order_month as varchar) as slice, cast(null as bigint) as model_value, count(*) as reference_value from reference_output r left join (select distinct order_month from model_output) m on r.order_month = m.order_month where m.order_month is null group by 1 order by 1

description: Full outer join on (order_month, customer_type) key, counting presence (1) on each side to surface missing keys.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar),cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null order by 1

description: Distinct set of customer_type values present in each table (checks for unexpected labels).
sql: with mt as (select distinct customer_type from model_output), rt as (select distinct customer_type from reference_output) select coalesce(mt.customer_type, rt.customer_type) as slice, case when mt.customer_type is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when rt.customer_type is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from mt full outer join rt on mt.customer_type = rt.customer_type order by 1

description: Average revenue per order overall (revenue_gross / order_count), exposing distortions from fan-out or nulls.
sql: select 'avg_revenue_per_order' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(order_count),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(order_count),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average revenue per customer overall (revenue_gross / customers).
sql: select 'avg_revenue_per_customer' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(customers),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)/nullif(sum(customers),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average orders per customer for 'new' customer type, exposing fan-out distortions.
sql: select 'new' as slice, (select sum(order_count)/nullif(sum(customers),0) from model_output where customer_type='new') as model_value, (select sum(order_count)/nullif(sum(customers),0) from reference_output where customer_type='new') as reference_value

description: Average orders per customer for 'returning' customer type, exposing fan-out distortions.
sql: select 'returning' as slice, (select sum(order_count)/nullif(sum(customers),0) from model_output where customer_type='returning') as model_value, (select sum(order_count)/nullif(sum(customers),0) from reference_output where customer_type='returning') as reference_value

description: Share of total customers classified as 'new' - exposes classification boundary errors.
sql: select 'share_new' as slice, (select sum(customers) from model_output where customer_type='new')*1.0/nullif((select sum(customers) from model_output),0) as model_value, (select sum(customers) from reference_output where customer_type='new')*1.0/nullif((select sum(customers) from reference_output),0) as reference_value

description: Revenue per order by month for 'new' customer type, exposing per-period distortions.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar),cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.revenue_gross/nullif(m.order_count,0) as model_value, r.revenue_gross/nullif(r.order_count,0) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type and m.customer_type='new' where m.customer_type='new' or r.customer_type='new' order by 1

description: Revenue per order by month for 'returning' customer type, exposing per-period distortions.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar),cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.revenue_gross/nullif(m.order_count,0) as model_value, r.revenue_gross/nullif(r.order_count,0) as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type and m.customer_type='returning' where m.customer_type='returning' or r.customer_type='returning' order by 1

description: Sum of per-month-type customers vs max possible (sanity bound) - compares model total customer-months to reference total customer-months.
sql: select 'total_customer_months' as slice, (select sum(customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where order_count is zero or null but customers > 0 (data quality edge case), compared between tables.
sql: select 'zero_order_nonzero_customer_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where (order_count = 0 or order_count is null) and customers > 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where (order_count = 0 or order_count is null) and customers > 0) as reference_value

description: Total revenue by customer_type.

description: Total customers (summed) by customer_type.

description: Total order_count by customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Revenue by month, comparing model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue_gross) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Customers (summed) by month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Order count by month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Revenue by month and customer_type (full grain).
sql: with m as (select order_month, customer_type, revenue_gross as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, customer_type, revenue_gross as v from reference_output) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type order by 1

description: Order count by month and customer_type (full grain).

sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, customer_type from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, customer_type from reference_output) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar || ' | ' || coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.customer_type = r.customer_type where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Number of distinct order_month values in each table.

sql: select 'distinct_customer_type_count' as slice, (select count(distinct customer_type) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct customer_type) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Revenue in the earliest month present in either table.
sql: with mn as (select min(order_month) as mo from model_output), rn as (select min(order_month) as mo from reference_output), allmin as (select least(coalesce((select mo from mn), (select mo from rn)), coalesce((select mo from rn), (select mo from mn))) as mo) select 'first_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = (select mo from allmin)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = (select mo from allmin)) as reference_value

description: Revenue in the latest month present in either table.
sql: with mn as (select max(order_month) as mo from model_output), rn as (select max(order_month) as mo from reference_output), allmax as (select greatest(coalesce((select mo from mn), (select mo from rn)), coalesce((select mo from rn), (select mo from mn))) as mo) select 'last_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where order_month = (select mo from allmax)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where order_month = (select mo from allmax)) as reference_value

description: Minimum order_month value in each table (date boundary check, cast to epoch days).

description: Maximum order_month value in each table (date boundary check, cast to epoch days).

description: Total 'returning' customers summed across all months.
sql: select 'returning_customers_total' as slice, (select sum(customers) from model_output where customer_type = 'returning') as model_value, (select sum(customers) from reference_output where customer_type = 'returning') as reference_value

description: Total revenue from 'new' customers.
sql: select 'new_revenue_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where customer_type = 'new') as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where customer_type = 'new') as reference_value

description: Total revenue from 'returning' customers.
sql: select 'returning_revenue_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) from model_output where customer_type = 'returning') as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) from reference_output where customer_type = 'returning') as reference_value

description: Total order_count from 'new' customers.

description: Total order_count from 'returning' customers.
sql: select 'returning_orders_total' as slice, (select sum(order_count) from model_output where customer_type = 'returning') as model_value, (select sum(order_count) from reference_output where customer_type = 'returning') as reference_value

description: Overall average order value (revenue/order_count) across all rows, checking for distortion from nulls or fan-out.
sql: select 'avg_order_value_overall' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross) / sum(order_count) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average order value per customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(revenue_gross)/sum(order_count) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Overall orders per customer ratio (order_count/customers), sensitive to fan-out or double counting.
sql: select 'orders_per_customer_overall' as slice, (select sum(order_count)::double / sum(customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(order_count)::double / sum(customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Orders per customer ratio by customer_type.
sql: with m as (select customer_type, sum(order_count)::double/sum(customers) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select customer_type, sum(order_count)::double/sum(customers) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.customer_type, r.customer_type) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.customer_type = r.customer_type

description: Overall revenue per customer ratio.
sql: select 'revenue_per_customer_overall' as slice, (select sum(revenue_gross)/sum(customers) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue_gross)/sum(customers) from reference_output) as reference_value

sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(case when customer_type='new' then customers else 0 end)::double / nullif(sum(customers),0) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(case when customer_type='new' then customers else 0 end)::double / nullif(sum(customers),0) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Count of rows with zero or negative revenue, which could indicate refund leakage.
sql: select 'nonpositive_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue_gross <= 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue_gross <= 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where any measure is null, which could distort ratios/sums.
sql: select 'null_measure_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where customers is null or order_count is null or revenue_gross is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where customers is null or order_count is null or revenue_gross is null) as reference_value

description: Months that have a 'returning' row but no 'new' row (potential missing new-customer detection), compared across tables.
sql: with m as (select order_month from model_output where customer_type='returning' and order_month not in (select order_month from model_output where customer_type='new')), r as (select order_month from reference_output where customer_type='returning' and order_month not in (select order_month from reference_output where customer_type='new')) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Revenue aggregated by calendar quarter.

sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_month, product_id FROM model_output), r AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_month, product_id FROM reference_output) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.order_month AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.order_month AS VARCHAR)) || ' | ' || COALESCE(m.product_id, r.product_id) AS slice, CASE WHEN m.order_month IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS model_value, CASE WHEN r.order_month IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.order_month = r.order_month AND m.product_id = r.product_id WHERE m.order_month IS NULL OR r.order_month IS NULL LIMIT 5000

sql: with m as (select distinct order_month from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month from reference_output) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Full grain (order_month, product_id) keys present in only one table (presence indicator 1/0).
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, product_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, product_id from reference_output) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null

description: Overall average revenue per unit sold (sum revenue / sum units).
sql: select 'overall' as slice, (select sum(revenue)/sum(units_sold)::double from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue)/sum(units_sold)::double from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average revenue per unit sold by product_id, exposes fan-out or join distortions.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue)/sum(units_sold)::double as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue)/sum(units_sold)::double as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Overall gross margin ratio (sum gross_margin / sum revenue).
sql: select 'overall' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin)/sum(revenue)::double from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin)/sum(revenue)::double from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Gross margin ratio by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin)/sum(revenue)::double as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin)/sum(revenue)::double as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Count of distinct product_name values per product_id, should be 1 on both sides; mismatches flag naming inconsistency.
sql: with m as (select product_id, count(distinct product_name) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, count(distinct product_name) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Count of (order_month, product_id) combos appearing more than once (should be 0).
sql: select 'duplicate_keys' as slice, (select count(*) from (select order_month, product_id from model_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1)) as model_value, (select count(*) from (select order_month, product_id from reference_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1)) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with null revenue in each table.
sql: select 'null_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue is null) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct product_id values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_products' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Earliest order_month in each table, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: select 'min_order_month' as slice, (select min(order_month) - date '1970-01-01' from model_output) as model_value, (select min(order_month) - date '1970-01-01' from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Latest order_month in each table, expressed as days since epoch for numeric comparison.
sql: select 'max_order_month' as slice, (select max(order_month) - date '1970-01-01' from model_output) as model_value, (select max(order_month) - date '1970-01-01' from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with units_sold = 0 in each table.
sql: select 'zero_units_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where units_sold = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where units_sold = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative gross_margin in each table.
sql: select 'negative_margin_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Revenue at the full (order_month, product_id) grain to catch errors masked by aggregation.
sql: with m as (select order_month, product_id, revenue as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, product_id, revenue as v from reference_output) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Gross margin at the full (order_month, product_id) grain to catch errors masked by aggregation.
sql: with m as (select order_month, product_id, gross_margin as v from model_output), r as (select order_month, product_id, gross_margin as v from reference_output) select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id
