description: Counts of grain keys (month, product) present on only one side.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, product_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, product_id from reference_output), only_model as (select count(*) as cnt from m left join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where r.order_month is null), only_ref as (select count(*) as cnt from r left join m on r.order_month = m.order_month and r.product_id = m.product_id where m.order_month is null) select 'only_in_model' as slice, (select cnt from only_model) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select cnt from only_ref) as reference_value

description: Total revenue by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total units sold by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total supply cost by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total gross margin by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total revenue by order_month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Total units sold by order_month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Total revenue by product_name, treating NULLs as their own bucket to catch naming/join mismatches.
sql: with m as (select coalesce(product_name, '<NULL>') as pname, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select coalesce(product_name, '<NULL>') as pname, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.pname, r.pname) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.pname = r.pname

description: Revenue total for the first and last order_month in each table (boundary periods).
sql: select 'first_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where order_month = (select min(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where order_month = (select min(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value union all select 'last_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where order_month = (select max(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where order_month = (select max(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Total revenue rolled up by year.
sql: with m as (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select extract(year from order_month) as yr, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.yr as varchar), cast(r.yr as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.yr = r.yr

description: Total revenue rolled up by quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as qtr, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as qtr, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.qtr as varchar), cast(r.qtr as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.qtr = r.qtr

description: Average revenue per unit sold by product_id, sensitive to join fan-out.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Overall average supply cost per unit sold.
sql: select 'avg_supply_cost_per_unit' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost) / sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost) / sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall gross margin ratio (sum(gross_margin)/sum(revenue)).
sql: select 'gross_margin_ratio' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Gross margin ratio by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Count of distinct product_id values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_product_id_count' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_order_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

sql: select 'null_product_name_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where product_name is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where product_name is null) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative revenue (data quality / refund leakage check).

description: Count of rows with negative supply_cost.
sql: select 'negative_supply_cost_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where supply_cost < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where supply_cost < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative gross_margin.
sql: select 'negative_gross_margin_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Latest order_month present in each table, as epoch seconds for numeric comparison.
sql: select 'max_order_month' as slice, (select date_part('epoch', cast(max(order_month) as timestamp)) from model_output) as model_value, (select date_part('epoch', cast(max(order_month) as timestamp)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Earliest order_month present in each table, as epoch seconds for numeric comparison.

description: Units sold summed only over rows where revenue is null, to catch silently dropped revenue.

description: Average units_sold per (month, product) row, sensitive to grain duplication.
sql: select 'avg_units_sold_per_row' as slice, (select avg(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select avg(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total gross margin rolled up by quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as qtr, sum(gross_margin) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as qtr, sum(gross_margin) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.qtr as varchar), cast(r.qtr as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.qtr = r.qtr

description: Compare total revenue per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) q, sum(revenue) v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) q, sum(revenue) v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare total units sold per calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) q, sum(units_sold) v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) q, sum(units_sold) v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compare total revenue per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) y, sum(revenue) v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) y, sum(revenue) v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Compare total gross margin per calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) y, sum(gross_margin) v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) y, sum(gross_margin) v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Compare revenue for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with minm as (select min(order_month) mn from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue) v from model_output, minm where order_month = minm.mn), r as (select sum(revenue) v from reference_output, minm where order_month = minm.mn) select 'first_month_revenue' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare revenue for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with maxm as (select max(order_month) mx from (select order_month from model_output union all select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue) v from model_output, maxm where order_month = maxm.mx), r as (select sum(revenue) v from reference_output, maxm where order_month = maxm.mx) select 'last_month_revenue' as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare the earliest order_month value (as days since epoch) to catch boundary truncation/timezone issues.
sql: select 'min_order_month' as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select min(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select min(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Compare the latest order_month value (as days since epoch) to catch boundary truncation/timezone issues.
sql: select 'max_order_month' as slice, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select max(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, date_diff('day', date '1970-01-01', (select max(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Count of (order_month, product_id) keys present in model_output but missing from reference_output.
sql: select 'keys_in_model_not_reference' as slice, (select count(*) from (select order_month, product_id from model_output except select order_month, product_id from reference_output)) as model_value, 0 as reference_value

description: Count of (order_month, product_id) keys present in reference_output but missing from model_output.
sql: select 'keys_in_reference_not_model' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from (select order_month, product_id from reference_output except select order_month, product_id from model_output)) as reference_value

description: Compare the number of distinct product_id values covered by each output.
sql: select 'distinct_product_count' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare the number of distinct order_month values covered by each output.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compare overall average revenue per unit sold, sensitive to join fan-out or missing items.
sql: with m as (select sum(revenue) rev, sum(units_sold) u from model_output), r as (select sum(revenue) rev, sum(units_sold) u from reference_output) select 'avg_revenue_per_unit' as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.u, 0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.u, 0) as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare overall average supply cost per unit sold.
sql: with m as (select sum(supply_cost) sc, sum(units_sold) u from model_output), r as (select sum(supply_cost) sc, sum(units_sold) u from reference_output) select 'avg_supply_cost_per_unit' as slice, m.sc / nullif(m.u, 0) as model_value, r.sc / nullif(r.u, 0) as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare overall gross margin as a percentage of revenue.
sql: with m as (select sum(gross_margin) gm, sum(revenue) rev from model_output), r as (select sum(gross_margin) gm, sum(revenue) rev from reference_output) select 'margin_rate' as slice, m.gm / nullif(m.rev, 0) as model_value, r.gm / nullif(r.rev, 0) as reference_value from m, r

description: Compare gross margin as a percentage of revenue, per product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) gm, sum(revenue) rev from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) gm, sum(revenue) rev from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.gm / nullif(m.rev, 0) as model_value, r.gm / nullif(r.rev, 0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compare average revenue per unit sold, per product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) rev, sum(units_sold) u from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) rev, sum(units_sold) u from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.u, 0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.u, 0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compare count of rows with null revenue in each output.
sql: select 'null_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue is null) as reference_value

description: Compare count of rows with null supply_cost in each output.
sql: select 'null_supply_cost_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Compare count of rows with zero units_sold in each output.
sql: select 'zero_units_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where units_sold = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where units_sold = 0) as reference_value

description: Compare count of rows with negative gross_margin in each output.
sql: select 'negative_margin_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Compare the number of duplicate (order_month, product_id) keys in each output (should be zero if grain holds).
sql: select 'duplicate_keys' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) - (select count(*) from (select distinct order_month, product_id from model_output)) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) - (select count(*) from (select distinct order_month, product_id from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Count of matched keys where product_name differs between model and reference.
sql: select 'product_name_mismatches' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where m.product_name <> r.product_name) as model_value, 0 as reference_value

description: Compare number of distinct product rows reported per month, to catch fan-out or missing products.
sql: with m as (select order_month, count(*) c from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, count(*) c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compare number of month rows reported per product, to catch fan-out or missing months.
sql: with m as (select product_id, count(*) c from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, count(*) c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Grand total revenue across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total supply cost across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total gross margin across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total units sold across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total row count in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total revenue by product_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.rev as model_value, r.rev as reference_value from (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total supply cost by product_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total gross margin by product_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total units sold by product_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Row count by product_id to detect missing product keys.
sql: select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from (select product_id, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Total revenue by order_month.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Total supply cost by order_month.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Total gross margin by order_month.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Total units sold by order_month.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Row count by order_month to detect missing month coverage.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from (select order_month, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Total revenue by calendar year.
sql: select coalesce(date_part('year', m.order_month), date_part('year', r.order_month))::varchar as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month

description: Total revenue by calendar quarter.
sql: select coalesce(date_trunc('quarter', m.order_month), date_trunc('quarter', r.order_month))::varchar as slice, sum(m.val) as model_value, sum(r.val) as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month group by 1 order by 1

description: Revenue total for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mn as (select least(min(order_month), (select min(order_month) from reference_output)) as m from model_output) select 'first_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where order_month = (select m from mn)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where order_month = (select m from mn)) as reference_value

description: Revenue total for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mx as (select greatest(max(order_month), (select max(order_month) from reference_output)) as m from model_output) select 'last_month' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where order_month = (select m from mx)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where order_month = (select m from mx)) as reference_value

description: Units sold for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mn as (select least(min(order_month), (select min(order_month) from reference_output)) as m from model_output) select 'first_month' as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output where order_month = (select m from mn)) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output where order_month = (select m from mn)) as reference_value

description: Units sold for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with mx as (select greatest(max(order_month), (select max(order_month) from reference_output)) as m from model_output) select 'last_month' as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output where order_month = (select m from mx)) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output where order_month = (select m from mx)) as reference_value

description: Min and max order_month values compared as epoch days.
sql: select 'min_month' as slice, (select epoch(min(order_month)) from model_output) as model_value, (select epoch(min(order_month)) from reference_output) as reference_value union all select 'max_month' as slice, (select epoch(max(order_month)) from model_output) as model_value, (select epoch(max(order_month)) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Full key-grain coverage check: rows present in one table but not the other at (order_month, product_id) grain.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from (select order_month, product_id, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1,2) m full outer join (select order_month, product_id, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1,2) r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where m.cnt is null or r.cnt is null or m.cnt <> r.cnt

description: Distinct count of product_id values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_products' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Distinct count of order_month values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of rows where product_name differs for the same product_id between model and reference, aggregated per product_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.nm as model_value, r.nm as reference_value from (select product_id, max(product_name) as nm from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, max(product_name) as nm from reference_output group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id where m.nm is distinct from r.nm

description: Overall average revenue per unit sold (revenue/units_sold) to catch fan-out distortions.
sql: select 'avg_rev_per_unit' as slice, (select sum(revenue)/nullif(sum(units_sold),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue)/nullif(sum(units_sold),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall average supply cost per unit sold to catch join fan-out on supplies.
sql: select 'avg_cost_per_unit' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost)/nullif(sum(units_sold),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost)/nullif(sum(units_sold),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Gross margin rate (margin/revenue) by product_id.
sql: select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.rate as model_value, r.rate as reference_value from (select product_id, sum(gross_margin)/nullif(sum(revenue),0) as rate from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, sum(gross_margin)/nullif(sum(revenue),0) as rate from reference_output group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Gross margin rate (margin/revenue) by order_month.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.rate as model_value, r.rate as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(gross_margin)/nullif(sum(revenue),0) as rate from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(gross_margin)/nullif(sum(revenue),0) as rate from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Average units sold per product row by month, flags fan-out where row counts diverge but totals look similar.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.avg_val as model_value, r.avg_val as reference_value from (select order_month, avg(units_sold) as avg_val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, avg(units_sold) as avg_val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Count of rows with zero units_sold in each table, an edge case that may indicate orphaned aggregation rows.
sql: select 'zero_units_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where units_sold = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where units_sold = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative gross_margin in each table.
sql: select 'negative_margin_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with null product_name in each table (would indicate join issues to products).
sql: select 'null_product_name' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where product_name is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where product_name is null) as reference_value

description: Total revenue bucketed by week-of start-of-month (approximation using date_trunc week on order_month) to sanity-check finer time alignment.
sql: select coalesce(date_trunc('week', m.order_month), date_trunc('week', r.order_month))::varchar as slice, sum(m.val) as model_value, sum(r.val) as reference_value from (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month group by 1 order by 1

description: Revenue for the top 5 products by model revenue, compared to reference for the same products.
sql: with top_m as (select product_id from model_output group by 1 order by sum(revenue) desc limit 5) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from (select product_id, sum(revenue) as val from model_output where product_id in (select product_id from top_m) group by 1) m full outer join (select product_id, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output where product_id in (select product_id from top_m) group by 1) r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Distinct product count per month to detect missing product coverage in specific periods.
sql: select coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month)::varchar as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from (select order_month, count(distinct product_id) as cnt from model_output group by 1) m full outer join (select order_month, count(distinct product_id) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Revenue mismatches at the full (order_month, product_id) grain, filtered to only mismatched rows.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.revenue as model_value, r.revenue as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where m.revenue is distinct from r.revenue or m.revenue is null or r.revenue is null

description: Units sold mismatches at the full (order_month, product_id) grain, filtered to only mismatched rows.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.units_sold as model_value, r.units_sold as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where m.units_sold is distinct from r.units_sold or m.units_sold is null or r.units_sold is null

description: Supply cost mismatches at the full (order_month, product_id) grain, filtered to only mismatched rows.
sql: select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.supply_cost as model_value, r.supply_cost as reference_value from model_output m full outer join reference_output r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where m.supply_cost is distinct from r.supply_cost or m.supply_cost is null or r.supply_cost is null

description: Grand total revenue across all rows.
sql: select 'total_revenue' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total supply cost across all rows.
sql: select 'total_supply_cost' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total gross margin across all rows.
sql: select 'total_gross_margin' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total units sold across all rows.
sql: select 'total_units_sold' as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows in each table.
sql: select 'total_row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Revenue totaled by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Units sold totaled by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Supply cost totaled by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Gross margin totaled by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Revenue totaled by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Revenue totaled by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Gross margin totaled by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Revenue totaled by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Gross margin totaled by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Revenue for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue) as val from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn), r as (select sum(revenue) as val from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) select 'first_month_revenue' as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m, r

description: Revenue for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue) as val from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mx), r as (select sum(revenue) as val from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx) select 'last_month_revenue' as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m, r

description: Units sold for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(units_sold) as val from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn), r as (select sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) select 'first_month_units' as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m, r

description: Units sold for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(units_sold) as val from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mx), r as (select sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx) select 'last_month_units' as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m, r

description: Count of (product_id, order_month) keys present only in model vs only in reference.
sql: with m as (select distinct product_id, order_month from model_output), r as (select distinct product_id, order_month from reference_output), only_model as (select count(*) as cnt from m left join r on m.product_id = r.product_id and m.order_month = r.order_month where r.product_id is null), only_ref as (select count(*) as cnt from r left join m on r.product_id = m.product_id and r.order_month = m.order_month where m.product_id is null) select 'keys_only_in_model' as slice, only_model.cnt as model_value, 0 as reference_value from only_model union all select 'keys_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, only_ref.cnt as reference_value from only_ref

description: Row counts per order_month to detect missing or duplicated (product, month) rows.
sql: with m as (select order_month, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Row counts per product_id to detect missing or duplicated months.
sql: with m as (select product_id, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Count of distinct product_id values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_product_count' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Overall average revenue per unit sold, sensitive to null or fan-out distortions.
sql: select 'avg_revenue_per_unit' as slice, (select sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average revenue per unit sold by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Overall gross margin rate (gross_margin / revenue).
sql: select 'margin_rate_total' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Gross margin rate by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Overall supply cost as a fraction of revenue.
sql: select 'supply_cost_ratio_total' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost) / sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost) / sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of (product_id, order_month) combinations that appear more than once in each table (should be zero, grain violation).
sql: with m as (select product_id, order_month, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select product_id, order_month, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1,2) select 'duplicate_key_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from m where cnt > 1) as model_value, (select count(*) from r where cnt > 1) as reference_value

description: Count of product-month rows with negative gross margin.
sql: select 'negative_margin_product_months' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of product-month rows with exactly zero revenue.
sql: select 'zero_revenue_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue = 0) as reference_value

description: Count of null values in each key measure column, which could silently distort ratios.
sql: select 'null_revenue' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue is null) as reference_value union all select 'null_supply_cost' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where supply_cost is null) as reference_value union all select 'null_units_sold' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where units_sold is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where units_sold is null) as reference_value union all select 'null_gross_margin' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin is null) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct (product_id, product_name) pairs, to catch inconsistent or duplicated product naming.
sql: select 'distinct_product_id_name_pairs' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id || '|' || coalesce(product_name,'')) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id || '|' || coalesce(product_name,'')) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Revenue totaled by product_name, to catch join/mapping issues distinct from product_id slicing.
sql: with m as (select product_name, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_name, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_name, r.product_name) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_name = r.product_name order by 1

description: Average revenue per output row, sensitive to row-count differences caused by join fan-out or missing rows.
sql: select 'avg_revenue_per_row' as slice, (select sum(revenue) / count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) / count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total revenue over the trailing 12 months relative to the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)), m as (select sum(revenue) as val from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month > bounds.mx - interval 12 month), r as (select sum(revenue) as val from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month > bounds.mx - interval 12 month) select 'last_12_months_revenue' as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m, r

description: Grand total of revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue
sql:
select 'grand_total' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total of revenue in the most recent month
sql:
with latest as (select max(date_trunc('month', order_month)) as p from reference_output)
select 'latest month' as slice,
  (select sum(revenue) from model_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as model_value,
  (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where date_trunc('month', order_month) = (select p from latest)) as reference_value

description: Grand total units_sold across all rows, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total_units_sold' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total revenue across all rows, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total_revenue' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(revenue),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(revenue),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total supply_cost across all rows, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total_supply_cost' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(supply_cost),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(supply_cost),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total gross_margin across all rows, model vs reference.
sql: select 'total_gross_margin' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(gross_margin),0) from model_output) as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(gross_margin),0) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total row count comparison at the (order_month, product_id) grain.
sql: select 'row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct product_id values present in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_products' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_month values present in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_months' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Units sold totals by product_id, model vs reference, with full outer join to expose missing products.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Revenue totals by product_id, model vs reference, with full outer join to expose missing products.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id
