description: Revenue totals by order_month, model vs reference, with full outer join to expose missing months.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Supply cost totals by order_month, model vs reference, with full outer join to expose missing months.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Gross margin totals by order_month, model vs reference, with full outer join to expose missing months.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Revenue totals rolled up to quarter, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Units sold totals rolled up to quarter, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Supply cost totals rolled up to quarter, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(supply_cost) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(supply_cost) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Gross margin totals rolled up to quarter, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(gross_margin) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(gross_margin) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.q, r.q) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Revenue totals rolled up to year, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.y, r.y) as varchar) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Revenue total for the earliest order_month present in each table (boundary check).
sql: select 'first_month_revenue' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where order_month = (select min(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where order_month = (select min(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Revenue total for the latest order_month present in each table (boundary check).
sql: select 'last_month_revenue' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where order_month = (select max(order_month) from model_output)) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where order_month = (select max(order_month) from reference_output)) as reference_value

description: Earliest order_month present in each table, encoded as YYYYMM integer, to catch period boundary drift.
sql: select 'min_order_month' as slice, (select cast(strftime(min(order_month), '%Y%m') as integer) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(strftime(min(order_month), '%Y%m') as integer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Latest order_month present in each table, encoded as YYYYMM integer, to catch period boundary drift.
sql: select 'max_order_month' as slice, (select cast(strftime(max(order_month), '%Y%m') as integer) from model_output) as model_value, (select cast(strftime(max(order_month), '%Y%m') as integer) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Counts of (order_month, product_id) keys present only in model vs present only in reference; both should be zero.
sql: select 'key_coverage_mismatch_counts' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output m where not exists (select 1 from reference_output r where r.order_month = m.order_month and r.product_id = m.product_id)) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output r where not exists (select 1 from model_output m where m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id)) as reference_value

description: Count of product_id values whose product_name differs between model and reference (e.g. from SKU remapping); should be zero on both sides.
sql: select 'product_name_mismatch_count' as slice, (select count(*) from (select distinct product_id, product_name from model_output) m join (select distinct product_id, product_name from reference_output) r on m.product_id = r.product_id where m.product_name is distinct from r.product_name) as model_value, 0 as reference_value

description: Units sold for raw SKU JAF-005, which the model remaps into JAF-003; expect model_value near 0 if remap is working, compared to reference's independent treatment.
sql: select 'JAF-005_units_sold' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from model_output where product_id = 'JAF-005') as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from reference_output where product_id = 'JAF-005') as reference_value

description: Units sold for SKU JAF-003 alone, model vs reference, to see if the model's absorbed JAF-005 volume overstates this bucket.
sql: select 'JAF-003_units_sold' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from model_output where product_id = 'JAF-003') as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from reference_output where product_id = 'JAF-003') as reference_value

description: Model's JAF-003 revenue (post-remap) vs reference's combined JAF-003+JAF-005 revenue, to validate the SKU merge logic end-to-end.
sql: select 'JAF003_model_vs_JAF003+005_reference_revenue' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(revenue),0) from model_output where product_id = 'JAF-003') as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(revenue),0) from reference_output where product_id in ('JAF-003','JAF-005')) as reference_value

description: Model's JAF-003 units (post-remap) vs reference's combined JAF-003+JAF-005 units, to validate the SKU merge logic end-to-end.
sql: select 'JAF003_model_vs_JAF003+005_reference_units' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from model_output where product_id = 'JAF-003') as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(units_sold),0) from reference_output where product_id in ('JAF-003','JAF-005')) as reference_value

description: Model's JAF-003 supply_cost (post-remap) vs reference's combined JAF-003+JAF-005 supply_cost, to validate the SKU merge logic end-to-end.
sql: select 'JAF003_model_vs_JAF003+005_reference_supply_cost' as slice, (select coalesce(sum(supply_cost),0) from model_output where product_id = 'JAF-003') as model_value, (select coalesce(sum(supply_cost),0) from reference_output where product_id in ('JAF-003','JAF-005')) as reference_value

description: Overall gross margin as a fraction of revenue, model vs reference.
sql: select 'margin_ratio_total' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Gross margin as a fraction of revenue by product_id, model vs reference.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Average revenue per unit by product_id, model vs reference; exposes price or unit-count distortions.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) / sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Average gross margin per unit overall, model vs reference.
sql: select 'avg_margin_per_unit_total' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) / sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with negative gross_margin in each table, to catch sign or join errors.
sql: select 'negative_margin_row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null revenue value in each table.
sql: select 'null_revenue_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue is null) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with a null supply_cost value in each table.
sql: select 'null_supply_cost_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Number of (month) rows per product_id in each table, to detect join fan-out or missing-month duplication.
sql: with m as (select product_id, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id

description: Number of product rows per order_month in each table, to detect join fan-out or missing-product duplication.
sql: with m as (select order_month, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1) select cast(coalesce(m.order_month, r.order_month) as varchar) as slice, m.c as model_value, r.c as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compares grand total revenue across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total supply cost across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total gross margin across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares grand total units sold across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares total row counts between model and reference.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares revenue totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compares units sold totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compares supply cost totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compares gross margin totals by calendar month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compares revenue totals by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compares units sold totals by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compares supply cost totals by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compares gross margin totals by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compares revenue totals by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compares units sold totals by calendar quarter.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: Compares revenue totals by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Compares units sold totals by calendar year.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(units_sold) as val from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(units_sold) as val from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.val as model_value, r.val as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: Checks that combined revenue for JAF-005 and JAF-003 matches, since the model remaps JAF-005 into JAF-003.
sql: select 'JAF-005+JAF-003 combined revenue' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where product_id in ('JAF-005','JAF-003')) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where product_id in ('JAF-005','JAF-003')) as reference_value

description: Checks revenue for product_id JAF-005 alone; model should show none since it is remapped to JAF-003.
sql: select 'JAF-005 alone revenue' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output where product_id = 'JAF-005') as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output where product_id = 'JAF-005') as reference_value

description: Finds product_ids present in only one of the two tables.
sql: with m as (select distinct product_id from model_output), r as (select distinct product_id from reference_output) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, case when m.product_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.product_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id where m.product_id is null or r.product_id is null

description: Finds order_month/product_id key combinations present in only one of the two tables.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, product_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, product_id from reference_output) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || '|' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, case when m.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as model_value, case when r.order_month is not null then 1 else 0 end as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id where m.order_month is null or r.order_month is null limit 5000

description: Compares total revenue in the earliest order_month observed across both tables.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month_' || cast(bounds.mn as varchar) as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as reference_value from bounds

description: Compares total revenue in the latest order_month observed across both tables.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'last_month_' || cast(bounds.mx as varchar) as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mx) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx) as reference_value from bounds

description: Compares total units sold in the earliest order_month observed across both tables.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mn from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'first_month_' || cast(bounds.mn as varchar) as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mn) as reference_value from bounds

description: Compares total units sold in the latest order_month observed across both tables.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mx from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output)) select 'last_month_' || cast(bounds.mx as varchar) as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mx) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mx) as reference_value from bounds

description: Compares overall average revenue per unit sold.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output) / nullif((select sum(units_sold) from model_output),0) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output) / nullif((select sum(units_sold) from reference_output),0) as reference_value

description: Compares average revenue per unit sold by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev, sum(units_sold) as units from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev, sum(units_sold) as units from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.units,0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.units,0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compares gross margin as a percentage of revenue by month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as gm, sum(revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as gm, sum(revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.gm / nullif(m.rev,0) as model_value, r.gm / nullif(r.rev,0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compares the number of rows (product grain entries) per month.
sql: with m as (select order_month, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Compares the number of rows (monthly entries) per product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, count(*) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, count(*) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compares the number of distinct product_ids across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the number of distinct order_months across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Checks for duplicate order_month/product_id keys (violating the stated grain) in each table.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) - count(distinct order_month || '|' || product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) - count(distinct order_month || '|' || product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Compares the number of rows with negative gross margin.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Compares the overall ratio of supply cost to revenue.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost) from model_output) / nullif((select sum(revenue) from model_output),0) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost) from reference_output) / nullif((select sum(revenue) from reference_output),0) as reference_value

description: Compares each top-5 (by model revenue) product's share of total revenue between model and reference.
sql: with model_tot as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev from model_output group by 1), ref_tot as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev from reference_output group by 1), model_grand as (select sum(rev) as g from model_tot), ref_grand as (select sum(rev) as g from ref_tot), top5 as (select product_id from model_tot order by rev desc limit 5) select top5.product_id as slice, model_tot.rev / nullif(model_grand.g,0) as model_value, ref_tot.rev / nullif(ref_grand.g,0) as reference_value from top5 left join model_tot on top5.product_id = model_tot.product_id left join ref_tot on top5.product_id = ref_tot.product_id cross join model_grand cross join ref_grand

description: Compares weighted average unit price (revenue/units) by product_id.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev, sum(units_sold) as units from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as rev, sum(units_sold) as units from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.rev / nullif(m.units,0) as model_value, r.rev / nullif(r.units,0) as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Compares the count of rows with null revenue.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where revenue is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where revenue is null) as reference_value

description: Compares the count of rows with null supply_cost.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where supply_cost is null) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where supply_cost is null) as reference_value

description: Checks that each product_id maps to exactly one product_name, comparing counts between tables.
sql: with m as (select product_id, count(distinct product_name) as cnt from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, count(distinct product_name) as cnt from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.cnt as model_value, r.cnt as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Grand total of units_sold across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of revenue across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of supply_cost across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Grand total of gross_margin across all rows.
sql: select 'total' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Total number of rows in each table.
sql: select 'total_row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct product_id values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_product_count' as slice, (select count(distinct product_id) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct product_id) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Count of distinct order_month values in each table.
sql: select 'distinct_month_count' as slice, (select count(distinct order_month) from model_output) as model_value, (select count(distinct order_month) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: units_sold totals by product_id, full outer joined to expose product_id mismatches (e.g. JAF-005/JAF-003 remapping).
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: revenue totals by product_id, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: supply_cost totals by product_id, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: gross_margin totals by product_id, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Row counts per product_id, full outer joined to surface coverage gaps.
sql: with m as (select product_id, count(*) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, count(*) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: revenue totals by product_name, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select product_name, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_name, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_name, r.product_name) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_name = r.product_name order by 1

description: units_sold totals by order_month, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: revenue totals by order_month, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: supply_cost totals by order_month, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(supply_cost) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: gross_margin totals by order_month, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(gross_margin) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: revenue totals rolled up to quarter, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('quarter', order_month) as q, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.q as varchar), cast(r.q as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.q = r.q order by 1

description: revenue totals rolled up to year, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select date_trunc('year', order_month) as y, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.y as varchar), cast(r.y as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.y = r.y order by 1

description: revenue total for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output) u) select 'first_month:' || cast(bounds.mm as varchar) as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as reference_value from bounds

description: revenue total for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output) u) select 'last_month:' || cast(bounds.mm as varchar) as slice, (select sum(revenue) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as model_value, (select sum(revenue) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as reference_value from bounds

description: units_sold total for the earliest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select min(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output) u) select 'first_month:' || cast(bounds.mm as varchar) as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as reference_value from bounds

description: units_sold total for the latest order_month present in either table.
sql: with bounds as (select max(order_month) as mm from (select order_month from model_output union select order_month from reference_output) u) select 'last_month:' || cast(bounds.mm as varchar) as slice, (select sum(units_sold) from model_output, bounds where model_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as model_value, (select sum(units_sold) from reference_output, bounds where reference_output.order_month = bounds.mm) as reference_value from bounds

description: Counts of (order_month, product_id) keys present only in model_output or only in reference_output.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month, product_id from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month, product_id from reference_output), only_m as (select m.* from m left join r using (order_month, product_id) where r.order_month is null), only_r as (select r.* from r left join m using (order_month, product_id) where m.order_month is null) select 'keys_only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from only_m) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'keys_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from only_r) as reference_value

description: Count of product_id values present only in one table.
sql: with m as (select distinct product_id from model_output), r as (select distinct product_id from reference_output) select 'product_ids_only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from m left join r using (product_id) where r.product_id is null) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'product_ids_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from r left join m using (product_id) where m.product_id is null) as reference_value

description: Count of order_month values present only in one table.
sql: with m as (select distinct order_month from model_output), r as (select distinct order_month from reference_output) select 'months_only_in_model' as slice, (select count(*) from m left join r using (order_month) where r.order_month is null) as model_value, 0 as reference_value union all select 'months_only_in_reference' as slice, 0 as model_value, (select count(*) from r left join m using (order_month) where m.order_month is null) as reference_value

description: Count of (order_month, product_id) keys that appear more than once, validating the expected grain in each table.
sql: with m as (select order_month, product_id, count(*) as c from model_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1), r as (select order_month, product_id, count(*) as c from reference_output group by 1,2 having count(*) > 1) select 'duplicate_key_rows' as slice, (select count(*) from m) as model_value, (select count(*) from r) as reference_value

description: Overall gross margin rate (gross_margin / revenue) across all rows.
sql: select 'margin_rate_total' as slice, (select sum(gross_margin)::double / sum(revenue) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(gross_margin)::double / sum(revenue) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Gross margin rate per product_id, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin)::double / sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(gross_margin)::double / sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Overall average revenue per unit sold across all rows.
sql: select 'avg_revenue_per_unit_total' as slice, (select sum(revenue)::double / sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(revenue)::double / sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average revenue per unit sold by order_month, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select order_month, sum(revenue)::double / sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select order_month, sum(revenue)::double / sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month order by 1

description: Overall average supply cost per unit sold across all rows.
sql: select 'avg_supply_cost_per_unit_total' as slice, (select sum(supply_cost)::double / sum(units_sold) from model_output) as model_value, (select sum(supply_cost)::double / sum(units_sold) from reference_output) as reference_value

description: Average supply cost per unit sold by product_id, full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost)::double / sum(units_sold) as v from model_output group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(supply_cost)::double / sum(units_sold) as v from reference_output group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: Count of rows with negative gross_margin in each table.
sql: select 'negative_margin_row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where gross_margin < 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where gross_margin < 0) as reference_value

description: Count of rows with units_sold = 0 in each table.
sql: select 'zero_units_row_count' as slice, (select count(*) from model_output where units_sold = 0) as model_value, (select count(*) from reference_output where units_sold = 0) as reference_value

description: revenue for JAF-003 and JAF-005 specifically, to expose the model's remapping of JAF-005 into JAF-003.
sql: with m as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from model_output where product_id in ('JAF-003','JAF-005') group by 1), r as (select product_id, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output where product_id in ('JAF-003','JAF-005') group by 1) select coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1

description: revenue at the full model grain (order_month x product_id), full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select order_month, product_id, sum(revenue) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select order_month, product_id, sum(revenue) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1 limit 5000

description: gross_margin at the full model grain (order_month x product_id), full outer joined.
sql: with m as (select order_month, product_id, sum(gross_margin) as v from model_output group by 1,2), r as (select order_month, product_id, sum(gross_margin) as v from reference_output group by 1,2) select coalesce(cast(m.order_month as varchar), cast(r.order_month as varchar)) || ' | ' || coalesce(m.product_id, r.product_id) as slice, m.v as model_value, r.v as reference_value from m full outer join r on m.order_month = r.order_month and m.product_id = r.product_id order by 1 limit 5000
